Focus helpers use global document.querySelector on data-accordion-trigger (223-254) so two accordions with same item ids steal focus across instances. Collapsed panels are height:0 overflow hidden but not hidden/inert, so focusable content inside closed panels stays in tab order. Trigger min-height 44/48 good.
api: forwardRef yes, className/style passthrough, controlled/uncontrolled value/defaultValue, but data-driven items[] only (no compound Accordion.Item/Trigger/Content), no asChild, value type flips string vs string[] by `multiple`. compact/contained/maxHeight props are layout hacks for docs previews.
ssr: 'use client'; document access only in event handlers. OK.
fake_complexity: None.
target: Single compound Accordion (Root/Item/Trigger/Content) on a shared disclosure primitive; absorb GlassAccordionUI
justification: Accordion is a core primitive that must be flawless; this one uses tab semantics, has broken aria-labelledby, cross-instance focus via document.querySelector, a non-rotating (or double-rotating) chevron and inline rgba that overrides the glass primitive. Two accordions exist in the library. Rebuild once as a compound disclosure component with correct WAI-ARIA, scoped focus, inert closed panels and token-driven material, then retire GlassAccordionUI.

name: GlassAlert (+ GlassAlertTitle, GlassAlertDescription, GlassAlertActions; aliases Alert/AlertTitle/...)

stories.notes: Placeholder docs text.

material_impl: Uses OptimizedGlass with intent mapping (success/warning/danger) - one of the cleaner uses of the shared primitive. 'info' maps to neutral intent (141-142) so info has no visual identity. Exposes raw primitive knobs (blur, animation 'morph/ripple/wave', border 'neon/particle', lighting 'caustic/iridescent', intensity 'ultra') - leaking the material engine into a feedback component.
motion: Motion preset slideUp; reduced motion wired via useMotionPreferenceContext (114-117). Dismiss is instant (no exit animation).
a11y: role=alert combined with aria-live=polite default (193-195) - contradictory (alert is implicitly assertive); every static inline alert announces on mount. Dismiss button labelled. Title is hard-coded <h5> (251) regardless of document outline. ContrastGuard/TextWithContrast imported but unused.
api: forwardRef; className passthrough; variant includes both 'error' and 'destructive' synonyms; dismiss is uncontrolled only (internal dismissed state, no open prop). Compound parts exist. Ref goes to OptimizedGlass but when animated the outer element is Motion wrapper, so className lands on inner element.
fake_complexity: None, but prop surface (lighting=caustic, border=particle) promises effects irrelevant to an alert.
justification: Structurally reasonable compound alert on the shared primitive. Needs: correct live-region semantics (role=status for non-urgent, alert only for errors), distinct info intent, controlled open + exit motion, configurable heading level, and removal of the leaked material-engine props. GlassErrorState should become an Alert recipe rather than a separate component.

name: GlassAnimatedNumber (+ GlassAnimatedCounter, GlassAnimatedStat, useAnimatedNumber)

stories.notes: Best story coverage in shard (Sizes, Variants, InteractiveDemo, DashboardExample).

material_impl: Wraps the bare number in an OptimizedGlass pill with inline hard-coded border rgba(148,163,184,0.18) and triple box-shadow (204-211). A number should be typography, not a glass chip; GlassAnimatedStat additionally wraps the label text in its own OptimizedGlass (315-321), producing glass-on-glass blobs around plain text.
motion: Custom rAF tween with 4 easings. Reduced motion NOT handled: useReducedMotion is imported but never called (16), and respectMotionPreference is declared in props (46) but not destructured, so it leaks via ...props onto OptimizedGlass/DOM. useAnimatedNumber hook has no rAF cancel on unmount (368-387).
a11y: aria-label on a generic div without role; no aria-live, and every intermediate frame value is rendered as text so screen readers reading on change get noise. No final-value-only accessible text.
api: forwardRef via useImperativeHandle; className only (no style passthrough beyond spread); formatter/prefix/suffix good, but no Intl.NumberFormat/locale (manual regex comma). Compound helpers are React.FC without forwardRef/className consistency.
ssr: 'use client'; SSR renders `from` value (0) then animates - hydration-safe but shows 0 on first paint.
fake_complexity: None.
target: Unstyled-by-default AnimatedNumber (typography only, Intl.NumberFormat, reduced-motion, aria-live final value) consumed by a single Metric/Stat component
justification: Counting numbers are a premium-feel detail, but this implementation puts a glass box around text, ignores reduced motion despite importing the hook, leaks a prop to the DOM, and lacks locale formatting. Redesign as a pure typographic primitive and fold Counter/Stat into the metric family.

name: GlassAvatar (+ GlassAvatarGroup, GlassAvatarFallback)

stories.notes: Placeholder docs.

material_impl: OptimizedGlass plus Tailwind-ish 'glass-backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10 glass-border-white/20' (229) layered on top -> double blur/background; sizes/radius duplicated as both classes and inline styles (107-143). Variant literally named 'glass-radius-md' (18) - a CSS class name leaked into the public API.
motion: Loading spinner glass-animate-spin with no reduced-motion handling.
a11y: Outer OptimizedGlass role=img with aria-label AND inner => double announcement. Status dot uses role=status (287) - a live region per avatar. Status conveyed only by color.
api: forwardRef targets the , which is absent when showing fallback -> ref null. elevation typed 1|2|3 but default is 'level1' string (90) and AvatarGroup passes 'level2' (345) -> both silently fall to level1. className applied to wrapper AND inner glass (198, 230). isLoading not reset when src changes. AvatarGroup spacing classes '-glass-gap-1' are nonexistent; actual overlap via inline margins.
fake_complexity: None.
duplicates: src/components/interactive/GlassAvatarGroup.tsx (root export GlassAvatarGroup at src/index.ts:403 is the interactive one; this file's GlassAvatarGroup is shadowed)
target: Compound Avatar (Root/Image/Fallback/Status) + single AvatarGroup; delete duplicate in interactive/
justification: Typing is internally contradictory (elevation), the public variant name is a CSS class, the ref disappears in fallback state, and a11y double-announces. Two AvatarGroups exist. Rebuild as a small compound primitive with Radix-style image loading status.

name: GlassBadge (+ StatusBadge, CountBadge, BadgeGroup)

stories.notes: Placeholder docs.

material_impl: Each badge is a full OptimizedGlass (backdrop-filter per badge). All nine variants map to essentially the same class 'glass-border glass-border-black/10' (133-143) - a class not defined in library CSS - so success/warning/error badges are visually identical neutral pills. Dot colors use shadcn tokens bg-primary/bg-success/bg-destructive (145-155) that only partially exist via a [data-glass-component] compat shim in src/styles/glass.css.
motion: Motion preset on mount; reduced motion wired. Runtime-built Tailwind arbitrary class `duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms]` (219) can never be compiled.
a11y: Every badge is role=status (188, 225) => live-region spam in lists. Removable badge sets role=button on the container AND nests a GlassButton => nested interactive. aria-label `Badge: ${children}` stringifies ReactNode children to '[object Object]' for non-string content (227). Remove button sized to icon (12-16px) - fails touch target.
api: forwardRef (cast as any to OptimizedGlass); variant typed as open string; shape option literally 'glass-radius-md' (40). Helpers inconsistent.
fake_complexity: Semantic variants are fake - they do not change appearance.
target: One Badge primitive (non-interactive, tokenized tone scale, no backdrop-filter) + Tag/Chip for interactive; fold BadgeLine/BadgeCluster/StatusBadge into it
justification: A badge that renders all semantic tones identically and is a live region is broken at the most basic level. Per-badge backdrop-filter is wasteful for a 20px label. Redesign as a cheap, tokenized tone badge; interactive/removable behavior belongs to Chip.

name: GlassBadgeLine

stories.notes: Placeholder docs.

material_impl: Pure Tailwind classes bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 bg-amber-500/15 bg-red-500/15 (52-58) - none defined in library CSS (rg count 0), so without consumer Tailwind every intent renders identically unstyled. No glass primitive.
motion: None (unused ANIMATION/useReducedMotion imports).
a11y: role=list/listitem OK; aria-label per item overrides visible text with 'success badge: X' - acceptable.
api: forwardRef; items[] only; 'danger' vs Badge 'error' naming inconsistency; index keys.
fake_complexity: Intent styling is non-functional in the shipped CSS.
target: Badge group pattern (BadgeGroup) in redesigned Badge
justification: A 73-line map over Tailwind classes the library does not ship. It is a strict subset of BadgeGroup and LiquidGlassBadgeCluster. Remove (or keep a deprecated alias to the consolidated Badge group for one major).

name: GlassChip (+ GlassChipGroup)

tests.notes: Template tests; no selection/removal behavior tests.

material_impl: OptimizedGlass with liftOnHover/press plus extra 'glass-backdrop-blur-md' class. All nine variants map to the same 'glass-border-black/10' class (124-170, undefined in CSS) - comment admits shell stays neutral. Forces --glass-theme-text to dark slate rgba(15,23,42,0.92) inline (301) - unreadable on dark surfaces, theme-hostile.
motion: Motion scaleIn wrapper; useMotionPreference wired. Hover-scale classes glass-hover-scale-105 / active:scale-95. GlassChipGroup wraps each chip in a second Motion (slideIn, 50ms stagger) so each chip animates twice.
a11y: role=checkbox when onSelect, role=button when clickable, otherwise role=status (308) - static chips become live regions. GroupChip single-selection still uses checkbox semantics (should be radio). Remove <button> nested inside role=checkbox/button container => nested interactive. Remove button 20x20px (249). Default chip tabIndex=-1.
api: forwardRef; controlled selected; group supports controlled/uncontrolled. Plays UI sounds (useGlassSound) on click/select/remove by default (180-194) - surprising side effect for a design-system chip.
ssr: 'use client'; sound util presumably lazily creates AudioContext (not verified).
fake_complexity: Semantic variants do nothing visually.
target: Chip/Tag (interactive: filter, input, choice) with ChipGroup using radio/checkbox group semantics; absorbs removable Badge
justification: Chips are high-frequency surfaces; this one has fake variants, forced dark text, nested interactive controls, wrong ARIA for single-select, sub-minimum remove target and default sound effects. Redesign into a proper filter/choice chip family with tokenized selected state.

name: GlassDataGrid

tests.notes: Includes real keyboard sort tests (Enter/Space, non-sortable).

material_impl: OptimizedGlass container + CSS module using --aura-* tokens and color-mix (module.css:15-170) - the most token-disciplined styling in this shard. Remaining hard-codes are fallbacks only.
motion: CSS transitions on row/header with token durations; no reduced-motion override in module CSS (transitions are short).
a11y: Native table with columnheader + aria-sort, sortable headers tabbable with Enter/Space (203-211, 326-347). aria-label 'Column X' overrides visible header text unnecessarily. Drag handles are role=button tabIndex=0 but do nothing (see fake_complexity) - focusable dead controls.
api: forwardRef; className/style; tri-state sort; columns accept key/id/header/label/accessorKey/cellRenderer/render (multiple synonyms) - API sprawl. initialSort only (no controlled sort).
fake_complexity: enableRowDragging and sort-indicator spring are fake: useDraggableListPhysics and useVectorSpring are inline stubs returning empty handlers/styles (66-77), so drag handles render but reordering never happens and onRowOrderChange is never called; 'perspective: 1000px' (280) is leftover.
target: Single GlassTable/DataTable (headless sort/filter/selection + optional virtualization); reuse this file's CSS-module token approach
justification: Clean token-based CSS and decent keyboard sort, but it ships a fake drag-reorder feature with stub physics hooks and duplicates at least five other table implementations. Its styling approach should be the template for the consolidated table; the component itself should be merged.

name: GlassDataGridPro
material_impl: None of its own; delegates to GlassDataTable.
motion: Inherited.
a11y: Wraps table in role=region div; otherwise inherits DataTable issues.
api: Different prop names than DataTable (rows vs data, density vs size). `grouping` prop declared (22) but never used; density 'spacious' ignored; ref goes to wrapper div.
ssr: Inherits DataTable's heavy imports of the advanced/* 'consciousness' modules.
fake_complexity: 'Pro' is a name only - source comment: 'Lightweight wrapper around GlassDataTable; placeholder for advanced features' (29). Grouping not implemented.
target: GlassDataTable (consolidated)
justification: A placeholder that advertises Pro features (grouping) it does not implement, with a divergent prop vocabulary. Remove; provide a codemod/alias to the consolidated table.

name: GlassDataTable (+ ConsciousGlassDataTable, PredictiveDataTable, GazeResponsiveDataTable, AccessibleDataTable, DataTableConsciousnessPresets)

stories.notes: Placeholder docs; no stories for selection, loading, empty, sticky header or consciousness variants.

tests.notes: Some real behavior tests (mobile rows, sorting, selection, pagination states).

material_impl: OptimizedGlass + createGlassStyle, then overridden inline with hard-coded gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.05->0.018), shadows and borderColor (732-746); controls styled by inline tableControlStyle constants with hard-coded rgba and an SF Pro font stack (34-50). thead uses both bg-muted/20 class and inline rgba (853-856). Three competing material sources.
motion: Reduced motion via useReducedMotion gates transition classes, but those classes are runtime-built Tailwind arbitrary values `duration-[${...}ms]` (729, 895, 1042) that cannot exist in CSS. 'animate-pulse' applied to all rows when a predicted sort column exists (1056-1062).
a11y: Desktop sortable <th> are click-only: no tabIndex, no button, no key handler (882-910) - keyboard users cannot sort (DataGrid gets this right). aria-sort='none' set on non-sortable columns. Mobile card rows clickable divs without role/keyboard (775-790). Checkbox accent hard-coded slate (868) - near invisible on dark glass. Mobile stacked dl layout is a genuine good idea.
api: Generic typed columns (accessorKey/accessorFn/cell) - decent. But GlassDataTable wrapper (218-222) is a plain function that spreads props into the forwardRef inner; with React 18.2 (package.json:471) `ref` is stripped from props, so ref never reaches the DOM. Default getRowId uses index, so selection breaks across pages/sorting. Sort/filter/pagination/search are uncontrolled only; filterable has no UI. Default searchable=true and pagination=true.
ssr: 'use client'. Statically imports five 'advanced' modules (~6,150 lines, framer-motion) - GlassPredictiveEngine, GlassAchievementSystem, GlassBiometricAdaptation, GlassEyeTracking, GlassSpatialAudio (12-19) - into every table bundle. Hooks are called conditionally (302-310) violating Rules of Hooks; toggling a feature prop at runtime corrupts hook order.
fake_complexity: Severe. 'Eye tracking' handler is never attached - subscription lines are commented out (430-437). 'Biometric' adaptation changes page size from a stress level derived from mouse-movement heuristics; outside its provider the default context returns stress 0 (advanced/GlassBiometricAdaptation.tsx:749-753). 'Predictive' sorting builds a fake MouseEvent object with document.createElement to record a click (550-574). 'AccessibleDataTable' preset = biometric + spatial audio + achievements, which has nothing to do with accessibility (1336-1351).
target: Single consolidated GlassTable: headless core (TanStack-style) + glass skin from GlassDataGrid.module.css; drop all consciousness variants
justification: A data table is a flagship-grade surface for a premium design system and this file has the right bones (typed columns, mobile card layout, pagination, selection). But it is weighed down by Rules-of-Hooks violations, a dropped ref, keyboard-inaccessible sorting, three competing material sources, dead Tailwind classes, 6k lines of pseudo-AI imports and fake eye-tracking/biometric presets. Rebuild as the one table for the library with controlled state, virtualization option and real a11y; delete the consciousness exports and the four sibling tables.

name: GlassDiffViewer
material_impl: OptimizedGlass overridden inline with hard-coded gradient/border/shadow (199-210, 283-294) duplicated twice; add/remove row colors hard-coded rgba mint/rose (85-100) not tokens. One fallback color is dark slate (219) while others are light - inconsistent.
motion: None.
a11y: Rows have aria-label 'Added line' which replaces the code content for AT (142) - screen reader hears 'Added line' not the code. Sign column aria-hidden. Color + sign used (good).
api: No forwardRef, no style/rest passthrough. `language` prop only sets a data attribute (no highlighting). sideBySide and mode are redundant. Ships default demo strings as left/right defaults (29-31).
fake_complexity: The 'diff' is positional line-by-line comparison, not an LCS/Myers diff (43-83): inserting one line at the top marks every subsequent line as removed+added. 'split' mode just shows raw before/after panels with no change highlighting.
target: Shared CodeSurface primitive + DiffViewer using a real diff algorithm (e.g. jsdiff, pinned) with optional highlighter
justification: The name promises a diff viewer; the algorithm is wrong for any real-world change, and split mode does not show differences. Either implement a real line diff with hunks and split alignment on a shared code-surface primitive, or remove it from the core package.

name: GlassDivider (+ GlassTextDivider, GlassIconDivider)
material_impl: Relies on Tailwind classes not shipped by the library: bg-gradient-to-r with from-transparent/via-primary/40 (gradient stops absent - rg finds no via-primary rule), bg-glass-border/20, shadow-primary/20, animate-shimmer, animate-glow (93-124, 206-212). Default line sizes h-0.5 / w-0.5 / h-1 etc. A 1px hairline gets 'glass-backdrop-blur-sm' (200). Label wrapped in an OptimizedGlass pill (255-270).
motion: Every divider fades in via Motion; useMotionPreference wired. animate-shimmer/animate-glow classes undefined (library has glass-animate-shimmer instead).
a11y: role=separator with aria-orientation; but labelled variant puts content inside role=separator (separator children are presentational) so label text is hidden from some AT.
api: forwardRef via Motion as=div; 6 variants x 5 colors x 3 opacities x 4 animations x 6 spacings - large surface mostly non-functional. Vertical always adds glass-mx-4 regardless of spacing prop.
fake_complexity: Gradient/glow/shimmer variants likely render as nothing/flat because classes are missing.
target: GlassSeparator (layout) with a token hairline + optional label slot
justification: A divider should be a token hairline; this one has a combinatorial prop surface built on missing Tailwind classes, animates on mount, and duplicates GlassSeparator. Merge into one Separator with hairline/label variants.

name: GlassEmptyState

stories.notes: Default + SearchResults.

material_impl: OptimizedGlass (subtle). Inline override forces --glass-theme-text: rgba(15,23,42,0.92) dark slate (83) - on the library's default dark glass theme this yields dark text on dark glass unless glass-text-* classes win. Icon well uses glass-bg-white/8 class.
motion: None.
a11y: role=status aria-live=polite on a static empty state (68-69) - announces on mount; heading hard-coded h3. Actions use GlassButton asChild for links (good).
api: forwardRef, className, rest; variant 'compact' mixed with semantic variants; actions as data objects instead of slots. Default copy baked in.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: Small, sane, recent component. Fix the forced dark text token, drop the live-region role, add heading-level/slot API, add tests and certification coverage (no screenshot exists), and make tables/kanban reuse it for their empty states.

name: GlassErrorState
material_impl: OptimizedGlass with border="visible" (43) - not a member of the OptimizedGlass border union (src/primitives/OptimizedGlassCore.tsx:60-69), so it falls through to default. Same forced dark --glass-theme-text override (48). Error icon uses glass-text-primary - no danger color at all.
motion: None.
a11y: role=alert + aria-live assertive for error severity - acceptable for a load failure; heading h3 fixed.
api: forwardRef; onRetry; severity only toggles aria-live, not visuals.
fake_complexity: severity='warning' has no visual effect.
target: StateView (empty/error/loading) family sharing one layout, or GlassAlert recipe
justification: Thin component with an invalid primitive prop and no danger styling. Merge with EmptyState/LoadingState into a single state-view component with tone tokens.

name: GlassGanttChart

tests.notes: Template tests only.

material_impl: Every task bar is its own OptimizedGlass with backdrop-blur (463-499) inside a glass container - N backdrop-filters for N tasks. Status colors hard-coded hex (244-250); milestone colors hard-coded #70d6ff; many glass-surface-primary/30-style classes.
motion: Motion fadeIn/slideUp/slideRight with per-row stagger delays (index*50/100ms); useMotionPreference wired. Dead runtime class glass-duration-[${...}ms] (470, 518).
a11y: No grid/treegrid/table semantics; task bars are non-focusable divs with mouse-only click/drag (490-499); hierarchy expand button '▼' has no handler or label (731-733); no keyboard alternative for move/resize/progress; milestone info via title attribute only.
api: forwardRef; extensive props but onTaskUpdate, onDependencyCreate, onDependencyDelete, showCriticalPath, showBaseline are declared and never used. Plays sounds on drag (280, 341).
ssr: Uses new Date() during render for today/default range - hydration mismatch risk near midnight/timezone; otherwise safe.
fake_complexity: Partial. Basic bars/dependency lines work, but critical path/baseline/dependency editing are advertised and absent; collapse button is a no-op. Correctness bug: hierarchy indentation applies marginLeft: level*20 to timeline bars (482), shifting child tasks to the wrong dates. 'W' week labels compute Math.ceil(date/7) - week-of-month, not ISO week (370). Each dependency renders a full-size SVG overlay (853-878).
target: Move to an optional @aura-glass/charts or labs package; not core
justification: A Gantt chart is an application, not a design-system component. This one misplaces child task dates, has no keyboard path, advertises unimplemented features and uses per-bar backdrop-filter. Deprecate out of core; if kept, rebuild in a labs package on a canvas/SVG renderer with a single glass container.

name: GlassHeatmap

stories.notes: Placeholder docs.

material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell overridden by inline heatmapSurfaceStyle/insetStyle/legendStyle constants with hard-coded rgba (108-135); legend and tooltip are additional OptimizedGlass layers (glass-on-glass-on-glass). Default color scale hex #163047->#25bde3; token colors are resolved by string-matching CSS var names to hard-coded hex (303-307) - token system bypassed.
motion: Reduced motion wired via useMotionPreferenceContext. Every cell gets its own Motion scaleIn with delay (row*cols+col)*10ms (804-819): a 50x50 grid takes 25s to finish appearing and mounts 2,500 Motion wrappers.
a11y: Each cell is a <button> with no accessible name (417-448) - unlabeled buttons; values/tooltip only on mouse hover; zoom buttons '+'/'−' unlabeled (864-875); no table/grid fallback or data summary; y-axis labels use justify-between so they do not align with rows.
api: forwardRef, className/style; accepts matrix or points; selection controlled-only; renderCell/renderTooltip escape hatches good. onWheel preventDefault in React's passive listener does not stop page scroll.
fake_complexity: None in name; zoom is crude.
duplicates: charts/ components (GlassChart etc., not verified in this shard)
target: Charts family on a shared viz layer (single SVG/canvas, tokenized sequential palettes, accessible data table fallback)
justification: Useful concept, but per-cell buttons without names, per-cell Motion staggering, nested glass layers and token-by-string-matching make it neither accessible nor scalable. Redesign within a coherent charts layer.

name: GlassJSONViewer

stories.notes: Placeholder docs.

material_impl: OptimizedGlass then a bespoke inline backdropFilter 'blur(16px) saturate(1.4) brightness(1.08) contrast(1.04)' with hard-coded gradient/border/shadow (5-16) - the clearest case in this shard of bypassing the material system with hand-rolled backdrop-filter.
motion: None.
a11y: Plain <pre>; no label/region; fine but minimal.
api: No forwardRef, no rest/style passthrough. Just JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) - throws on circular structures/BigInt with no guard.
fake_complexity: Named 'Viewer' but has no collapsing, syntax coloring, copy, or search - it is a styled <pre>.
target: Shared CodeSurface/CodeBlock primitive (JSON as a language mode); collapsible tree as optional labs feature
justification: A 78-line styled <pre> with bespoke backdrop-filter and an unsafe stringify. Fold into one code-surface primitive shared with DiffViewer/SchemaViewer.

name: GlassKanbanBoard

stories.notes: Default + CompactCards with stateful onCardMove; realistic content.

tests.notes: Includes contained/compact sizing tests; no drag tests.

material_impl: Three nested OptimizedGlass levels (board > column > card), each also adding 'glass-backdrop-blur-md' (382, 719, 803) - stacked backdrop-filters for every card. Priority/due-date colors via Tailwind bg-green-500/5, bg-red-500, text-red-600 (272-277, 341-346, 519-524) mostly absent from library CSS; board text color hard-coded rgba(248,250,252,0.94) (731).
motion: Motion fadeIn/slideUp with column and card staggering; reduced motion wired via useMotionPreferenceContext. Hover scale-[1.02] arbitrary class not shipped.
a11y: Cards focusable (tabIndex 0, role=article) with Enter/Space to click, but drag is HTML5 DnD only - no keyboard move, no live announcements; touch devices cannot drag (HTML5 DnD). Column add/delete buttons 24px. Headings h1/h2/h3 hard-coded inside a component.
api: forwardRef; many show* booleans (showHeader/showToolbar/showActions/showAddColumn/showAddCard) overlapping; drop position is always 0 or end - no within-column reorder or insertion index. scrollPositions state tracked but never used; virtualized prop unused. Plays sounds via useGlassSound feedback.
ssr: new Date() comparisons in render for due-date coloring; otherwise safe.
fake_complexity: Ships hard-coded demo data: when columns=[] and no emptyState, it renders DEFAULT_KANBAN_COLUMNS ('Sketch hero', 'Wire previews') (126-172, 263-264) - production consumers with an empty board see fake cards. 'virtualized' prop does nothing.
target: Labs/templates package (merge with interactive/GlassKanban); core keeps only Card + sortable list primitives
justification: Board-level app widget with demo data baked in, no keyboard or touch drag, no insertion index, triple stacked backdrop-filters and a duplicate in interactive/. Move out of core into a templates/labs package built on a real accessible DnD layer (e.g. dnd-kit, pinned).

name: GlassLoadingSkeleton
material_impl: Mixed. Card/dashboard layouts wrap in OptimizedGlass but override background/border/boxShadow inline with hard-coded rgba (lines 136-142, 310-316). Every bone is a bespoke div with a hard-coded double linear-gradient + rgba border/shadow (getSkeletonStyle, lines 83-91) plus glass-backdrop-blur-md on every bone (line 79) -> N backdrop-filter layers per skeleton. Shimmer overlay uses color-mix on --glass-white (line 400) but class glass-animate-glass-shimmer has no CSS definition anywhere in src/styles or dist (verified by rg) so the overlay is a static skewed band.
motion: Motion primitive fadeIn wrapper; pulse via glass-animate-pulse (no CSS definition found in src/styles); shimmer class undefined. Reduced motion IS wired via useMotionPreferenceContext (lines 62-66) and gates both animate and shimmer.
a11y: role=status, aria-busy, aria-live=polite, default aria-label 'Loading content' (lines 382-386). Good. Bones are not aria-hidden but are empty divs.
api: forwardRef, but ref + ...props go to the inner div while className goes to the outer Motion wrapper (lines 376-389) - split passthrough is surprising. Variant list (default/card/list/table/form/dashboard) is a layout preset menu, table hard-codes 4 columns (line 239). Exports GlassSkeletonText/Card/List/Table names that collide with GlassSkeleton.tsx and GlassSkeletonLoader.tsx exports. Dead export skeletonAnimationCSS 'should be added to globals.css' (lines 442-456). Unused imports ContrastGuard/TextWithContrast/ANIMATION/useReducedMotion.
ssr: use client; no window at module scope; Motion import only.
fake_complexity: 'Premium shimmer overlay' (line 393) references a non-existent animation class, so it does not shimmer.
target: Single GlassSkeleton primitive (shape bones) + GlassLoadingState (composition presets)
justification: This is one of three independent skeleton systems (GlassSkeleton, GlassSkeletonLoader, GlassLoadingSkeleton) with conflicting compound export names. It has the best a11y wiring of the three (role=status + reduced motion) but its shimmer and pulse classes do not exist in the stylesheet, and stacking backdrop blur on every bone is expensive for a placeholder. The certification screenshot shows bones at luminance >=229 on a 255 white canvas, i.e. effectively invisible grey-on-white. Keep its a11y contract and layout presets, fold into one skeleton API.
evidence: reports/glassmorphism-storybook-visual-certification/screenshots/components-data-display-glassloadingskeleton/desktop.png: pixel analysis min luminance in component band 229-245, saturation 0

name: GlassLoadingState
material_impl: Shared primitive: OptimizedGlass with tokenized props (elevation level1, intensity subtle, tint neutral, border subtle) and no inline color overrides (lines 37-49). Cleanest material usage in the shard. Skeleton bones use glass-bg-white/12 (defined).
motion: Spinner relies on class glass-animate-spin (line 57) which has NO CSS definition in src/styles or dist (verified) - the Loader2 icon is static. No reduced-motion branch needed since nothing animates, but that is accidental.
a11y: role=status, aria-live=polite, aria-busy (lines 40-42); icon aria-hidden; progress variant has role=progressbar with valuenow but no accessible name (lines 83-89).
api: forwardRef, HTMLAttributes passthrough, variant spinner|skeleton|progress, clamped progress. Simple and coherent.
fake_complexity: None, but progress fill uses glass-bg-primary which is undefined in the stylesheet (line 91) so the progress variant renders an empty track.
target: Canonical loading-state composition; absorb skeleton presets from GlassLoadingSkeleton
justification: Best-structured file in the loading cluster: a small forwardRef wrapper over OptimizedGlass with no hard-coded material. But two of its three variants are broken because the utility classes they depend on (glass-animate-spin, glass-bg-primary) do not exist, and it has no test and no certification screenshot, so nothing caught it. Fix the class contract, add an accessible name to the progressbar, add reduced-motion-aware spin, and make this the single loading-state entry point.

name: GlassMetricChip
material_impl: OptimizedGlass then fully overridden by a module-level inline style with hard-coded white gradient, slate border, shadows, and it force-overrides theme text tokens (--glass-text-primary etc.) to dark slate rgba (lines 7-18). That pins the chip to light mode; in dark theme it renders dark text on a translucent white pill.
motion: None.
a11y: intent conveyed only via aria-label on the value span (line 58); no visual intent styling at all - intent success/warning/danger renders identically. delta has no direction semantics. Each text span wrapped in its own ContrastGuard (3 per chip).
api: No forwardRef, no ...rest/style passthrough, only className. label/value required in type yet defaulted. intent naming (default/success/warning/danger) differs from GlassProgress (success/warning/error) and StatusDot (ok/warn/error).
fake_complexity: intent prop is cosmetic-only in the a11y layer; no visual difference.
target: GlassChip / GlassBadge with a 'metric' slot layout (label, value, delta)
justification: A pill with three text spans; its only distinguishing props (intent, delta) produce no visual change, and it hard-overrides theme text tokens so it cannot follow dark mode. Screenshot shows a small grey pill with faint text on white (content band min luminance near 231 on mobile). The library already has GlassChip, GlassBadge and three dashboard stat cards; this belongs as a GlassChip layout, not a separate component.

name: GlassMetricsGrid
material_impl: OptimizedGlass root and cards but each overridden with three hard-coded inline surface objects (metricsSurfaceStyle/metricsCardSurfaceStyle/metricsInsetSurfaceStyle, lines 116-144) that also force light-mode text tokens. Every card also adds glass-backdrop-blur-md + glass-surface-dark/40 classes that fight the inline white gradient (line 431). Nested glass-in-glass (root -> card -> search inset).
motion: Motion fadeIn root + slideUp per card with index*100ms stagger (lines 723-731) - with 12 metrics the last card waits 1.2s. Reduced motion respected via MotionPreferenceContext (lines 624-628, 725-729). Hover scale uses Tailwind hover:scale-[1.02] (no glass equivalent). Sound feedback via useGlassSound on click and on every auto-refresh tick (lines 193, 442).
a11y: Clickable cards get role=button + tabIndex=0 but no onKeyDown, so Enter/Space do nothing (lines 439-450). Non-clickable cards are still clickable via onMetricClick yet tabIndex=-1. Search input has no label (lines 649-659). Emoji used as icons/buttons ('🔍', '🔄 Refresh', '📊 Export', lines 661, 681, 698). Trend up and down both glass-text-primary - no color/shape distinction beyond arrow glyph (lines 325-326). Status colors all identical (lines 263-269).
api: forwardRef + className/style. Large prop surface where many props are ignored: layout.columns and layout.responsive are discarded in favour of auto-fit minmax (lines 590-598); status prop has no effect; searchQuery is only initial state (not controlled, line 185); exportable offers only JSON despite csv|json|png type (line 687); currency hard-coded USD/en-US (line 292); bytes format breaks on 0 (log(0) -> -Infinity, line 298).
ssr: use client; NodeJS.Timeout type; no module-scope DOM.
fake_complexity: Filtering/sort/search/export/auto-refresh are real but thin; 'priority' indicator uses Tailwind classes top-2 right-2 bg-current opacity-60 that are not in the glass stylesheet, so priority dots are mispositioned.
target: Compose from a single GlassStatCard + GlassSparkline inside a responsive grid layout primitive
justification: Kitchen-sink dashboard widget that re-implements stat card and sparkline instead of composing existing ones, ignores half its declared props, and has a keyboard-inoperable role=button. The screenshot shows only faint text with cards nearly invisible on a white canvas (component band saturation 0-2, card surfaces above luminance 225). A premium metrics surface needs real status color, tabular numerals, delta semantics and a composable card; rebuild on top of a consolidated stat card.

name: GlassNotificationCenter
material_impl: OptimizedGlass with inline hard-coded surface (rgba(255,255,255,0.30) + 0.62 white border, lines 18-24) overriding tokens. Duplicate local + module-level getTypeStyles (lines 172-196 and 435-459). Unicode glyphs for type icons ('✓ ✕ ⚠ ℹ') instead of the library icon set used by GlassToast.
motion: Motion wrapper per item with delay but the computed getMotionPreset() is never passed to Motion (lines 259-276) - the 'animation' prop is dead. Progress bar uses @keyframes shrink injected at MODULE SCOPE into document.head (lines 469-478). No reduced-motion handling for shrink.
a11y: Container aria-live=polite (good). Close buttons are icon-only '✕' with no aria-label (lines 335-341, 420-426). 'Clear All' is an OptimizedGlass div with onClick - not a button, not keyboard reachable (lines 234-252). Action buttons lack type=button.
api: forwardRef. autoHideDelay prop destructured but never used (line 151) - provider uses its own default. animation prop dead. Container positioning classes 'fixed z-50 top-4 right-4' are unprefixed Tailwind and have no CSS definition in the shipped stylesheet (verified: no '.fixed', '.top-4'), so in consumer apps the center renders in document flow, not as an overlay. GlassNotificationProvider puts data-glass-component on a Context.Provider (no-op, line 126). setState typed as any.
ssr: Module-scope document.createElement/appendChild side effect on import (lines 469-478), guarded by typeof document but still a side-effect import that breaks tree-shaking/sideEffects:false assumptions.
fake_complexity: animation presets and autoHideDelay advertised but inert.
target: One toast/notification system (GlassToastProvider + queue) with a notification-center list view
justification: Third independent toast/notification stack in the library (alongside data-display/GlassToast and feedback/GlassToast) with its own context, its own id generation and its own timers. Several advertised props do nothing, its overlay positioning depends on Tailwind classes the package does not ship, close controls are unlabeled, and Clear All is not a button. Merge into a single notifications engine; keep the 'center' as a list presentation over the same store.

name: CircularProgress
material_impl: Plain SVG; no glass at all. Uses Tailwind-style stroke-primary/stroke-success/stroke-destructive (lines 392-397) which have no CSS definition. Glow overlay uses glass-stroke-white-opacity-10 (undefined) and no stroke attribute.
motion: setTimeout to animate value; class string literally contains 'transition-all var(--glass-motion-duration-normal) var(...)' as class names (line 439) - not CSS. No reduced motion. Rotation class 'glass---rotate-90' (triple dash typo, line 410) is undefined, so the arc starts at 3 o'clock.
a11y: No role=progressbar, no aria-valuenow, no label.
api: forwardRef; size sm-xl.
fake_complexity: Indeterminate uses animate-spin on a circle element without transform-box, spinning around the SVG origin.
target: GlassProgressRing (own file, exported, with progressbar semantics)
justification: Internal, unexported and visibly broken (wrong start angle, colorless strokes, class names that are actually CSS values). Either rebuild as a proper exported ring or delete; a premium system needs a ring, so rebuild.

name: GlassProgress
tests: src/components/data-display/GlassProgress.test.tsx (129 lines, includes reduced-motion and fill-vs-track contrast tests)
material_impl: Track is OptimizedGlass overridden inline with hard-coded white gradient + slate border (lines 241-248). Fill uses --glass-theme-text-secondary as its color (lines 163-170) - a text token as a fill, so every variant is the same grey. variantClasses map is entirely empty strings (lines 154-161): success/warning/error/gradient/primary are no-ops. Classes glass-sheen, glass-bg-stripes, bg-stripes, animate-progress-indeterminate have no CSS definition, so striped and indeterminate do not render as designed. shape value 'glass-radius-md' is a find/replace artifact leaking into the public type (line 41).
motion: Width transition with configurable duration; reduced motion via MotionPreferenceContext (lines 113-117). useEffect deps omit shouldAnimate (line 134). Indeterminate = full-width bar with animate-pulse (pulse class exists only in storybook-utility-shim).
a11y: role=progressbar with valuenow/min/max and aria-label (lines 249-254). Top label renders {label} not labelContent, so showValue without label produces an empty left span (line 220). aria-describedby points to a label id that does not exist when labelPosition=inline (line 254). Inline label uses mix-blend-difference inside ContrastGuard - unpredictable contrast.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes. Both 'data-testid' and camelCase dataTestId props (lines 78-81) - test plumbing in public API. Variant names inconsistent with siblings.
ssr: use client; mounted gate avoids hydration jump.
fake_complexity: Six variants that are visually identical; 'gradient' has no gradient; 'striped' has no stripe CSS.
target: GlassProgress (linear) with real intent tokens; split circular/steps into own files
justification: Progress is a core primitive, so it stays, but the current implementation has no working variants, no working stripes/indeterminate, and a leaked 'glass-radius-md' enum. The certification screenshot shows a light grey line on white (component band min luminance 240 on desktop), i.e. the fill is barely distinguishable. Rebuild around intent tokens, a proper indeterminate keyframe with reduced-motion fallback, and a liquid-glass track.

name: StepProgress
material_impl: No glass. Mix of glass-* and shadcn/Tailwind tokens (bg-primary, bg-background, bg-muted, ring-2 ring-primary/20, bg-primary-foreground) (lines 595-631). Completed and current both 'bg-primary ... glass-text-primary' so the check icon is same-color-on-same-color.
motion: Dynamic Tailwind class 'duration-[${ms}ms]' built at runtime (line 592) - cannot be generated by any JIT; inert.
a11y: Clickable step indicator is a div with onClick, no role/tabIndex/keyboard (lines 589-606). No aria-current on current step. No list semantics.
api: Function component, no forwardRef.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassWizard / stepper component
justification: Unexported, unstoried, inaccessible duplicate of the wizard step indicators that relies on a different design system's tokens. Delete and point to the canonical stepper.

name: GlassSchemaViewer
material_impl: None of its own; delegates entirely to GlassJSONViewer with an extra className (lines 21-29).
motion: Inherited.
a11y: Inherited from GlassJSONViewer.
api: No forwardRef, no rest props; renames value->schema. No schema-aware features (types, required, descriptions).
fake_complexity: Name implies a JSON-Schema viewer; it is an alias of the JSON tree viewer with zero schema semantics.
target: GlassJSONViewer
justification: A 32-line rename wrapper that inflates the component count without adding behavior and misleads by name. Deprecate in favour of GlassJSONViewer; if a real schema viewer is wanted, build it with property/type/required columns.

name: GlassSkeleton
material_impl: OptimizedGlass per bone (performanceMode low) but overridden with hard-coded rgba border + three-layer box-shadow (lines 54-66). Each bone is a full glass surface with shadow - heavier than a placeholder needs. Variant enum contains 'glass-radius-md' (find/replace artifact, line 15) as a public value.
motion: Injects a <style> keyframes tag on EVERY instance render (lines 144, 189). Applies both Tailwind 'animate-pulse' class and an inline skeleton-pulse animation (lines 170, 176, 204, 210) - double animation. 'wave' translates the entire bone off-screen (-100% to 100%) rather than sweeping a highlight (lines 44-51, 127-134) - visibly wrong. No reduced-motion handling at all.
a11y: No role, no aria-hidden, no aria-busy; consumer must wrap. Fine for a bone primitive but should be aria-hidden.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes. Avatar/Button/Card/Table/List helpers; Card/Table/List re-exported from data-display index as *Compact to dodge name collisions with GlassSkeletonLoader. Helpers lack forwardRef. 'width' handled as Array in code though typed string|number (line 147).
ssr: use client; inline <style> per instance duplicates CSS in SSR output.
fake_complexity: 'wave' animation is broken by design.
target: Canonical GlassSkeleton (bone primitive) - keep this name, absorb the other two
justification: Has the right shape for the canonical bone primitive (forwardRef, shape variants, 8 stories) but ships a broken wave, double pulse, per-instance style injection, no reduced motion, and a leaked enum value. The certification crop shows only the story headings; the bones themselves sit above luminance 215 on white and do not register. Make this the single skeleton primitive with a CSS-defined shimmer, aria-hidden bones, and reduced-motion fallback; delete the other two implementations.
evidence: reports/glassmorphism-storybook-visual-certification/screenshots/components-data-display-glassskeleton/desktop.png: only text labels exceed contrast threshold

name: GlassSkeletonLoader
material_impl: OptimizedGlass overridden with --glass-neutral-level2-surface + hard-coded rgba border/shadow (lines 161-169, 193-203). 'shimmer' and 'wave' set background to a flat surface var then animate background-position - no gradient means nothing visible moves (lines 116-133). Sheen overlay is the same flat surface color blurred, so invisible (lines 174-189). glass-depth-pulse keyframe animates box-shadow from X to X (lines 74-77) - a no-op.
motion: Uses useAccessibleAnimation for the main loader (line 94) - reduced motion honored there. GlassSkeletonText and GlassSkeletonCard hard-code 'glass-pulse 2s infinite' and ignore shouldAnimate (lines 256-275, 289) - reduced motion NOT honored. The glass-pulse keyframe is only injected by GlassSkeletonLoader's <style>, so standalone GlassSkeletonText/Card reference an undefined keyframe.
a11y: No role=status / aria-busy; aria-label on a generic div (line 158) is ignored by AT. This 'loader' is a pulsing circle + text, i.e. a spinner, not a skeleton.
api: React.FC wrapped in memo, no forwardRef, no rest props. loading/children toggle pattern. Exports GlassSkeletonText/GlassSkeletonCard which win the root export name over GlassSkeleton.tsx and GlassLoadingSkeleton.tsx versions (src/index.ts:347-351). Unused imports ContrastGuard/TextWithContrast/ANIMATION/useReducedMotion. Error boundary wrapping a placeholder.
ssr: mounted gate means children never render on the server even when loading=false (line 101) - SSR content flash.
fake_complexity: Four animation variants of which shimmer/wave/sheen produce no visible effect.
target: GlassLoadingState (spinner) + GlassSkeleton (bones)
justification: Misnamed spinner whose advertised variants are no-ops, whose compound helpers break reduced motion and depend on keyframes injected by a sibling, and whose exported names shadow the other skeleton implementations at the package root. It blocks server rendering of children. Nothing here is worth keeping beyond what GlassLoadingState and GlassSkeleton already cover.

name: GlassSparkline
material_impl: Plain SVG path, no glass. Hard-coded default stroke '#70d6ff' (line 44) - not a token, low contrast on light backgrounds.
motion: None. Imports useReducedMotion/ANIMATION but never uses them (lines 8-9).
a11y: No role=img, no <title>, no aria-label/aria-hidden; decorative-or-informative is undecided. Default data [0,0] renders a flat line instead of nothing.
api: Function component, no forwardRef; spreads SVG attributes (good). compact/contained are aliases for the same thing (lines 17-26). No area fill gradient, no min/max/last-point markers, no smoothing.
fake_complexity: None - honest but minimal.
justification: Small, deterministic, SSR-safe and genuinely useful; it should be the one sparkline that GlassMetricsGrid and stat cards compose. Needs a tokenized stroke, optional area gradient and endpoint dot, forwardRef, and an accessible name or aria-hidden contract. Screenshot shows a thin light line (band min luminance 202) - readable but not premium.

name: GlassStatusDot
material_impl: Bare span with Tailwind palette classes bg-emerald-400/bg-amber-400/bg-red-400/bg-blue-400/bg-slate-400 (lines 22-31). Only bg-red-400 and bg-blue-400 exist (in storybook-utility-shim.css); emerald, amber and slate are not defined anywhere in src/styles or dist, so status ok (the default), warn and offline render as a transparent, invisible dot in consumer apps. No tokens.
motion: None; imports useReducedMotion/ANIMATION unused (lines 8-9). No 'busy' pulse despite the status name.
a11y: No role, no aria-label, no text alternative - status is conveyed by color only (WCAG 1.4.1 failure). Unused ContrastGuard imports.
api: No forwardRef, no rest props, size as raw number. Status naming ok/warn/error/busy/offline differs from every other intent enum in the library.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassBadge dot variant or a tokenized GlassStatusIndicator
justification: The default status renders invisible outside Storybook because its color class is not shipped, and it has no non-color affordance or accessible label. A status dot is trivial to do right (intent tokens, optional pulse for busy with reduced-motion fallback, sr-only label); rebuild it as part of the badge/status family.

name: GlassTimeline
material_impl: OptimizedGlass cards overridden with a very faint hard-coded white gradient (0.105 -> 0.018 alpha) and 0.18 white border (lines 12-20) - on light backgrounds the card edge is essentially invisible. Line/dot colors hard-coded rgba (lines 196, 215-216, 293, 312-313). Layout CSS injected via <style> per instance (lines 22-34, 395).
motion: None.
a11y: Vertical: proper ul/li (good) but root div has aria-label without a role (ignored, line 286). Horizontal: role=list/listitem on divs. item.onClick and item.disabled are declared in TimelineItem but never wired (lines 66-72) - no interactive items. ContrastGuard wraps every text node.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes. timePosition 'left' declared but not implemented (lines 99, 365-389). Horizontal mode uses unprefixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 max-w-xs (undefined in stylesheet) so dots are mispositioned (line 208, 231). sizeClasses.container/line are empty strings. TimelineItemComponent is a stub with a comment 'Implementation would mirror...' (lines 423-462). data-testid only on vertical root.
ssr: Safe; inline style tag duplicated per instance.
fake_complexity: TimelineItemComponent is a placeholder; interactive items advertised in types only.
justification: Vertical mode is structurally sound (ul/li, responsive padding, min-width guards) and the screenshot shows three readable rows with title/subtitle/time, but cards are near-invisible on white (band min luminance ~200), horizontal mode depends on undefined Tailwind classes, and several advertised props are unimplemented. Worth polishing: tokenized card surface, working horizontal layout, wire onClick/disabled, delete the stub subcomponent.

name: GlassToast (+ GlassToastProvider, GlassToastViewport, useToast)
tests: src/components/data-display/GlassToast.test.tsx (191 lines, includes caller-owned live region test)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level4/strong then overridden with near-transparent hard-coded white gradient (0.105->0.018) and 0.18 border (lines 23-33). On light backgrounds the toast is a faint outline; screenshot confirms (component band min luminance 156 desktop, saturation 0). All four types use the same secondary text color for icon and progress (lines 179-204, 244, 251) - success/error/warning are visually indistinguishable.
motion: Motion slideRight preset; no reduced-motion check in this file (useMotionPreferenceContext imported, unused, line 16). Progress interval ticks every ANIMATION.DURATION.fast/3 = 50ms but decrements assuming 100ms ticks (lines 157-166), so the toast self-dismisses at ~50% of duration. handleDismiss is called from inside a setState updater (side effect in reducer, line 161). Provider also schedules its own removal setTimeout (lines 321-325) - two competing timers; hover-pause only pauses the inner one.
a11y: Toast has no role=status/alert and the viewport is not a live region - screen readers are not notified by default (contrast: feedback/GlassToast.tsx:211-212 has role=status). Close button 44x44 with aria-label (good). Hotkey Alt+T focuses [data-toast-id] wrappers which are not focusable (no tabIndex, lines 378-382, 409-413). Success icon has aria-label but others don't.
api: GlassToast is React.FC (no forwardRef). Viewport positioning uses unprefixed 'fixed', 'top-4 right-4', 'left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2', 'pointer-events-none' (lines 390-405) - none are defined in the shipped stylesheet (verified), so the viewport renders inline at the end of the provider's children instead of floating. useToast silently returns a no-op context outside a provider (lines 112-122) - toasts vanish without error. Dynamic class glass-duration-[${ms}ms] (line 283) is inert. GlassToastAction/useToastActions not root-exported.
ssr: use client; document access only in effects. OK.
fake_complexity: Pause-on-hover and progress bar are present but timing math is wrong and provider timer ignores pause.
target: Single GlassToast system (merge data-display/GlassToast, feedback/GlassToast, GlassNotificationCenter)
justification: Toasts are a high-visibility surface and a natural Liquid Glass showcase, but this implementation does not float (positioning classes not shipped), dismisses at half the requested duration, runs two competing timers, announces nothing to assistive tech, and makes all types look identical. The feedback/ copy is the better-colored starting point (certification shows saturation 28 vs 0). Rebuild one toast engine with a proper queue, role=status/alert by type, reduced-motion, intent tokens and a real lensing material - then make it a flagship.

name: GlassToastProvider (re-export module)
material_impl: N/A - pure re-export of GlassToastProvider/GlassToastViewport/useToast from ./GlassToast.
motion: N/A
a11y: N/A (see GlassToast).
api: Barrel file that exists only so there is a separate story/entry; same symbols also reachable via GlassToast.
fake_complexity: Counts as a 'component' in inventories while containing no code.
target: GlassToast module
justification: Nine-line re-export. Keep the public symbol names but remove the file as a separately counted component once the toast system is unified.

name: GlassTreeView
material_impl: Root OptimizedGlass with bespoke inline backdropFilter 'blur(24px) saturate(1.5) brightness(1.05) contrast(1.02)' + hard-coded rgba background/border/shadow (lines 680-691), bypassing the primitive's own blur. Every node is ANOTHER OptimizedGlass card with hard-coded inline background/border/two-layer shadow and 8px margin (lines 372-404) - a tree rendered as a stack of glass cards, glass-in-glass, one backdrop surface per row. Variant classes rely on glass-surface-primary/15 etc. that are then overridden by inline background.
motion: Motion slideIn per node with delay level*50 and slideDown on children; reduced motion via useMotionPreference hook (a different hook than siblings, line 13). Sound on select/expand/check via useGlassSound.
a11y: role=tree/treeitem with aria-level/expanded/selected (good start) but NO keyboard handling at all - no arrow navigation, no Enter/Space to select, no roving tabindex: every node is tabIndex=0 plus its expand button is tabbable (lines 417, 443-456). Children not wrapped in role=group. Checkbox unlabeled (lines 463-475). Expand button lacks type=button. Interactive button nested inside treeitem.
api: forwardRef. Single selection is controlled-only: no internal selectedId state, so clicking a node in uncontrolled usage does nothing visible (lines 574-578, 642-643). handleNodeCheck looks up only top-level nodes via data.find, passing undefined for nested nodes (line 637). onDrop receives a fake {id} node (lines 298-305, comment 'simplified version'). showLines connectors use absolute children without a positioned parent offset (lines 420-435). Ships DEFAULT_TREE_DATA demo content as a default prop (lines 26-47).
fake_complexity: Drag-and-drop reorder advertised; drop callback gets a stub node and no tree mutation or keyboard alternative exists.
target: One tree primitive (merge with tree-view/TreeView, back GlassFileTree and GlassTreeSelect)
justification: Two root-exported trees (GlassTreeView and TreeView) plus GlassFileTree and GlassTreeSelect each implement their own tree. This one looks like a card list rather than a tree, puts a backdrop-filter surface on every row, lacks WAI-ARIA tree keyboard support, and has broken uncontrolled single-select and nested check handling. Consolidate into one headless tree with roving focus and a flat row material; reuse it across file tree and tree select.

name: GlassVirtualTable
material_impl: None; delegates to GlassDataTable with rows->data rename (line 25).
motion: Inherited.
a11y: Inherited.
api: Adds unused 'children' and 'disabled' props (lines 15-16) that are spread into GlassDataTable. No virtualization props (rowHeight, overscan).
fake_complexity: Named 'Virtual' but explicitly not virtualized: comment 'In a future iteration this can swap to an actual virtualized list implementation' (line 22). Large datasets render every row.
target: GlassDataTable (add a real virtualize option) / GlassDataGridPro
justification: A name that promises performance it does not deliver; consumers choosing it for large datasets will get full DOM rendering. Deprecate and add genuine windowing (e.g., virtualize prop backed by GlassVirtualList logic) to the canonical data table.

name: LiquidGlassBadgeCluster
material_impl: Shared Liquid Glass primitives: LiquidGlassMaterial (material standard, variant regular|clear, radius full) + LiquidGlassEffectGroup (lines 53-78) - the intended v5 material path. But refraction, reflection, parallax and sheen are all explicitly disabled (lines 57-63), and --glass-theme-text is hard-coded to dark slate (line 72), pinning light mode. Badge fills are hard-coded rgba white (lines 88-90).
motion: None of its own; expand/collapse is instant. Reduced-motion n/a.
a11y: aria-pressed on non-interactive <span>s (line 82) - invalid ARIA (aria-pressed requires role=button). The '+N' toggle has no aria-expanded and no accessible label beyond '+3' (lines 98-105). selectionMode only sets a data attribute (line 69) - no selection behavior.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes. expanded is controlled-only with no internal state, so '+N' does nothing unless the parent wires onExpandedChange (lines 40-41, 102). No onSelectionChange. Item disabled is unused.
fake_complexity: selectionMode single/multiple advertised; no selection logic exists.
target: Liquid Glass chip group (toggle group semantics) built on LiquidGlassMaterial
justification: One of the few components on the real LiquidGlassMaterial/EffectGroup path, which is the right direction, but it disables every liquid effect, fakes selection, uses invalid ARIA and does nothing when uncontrolled. Rebuild as a proper chip/toggle group (role=group + buttons with aria-pressed, roving focus, uncontrolled expanded state) and let the material actually refract.

name: LiquidGlassCarouselRail
material_impl: Uses LiquidGlassScrollEdge primitive for soft edge fades (lines 48-52, 65-69) - good shared-primitive usage. Scroll buttons are bespoke: inline backdropFilter 'blur(16px) saturate(1.4) brightness(1.05) contrast(1.04)' + hard-coded rgba border/background/shadow and 'font: 600 24px system-ui' (lines 7-23) instead of GlassButton/LiquidGlassMaterial.
motion: scrollBy behavior 'smooth' unconditionally (line 37) - ignores prefers-reduced-motion. Fixed 240px step regardless of item width.
a11y: Buttons have type=button and aria-label (good). 36x36 buttons are below 44px touch target (lines 8-9). Glyphs '‹ ›' as text. Scroller is not focusable/labelled (no tabIndex, no role=region/aria-label) so keyboard users cannot scroll content that has no focusable children. Buttons never disable at scroll ends. Items rendered with index keys.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes; items array or children. Minimal and coherent.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: Small, honest component that correctly uses the LiquidGlassScrollEdge primitive and is distinct enough from the full GlassCarousel (a rail, not a paged carousel) to keep. Needs GlassButton/LiquidGlass for the controls, 44px targets, reduced-motion-aware scrolling, end-state disabling, a focusable labelled scroller, and real tests and a certification screenshot.

name: Typography
category: typography / foundation (miscategorized under data-display; Storybook title 'Data + Visualization/Typography')

stories.notes:
Default story has no children (renders an empty

); 'Variants' renders one 'Default' string and never sets variant. No variant/argTypes control for variant. Description is boilerplate 'A glass morphism typography component.'

tests.notes:
Generated template: smoke, axe on empty

, className passthrough, snapshot. Does not test variant->tag mapping, size classes, or ref forwarding. Imports userEvent unused.

material_impl: No material. Pure text: applies utility classes glass-text-primary + glass-text-{5xl,4xl,3xl,xl,lg,base}. glass-text-primary is defined three times (src/styles/glass.css:1628, src/styles/glass.css:1894, src/styles/typography.css:75) with !important and differing fallbacks (--glass-text-primary vs --typography-text-primary), so final color depends on CSS load order. Font sizes are tokenized via --glass-font-size-*. No line-height, weight, letter-spacing, or font-family per heading level - h1 is just bigger body text, no display/heading type ramp.
motion: None. useReducedMotion and ANIMATION are imported but never used (dead imports, lines 8-9).
a11y: Semantic tags via variant (h1-h6/p/span/div) - correct. But visual size is hard-coupled to semantic level (no way to render an h2 styled as h4), which pushes consumers to pick wrong heading levels for looks. ContrastGuard/TextWithContrast imported (lines 5-7) but unused; comment line 30 claims contrast coverage is 'tracked in the manual accessibility QA report' - i.e. no runtime contrast handling. Color via !important utility can override contrast-safe consumer styles.
api: forwardRef<HTMLElement> + className + ...rest passthrough (style works). 'variant' conflates element and visual scale; no 'as'/asChild, no size/weight/tone/align/truncate props, no muted/secondary tone. sizeClass record is re-created every render inside the component. Weakly typed ref (HTMLElement for all tags).
ssr: 'use client' directive is unnecessary (no hooks/state used); it forces a client boundary on a pure presentational text primitive, blocking RSC usage. Imports ContrastGuard module (client component) for nothing - extra bundle weight. No window/document access.
fake_complexity: Mild: imports of ContrastGuard, TextWithContrast, ANIMATION, useReducedMotion suggest contrast-aware and motion-aware text but none are used. Otherwise it is an honest 10-line tag mapper.
duplicates: src/styles/typography.css and src/styles/premium-typography.css (CSS-level type ramp that this component does not use)

CardTitle x3 (src/components/card/index.ts:12, src/components/card/GlassCard.tsx:387, src/components/card/div.tsx:28), DialogTitle, DrawerTitle, ChartTitle - each rolls own heading styles instead of a shared Text/Heading primitive
screenshot_review: desktop.png (1440x900) and mobile.png (390x844): pixel sampling finds only pure black and white - effectively a blank page. Certification JSON inspection records textLength 52 = only 'Skip to main content/Skip to navigation/Skip to footer' skip-link text, i.e. the component rendered nothing visible (empty Default story), yet issuesFound is []. The certification passed a blank screenshot.
target: New foundation Text + Heading primitives (src/components/typography/) with as/asChild, separate level vs size, tone (primary/secondary/muted/inverse), weight, tracking, truncate/balance, a real tokenized type ramp (display/title/body/caption with line-height and letter-spacing), server-safe (no 'use client'); fold DisplayText and the CardTitle/DialogTitle/DrawerTitle/ChartTitle styles onto it; keep Typography as a deprecated alias.
justification: Typography is not exported from src/index.ts, so it is an internal helper used only by the cookie-consent components and GlassThemeDemo. It maps a variant name to a tag and adds a font-size class. It has no type ramp (line-height, weight, tracking, family), it ties visual scale to heading level, it has no tone or as-prop, and it marks itself 'use client' for no reason while importing ContrastGuard and motion modules it never uses. The story renders an empty element and the certification screenshot is a blank black/white page that still passed. A premium design system needs a strong first-party Text/Heading foundation that every title, card, and dialog shares. This component is not that, and its name blocks the right primitive from being built in its place. Replace it with a proper server-safe Text/Heading pair and keep this as a deprecated alias.

name: GlassProductRecommendations
material_impl: Outer Glass primitive (shared). Cards use glass-surface-subtle/border utilities. Reason chips use raw Tailwind palette (bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-200 etc.). The overlay is bg-black bg-opacity-50 (Tailwind v2 syntax). The 'AI' badge uses inline colour #334155 on a dark glass surface, and the fallback artwork uses hard-coded light-slate hex.
motion: CSS hover scale on images and a carousel translateX transition; no reduced-motion gating; no framer.
a11y: The card wrapper is a clickable div with no role or keyboard support. Quick actions sit in an opacity-0 hover overlay that stays focusable and clickable while invisible, and is unreachable visually on touch. Emoji-only buttons (heart, cart) rely on title only. Carousel arrows (arrows as text) have no aria-label and no live region. The star rating has no text alternative.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no style. getItemsPerView is a hard-coded 4/8 regardless of viewport, and the carousel grid is glass-grid-cols-4 on mobile. Currency is hard-coded '$'. getReasonColor/getReasonIcon are duplicated in the card and the parent.
fake_complexity: Severe: when products are passed explicitly it fabricates reason ('personalized' for index 0, 'similar' for 1, then 'trending'), score and confidence, and labels them 'Match confidence'. The 'AI Insights' copy claims 'personalized based on your browsing history... Our AI analyzes N factors', where N is just the list length.
target: if commerce is in scope: rebuild as presentational GlassProductCard + LiquidGlassCarouselRail
justification: It invents recommendation reasons and confidence percentages for caller-supplied data and presents them as AI output, which is a trust and legal liability for any adopter. It is also emoji-iconed, not keyboard accessible, and a fixed 4-column carousel on mobile. Remove it. A future commerce kit should be a controlled product card composed with the existing carousel rail.

name: GlassSmartShoppingCart
material_impl: Glass primitive outer (shared). Interior uses border utilities, raw border-blue-400/60 bg-blue-500/15 for the selected shipping option, and an inline #334155 empty-state icon (low contrast on dark glass).
motion: None beyond colour transitions.
a11y: The close (multiplication sign) and remove buttons rely on title only, with no aria-label. The quantity +/- buttons have no labels and no live region; the quantity shows '...' during a fake delay. The promo input has no label (placeholder only). The 'Remove' promo button has no handler. The radio group has no fieldset/legend.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no style. The items prop makes it display-only: quantity/remove/save call the context's no-op updaters, so the controlled mode is broken (UI quantity changes locally, totals do not). showRecommendations is declared and never used. Hard-coded USD, 8% tax, and a $50 free-shipping rule.
fake_complexity: Severe: nothing 'smart'. Fake 300ms 'API delay' on quantity change and a 1s fake promo validation. Valid promo codes SAVE10/WELCOME20/FREESHIP are hard-coded in the shipped library (anyone can apply discounts client-side). It renders the claim 'Secure checkout with 256-bit SSL encryption' regardless of the host app.
target: if commerce is in scope: rebuild as controlled GlassCartSummary + GlassQuantityStepper
justification: It hard-codes discount codes, tax, currency and a security claim into a UI library. Its controlled mode silently does nothing, its icon buttons are unlabeled, and it simulates network latency with setTimeout. None of this is salvageable as a design-system component. Remove it, and if needed provide a controlled cart summary and quantity stepper that hold no business logic.

name: GlassRichTextEditor
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell (shared primitive, elevation prop). The toolbar and every tool button carry bespoke inline rgba gradients, borders and box-shadows plus an injected <style> with !important hover rules. These are not tokens and assume a light surface (hover rgba(255,255,255,0.36)).
motion: CSS translateY hover with a prefers-reduced-motion override (wired).
a11y: role=toolbar with aria-label; tool buttons have aria-label; the editable has role=textbox, aria-multiline, and a hard-coded aria-label 'Rich text editor' that cannot be overridden (rest props go to the outer shell, not the textbox). No aria-pressed/active state for B/I/U. No roving tabindex in the toolbar. The link tool uses window.prompt().
api: forwardRef to outer shell. Controlled-only in practice: in uncontrolled use, `!value` stays true, so the placeholder overlays typed content whenever the editor blurs. No sanitisation hook. No name/form integration.
ssr: 'use client'; document.execCommand / prompt only in handlers.
fake_complexity: None, but it is built on deprecated document.execCommand.
target: headless editor (Tiptap/Lexical) adapter wrapped in OptimizedGlass + shared LiquidGlassToolbar
justification: Writing the value prop straight into innerHTML with no sanitisation is a stored-XSS vector, and createLink accepts javascript: URLs from prompt(). It relies on deprecated execCommand, has no active-state feedback, and its placeholder overlaps typed text in uncontrolled mode. The glass shell is fine. Keep the visual wrapper and replace the engine with a maintained headless editor, using the library's LiquidGlassToolbar for the controls.

name: AuroraPro
material_impl: The r3f implementation uses three.js ShaderMaterial waves and points plus bespoke overlay chips (glass-surface-dark). The wrapper fallback is a plain div. Palettes are hard-coded Material-colour hex values; the 'custom' default passes CSS var strings into THREE.Color, which three cannot parse.
motion: useFrame loop, never gated by reduced motion. The overlay chips use initial opacity 0 + animate {} under reduced motion, so they stay invisible. particleDrift adds sin() to the already-mutated x every frame (random walk drift; particles wander off).
a11y: Control buttons are title-only (no aria-label/aria-pressed). The palette buttons do nothing ('Would update colorPalette prop'). The canvas has no aria-hidden.
api: Exported only via the 'aura-glass/three' subpath. No forwardRef/style. The fallback spreads all effect props (intensity, speed, colorPalette...) onto a DOM div, causing React unknown-prop warnings.
ssr: The wrapper lazy-imports the r3f chunk in an effect (good pattern). But the gate assertReact19ForThree checks React.__SECRET_INTERNALS_DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED for key 'S'. In React 18 (installed 18.2.0) that object has no 'S', and React 19 removed that export altogether. The check can never pass, so the R3F path is dead code: certification shows hasCanvas=false.
fake_complexity: Total: the shipped component always renders an empty div. If the R3F path ever ran, the fragment shader contains the JS line `const prefersReducedMotion = useReducedMotion();` inside the GLSL noise() function and would fail to compile. getPaletteColors calls a hook inside a nested function invoked a variable number of times (Rules of Hooks violation). Geometries and materials are never disposed.
target: marketing/AuroraBackground (CSS/GPU-cheap) as the single aurora
justification: This is a broken R3F demo hidden behind a version gate that can never succeed, so users get an empty div. Even unlocked, the shader would not compile because a React hook call is pasted into GLSL, the hooks usage violates React rules, and it leaks GPU resources. The story text even admits the fallback. Three other aurora components already exist; delete this one and the 'three' subpath entry.

name: Glass3DEngine
material_impl: Bespoke: inline hsla holographic gradients per layer, mixBlendMode multiply/overlay, conic-gradient overlay, CSS blur filters per layer and per SVG circle, and an feTurbulence/feDisplacementMap filter per layer. A comment says 'Use createGlassStyle() instead', but the code does not. No tokens except var(--glass-bg-default).
motion: framer springs for tilt, useScroll parallax, autoDemo infinite loops. shouldAnimate gates autoDemo/holographic, but mouse tilt springs, whileHover, whileTap and scroll translateZ are NOT gated, and the .interaction-pulse CSS animation is infinite and ungated.
a11y: Purely pointer-driven. Click does nothing for keyboard users. Decorative layers are not aria-hidden. Children are the only content.
api: React.FC; Glass3DEngineProps not exported; no forwardRef; no style/rest passthrough; template className. 'gaze'/'proximity' interactions are declared but unimplemented; refractionIndex is unused. Sub-variants (ParallaxGlass, DepthGlass, HolographicGlass, InteractiveGlass3D) are not exported from root.
ssr: 'use client'; useScroll at module-level hook is fine.
fake_complexity: High: 'Immersive 3D Glass Effects Engine' is CSS translateZ plus gradients. 'refraction' is unused. DistortionMesh and DepthOfFieldLayer are components declared inside render, so they get a new identity every render: every mouse move remounts all of them and their SVG filters. Each also has a conditional early return before useMemo (Rules of Hooks). Default config produces 8 meshes x 81 blurred circles plus 8 turbulence filters. SVG filter ids collide across instances.
target: surfaces/GlassDepthLayer + a single useTilt hook
justification: Component-in-render remounting on every mousemove, around 650 blurred SVG nodes, conditional hooks, colliding filter ids and ungated tilt make this a performance and a11y liability. Its 'engine' claims (refraction, gaze, proximity) are not implemented. Pointer tilt and depth layering already exist elsewhere. Remove it and offer a single cheap useTilt hook and depth primitive.

name: GlassMorphingEngine
material_impl: Bespoke: seven stacked .glass-layer divs in glass-morphing.css driven by --gm-* CSS variables (rgba white gradients, conic crystalline, caustic shimmer). Ten framer springs write CSS variables imperatively (a good technique, poor payload). Not built on OptimizedGlass or LiquidGlassMaterial.
motion: Springs plus a CSS caustic-shimmer infinite animation. useReducedMotion is called but its result is never used, and glass-morphing.css has no prefers-reduced-motion block, so the infinite shimmer is always on.
a11y: Decorative layers are not aria-hidden; otherwise transparent wrapper.
api: React.FC; props interface not exported; no forwardRef; className/style supported. enableRealTimeAdaptation defaults to true, and the mocked 'real-time' data is spread AFTER the caller's environmentalContext. Any timeOfDay/weather/season the caller passes is therefore overwritten by the clock and the hard-coded 'sunny'. The default environmentalContext={} is a new object every render, so the effect runs every render. A test-env branch checks process.env.JEST_WORKER_ID in production code.
fake_complexity: Self-declared '@demo ... uses in-component mock data'. fetchEnvironmentalData returns weather 'sunny', 22C, 45% humidity, 75% light, all constants. 'refraction', 'viscosity' and 'temperature' map only to white-gradient alpha.
duplicates: src/components/advanced/GlassEngine.tsx (EnvironmentalGlass/AdaptiveGlass; name collision with this file's EnvironmentalGlass)
target: primitives/LiquidGlassMaterial (expose tunable CSS vars instead)
justification: It is a self-declared demo that, by default, ignores the context props it advertises, runs an ungated infinite shimmer, and ships Jest-detection branches in production code. The CSS-variable-driven spring pipeline is the only reusable idea, and that belongs in LiquidGlassMaterial as documented tunables, not in an 'environmental engine' with fake weather.

name: GlassPhysicsEngine
material_impl: No material; canvas 2D particles with random hsl(180-240) colours, shadowBlur 10 and mixBlendMode screen, plus a radial-gradient pulse overlay.
motion: framer keyframes for bend/melt/vibrate, plus a canvas particle loop. triggerInteraction is gated by shouldAnimate, but mouse tilt (rotateX/rotateY springs) is NOT gated. The animate-pulse overlay is ungated.
a11y: Effects are click-only; there is no keyboard trigger. The tabIndex passthrough exists only so it can be removed. The canvas is not aria-hidden.
api: React.FC; props interface not exported; no forwardRef/style. Six alias components (ShatterGlass, RippleGlass...) are not root-exported.
ssr: 'use client'; window resize in effect only.
fake_complexity: High: the 'Physics simulation' is Euler particles stepped through React setState every frame. The updater mutates particle objects in place (impure, so StrictMode double-invocation doubles the physics). getBoundingClientRect is called per particle per frame (layout thrash). renderParticles draws the stale `particles` closure, one frame behind. physicsConfig is a new object every render, which recreates animate and restarts the rAF effect on every render. The canvas is not DPR-scaled (blurry on retina). viscosity/refractionIndex/density are unused.
target: visual-feedback/RippleButton (press feedback) as the supported interaction effect
justification: A 60fps React-state particle loop with impure updaters, per-particle layout reads and an rAF restart on each render is not shippable, and cyan sparks with screen blending do not read as premium glass. Press-ripple feedback already exists in RippleButton. Remove it, or at most reimplement a single GPU-cheap press highlight inside the material primitive.
