name: GlassShatterEffects
material_impl: r3f ShaderMaterial shards (fresnel tint). Fallback is a plain div. Controls use glass-surface-subtle utilities.
motion: Custom Date.now() lerp animations in useFrame; no reduced-motion gating of shatter/explosion; overlays invisible under reduced motion (animate {}).
a11y: Trigger is a native addEventListener click on a div, so it is not keyboard operable. The control button is title-only. On shatter, children fade to opacity 0 but stay in the a11y tree.
api: Exported only via the 'aura-glass/three' subpath. No forwardRef. The fallback spreads non-DOM props (duration, intensity, onShatter...) onto a div.
ssr: Lazy import behind assertReact19ForThree, which never returns true (see AuroraPro), so the R3F path never loads: certification hasCanvas=false.
fake_complexity: Total and doubly broken: (1) Shards are generated in a mount effect guarded by `if (!canvasRef.current) return`, but the Canvas only mounts after isShattered, so the shard list is always empty. (2) createExplosionAnimation calls useReducedMotion() inside a plain function invoked from a click handler, which throws 'Invalid hook call' on the first shatter. (3) Reform never resets isShattered (`if (!isShattered) setIsShattered(false)`), and the autoReform setTimeout captures a stale triggerReform, so content stays at opacity 0 permanently.
justification: Even if the dead version gate were fixed, the effect would crash on the first click (hook call outside render), render zero shards, and leave the wrapped content permanently invisible. Tests only assert that the fallback div renders. Shattering glass is also off-brand for a calm premium material system. Remove it along with the three subpath export.

name: SeasonalParticles
material_impl: r3f MeshPhong/MeshBasic meshes (cones for snow, planes for leaves/petals, yellow cylinders for 'summer'). Season chips use raw Tailwind palette (text-blue-400, pink-400...). Fallback is a plain div.
motion: useFrame loop, never gated by reduced motion; overlay chips stuck at opacity 0 under reduced motion; infinite wind-icon wiggle.
a11y: Season/play buttons are title-only. The canvas is not aria-hidden.
api: Exported only via the 'aura-glass/three' subpath. The `seasons` array is recreated each render and used as an effect dependency, so the interval is re-created every render. An inline onSeasonChange in deps rebuilds all particles on every parent render. setCurrentSeason is called inside the setSeasonIndex updater (side effect in updater). Math.random in the reset breaks the seed contract. createRainMaterial/rainFall are unused.
ssr: Same dead assertReact19ForThree gate, so the R3F path never loads (certification hasCanvas=false). The fallback spreads non-DOM props onto a div.
fake_complexity: Total in production (always the fallback). Even unlocked, it is clip-art geometry with no disposal, so each season change leaks geometries and materials.
justification: This is novelty seasonal confetti that never renders, because the React version gate is unreachable. Its R3F implementation has unstable effect dependencies, side-effects in state updaters, broken seeding and GPU leaks. Three other particle components already exist. Remove it with the rest of the three subpath.

name: GlassMoodRing
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell (level2/neutral) plus stacked redundant classes 'glass-backdrop-blur-md border border-border/20'. Ring itself is a bordered div with inline borderColor and `0 0 20px ${color}40` glow. Colors built by string-concatenating a hex alpha onto mood.color, but default moods use 'hsl(var(--glass-color-*))' / 'var(--glass-color-secondary)', producing invalid CSS (e.g. 'hsl(var(--x))cc') so the center fill and intensity-ring borders silently drop. Hard-coded #32CD32/#FF6347/#98FB98 mixed with tokens.
motion: Motion presets + Tailwind animate-pulse on center and all 3 intensity rings (infinite) + animate-spin overlay. Uses useMotionPreferenceContext whose default is prefersReducedMotion:false, so OS reduced-motion is ignored unless the app mounts MotionPreferenceProvider; useReducedMotion imported but unused. Dynamic Tailwind class `duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.slower}ms]` can never be generated by JIT.
a11y: Ring is role=button tabIndex=0 with Enter/Space; when non-interactive it becomes role=status with tabIndex=-1. Swatch buttons are 24px (w-6 h-6), below 44px touch target, label via aria-label; selected state communicated only by a white ring (no aria-pressed). Mood label text colored with the mood color itself (contrast not guaranteed). No live region for mood changes.
api: forwardRef, className + rest passthrough; size sm|md|lg|xl, thickness, glowIntensity. 'mood' prop is only an initial value (not controlled - never synced after mount). Toggle 'Auto' button only renders when autoTransition is set.
ssr: 'use client'; no module-scope window access. Plays sounds on change via useGlassSound.
fake_complexity: biometricIntegration is Math.random() every 10s ('This would normally connect to actual biometric sensors', L230-243); ambientResponse is a clock-hour lookup. Shows 'Bio' / 'Ambient' badges implying sensing that does not exist.
duplicates: Conceptually overlaps status-dot/indicator and avatar-ring patterns; no other mood component in library. Stale-closure handleMoodChange used inside interval effects not listed in deps.
justification: A novelty widget whose headline features (biometric, ambient) are random/clock fakes, whose default palette produces invalid CSS colors because hex alpha is appended to hsl(var()) strings, and which pulses indefinitely while ignoring OS reduced-motion by default. It has no plausible place in a premium first-party system; if a status ring is needed it should be rebuilt as a small token-driven indicator, not salvaged.

name: GlassToast (feedback)
material_impl: Glass primitive + glass-surface-{success,danger,warning,info} utility classes; progress bar via inline var(--glass-primary-level3-surface). Injects a global '@keyframes shrink' <style> per toast instance (name collides with the same keyframe in data-display/GlassNotificationCenter).
motion: CSS transform/opacity transition 300ms; useReducedMotion respected (instant enter/exit, progress bar hidden).
a11y: Each toast role=status aria-live=polite (error toasts should be assertive/alert). Dismiss button renders bare '✕' with NO aria-label and 20px size despite glass-touch-target class. Emoji icons (✅❌⚠️ℹ️) read aloud. No pause-on-hover/focus; auto-dismiss timer not cleared on manual dismiss (setTimeout leak, removeToast captured before definition).
api: Exports ToastProvider/useToast/useToastHelpers/GlassToast but none reach the root barrel. GlassToast itself is a demo wrapper that renders demo buttons when no children. useToast silently returns no-op context outside provider. Not forwardRef.
ssr: 'use client'; portal-less fixed container rendered inline (z-50), no SSR hazards.
fake_complexity: GlassToast default export is a demo harness (ToastDemoControls), not a toast.
duplicates: Direct duplicate of the exported src/components/data-display/GlassToast.tsx + GlassToastProvider.tsx (root exports those at src/index.ts:317-324); also overlaps GlassNotificationCenter.
target: src/components/data-display/GlassToastProvider.tsx
justification: Non-exported legacy duplicate of the shipped data-display toast system with a demo-harness as its main component, an unlabeled emoji close button, and a global keyframe collision. Nothing public depends on it; fold any useful bits (reduced-motion handling, position map) into the canonical GlassToastProvider and delete this file and its stories.

name: GlassErrorBoundary (components/)
material_impl: GlassAdvanced elev=3 variant=danger; ContrastGuard; glass-button utility classes. Reasonable reuse of primitives.
motion: None.
a11y: role=alert aria-live=assertive on fallback; buttons have aria-label. Class string duplicates glass-focus/glass-touch-target 3x. Leading emoji in heading. Copy claims 'The issue has been logged and our team will investigate' - false for a library.
api: Class component; wraps children in an extra <div> even when no error (layout side-effect). 'Go Home' hard-navigates window.location.href='/'. Sends gtag exceptions if window.gtag exists - undeclared analytics side effect. No resetKeys.
ssr: 'use client'; window access only in handlers/didCatch. Imports '@/lib/utils' alias.
fake_complexity: None, but the fallback copy is misleading product copy.
duplicates: Root exports GlassErrorBoundary from src/utils/errorBoundary.tsx (src/index.ts:1026-1032) - this is a same-named shadow implementation; also hooks/useErrorBoundary.tsx.
target: src/utils/errorBoundary.tsx
justification: Same-named duplicate of the exported utils/errorBoundary GlassErrorBoundary. It adds an unconditional wrapper div, implicit gtag telemetry, a hard redirect to '/', and false 'our team will investigate' copy. Delete it and keep one canonical boundary, adding resetKeys and a configurable fallback there.

name: HoudiniGlassCard (+ HoudiniGlassShowcase)
material_impl: Bespoke: relies on '.houdini-glass' CSS injected at runtime by HoudiniGlassProvider (blur(24px) saturate(1.5), rgba(255 255 255/.28) gradient) - without the provider the card gets only utility classes. Showcase buttons use hard-coded inline rgba(255,255,255,.12/.28) backgrounds/borders. Mixed raw Tailwind ('flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg') with glass-* utilities; nonsense class repeats ('glass-gradient-primary' x5).
motion: framer-motion whileHover scale 1.02 and overlay fade; useReducedMotion zeroes durations, but whileHover scale still applies. getPerformanceIndicator() calls useReducedMotion() inside a nested function rendered conditionally on showControls - a Rules-of-Hooks violation that changes hook order when showControls toggles.
a11y: Settings toggle is an icon-only button with only title (no aria-label/aria-expanded). Status dots convey state by color with title only. Emoji ✅/❌ for support state.
api: Plain function, no forwardRef, no rest/style passthrough, children required. effects/preset strings untyped (string[]).
ssr: 'use client'; framer-motion import; depends on provider injecting <style> into document.head in effect.
fake_complexity: Claims Paint Worklet effects ('frost', 'caustics', 'refraction'); useGlassEffect sets background-image: paint(glass-frost) etc. but no worklet module is ever registered (addModule calls are commented out in the provider), so on Chromium the paint() images are invalid/blank and the 'effects' do nothing.
duplicates: Overlaps GlassCard / LiquidGlassMaterial / LiquidGlassGPU and the OptimizedGlass primitive; HoudiniGlassShowcase is a demo page exported as a public component.
target: GlassCard / LiquidGlassMaterial
justification: Sells CSS Houdini paint effects that are never registered, so the card is really a hard-coded rgba/blur card that depends on runtime-injected global CSS. It breaks hook rules, skips forwardRef and style passthrough, and its showcase is exported as public API. Deprecate it in favour of the canonical card on the shared material. Real Houdini enhancement, if wanted, belongs inside the material primitive, not a parallel card.

name: HoudiniGlassProvider (+ useHoudiniGlass, useGlassEffect, glassPresets)
material_impl: Injects a global <style> with hard-coded backdrop-filter blur(24px) saturate(1.5) brightness(1.08) contrast(1.04) and rgba whites; writes --glass-background/--glass-blur/--glass-shadow etc. onto document.documentElement, globally overriding design tokens for the whole page. registerProperty declares '--glass-background' with syntax <color> and initialValue 'var(--glass-bg-default)' (invalid - initial values must be computationally independent, so registration throws and is swallowed).
motion: CSS transition with reduced-motion media query in injected CSS.
a11y: Debug panel role=status. Otherwise non-visual wrapper div.
api: forwardRef wrapper div + context; useHoudiniGlass returns a default context outside provider. 'enabledEffects' prop default array literal is a new identity each render and is an effect dependency (L255) - re-runs the performance effect every render.
ssr: 'use client'; all DOM writes inside effects. Mutates documentElement inline styles and never cleans them up on unmount; multiple providers fight over globals; window.__AURAGLASS_*_REGISTERED__ globals.
fake_complexity: Self-labelled @demo. registerGlassWorklets is a no-op (addModule lines commented out, 'Mock functions' comment L436); 'performanceMode' just toggles which strings are in an array.
duplicates: Overlaps ThemeProvider/GlassEffects context, LiquidGlassLayerProvider, token CSS. glassPresets name collides conceptually with other preset maps.
target: LiquidGlassLayerProvider / ThemeProvider tokens
justification: This is a mock of CSS Houdini. Its worklets are never loaded, its property registrations use invalid var() initial values, and it overwrites global design tokens on <html> with no cleanup. That is hostile to a token-driven system and unsafe when two instances mount. Remove it along with HoudiniGlassCard. If progressive Houdini enhancement is ever wanted, build it inside the canonical material primitive with real worklet modules.

name: ClearIcon
material_impl: N/A - plain stroked SVG 'X'.
motion: None.
a11y: No aria-hidden/role/title; when onClick is passed the SVG becomes a pointer-clickable non-focusable, non-keyboard control. Used inside buttons in GlassMultiSelect, where it should be aria-hidden.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no SVG prop spread (types.ts declares a different ClearIconProps extending SVGAttributes - two conflicting prop types).
ssr: Unneeded 'use client' on a pure SVG.
fake_complexity: None.
duplicates: Duplicate of icons/components.tsx X / XIcon / CloseIcon (src/icons/components.tsx:870,906).
target: src/icons (XIcon/CloseIcon)
justification: Internal one-off X icon duplicating the icon package, with a clickable-SVG anti-pattern and conflicting prop types. Replace its two uses in GlassMultiSelect with the canonical XIcon (aria-hidden), then delete the file, its story and its test.

name: ImageList (+ GlassImageList)
material_impl: CSS module using --aura-color-glass-surface/border/shadow and --aura-glass-neutral-level2-backdrop-blur tokens - token-correct, the cleanest material in this shard. No hard-coded colors.
motion: None (enableEntranceAnimation/animationConfig/disableAnimation/motionSensitivity props accepted and ignored).
a11y: Semantic <ul>; but items may be role=button (see ImageListItem) which breaks list semantics; cloned className injection 'galileo-image-list-item' (legacy brand leftover).
api: forwardRef, but ref is assigned in useEffect (late and never cleared on unmount) instead of being passed to the element. MUI-clone API (cols, rowHeight, variant standard|quilted|masonry|woven) - quilted and woven are effectively the same as standard. Dead props: rounded, enableEntranceAnimation, animationConfig, disableAnimation, motionSensitivity (any-typed).
fake_complexity: Variants 'quilted'/'woven' are named but not implemented beyond grid-auto-flow: dense.
duplicates: Overlaps layouts/GlassMasonryGrid.tsx and layout/GlassMasonry.tsx (masonry variant), media/LiquidGlassPhotoInspector galleries.
justification: Small and token-correct, and a reasonable media grid primitive. It needs a direct ref, removal of the dead animation props and the 'galileo' class, real or removed quilted/woven variants, and a decision on whether masonry lives here or in GlassMasonryGrid; consolidate the masonry implementations into one. The material approach (CSS module plus aura tokens) is the pattern other components should copy.

name: ImageListItem (+ GlassImageListItem)
material_impl: CSS module with aura glass tokens; focus ring and elevation shadows have rgba(99,102,241,…)/rgba(15,23,42,…) fallbacks behind token vars.
motion: CSS scale 1.03 on hover/focus via CSS var; useReducedMotion disables. Fine.
a11y: Interactive items get role=button on an <li> (removes listitem semantics); non-interactive items get forced aria-label='Image in gallery' overriding content; aria-expanded='true' set on hover when hoverOverlay (wrong semantics). Visible focus ring present (:focus-visible).
api:
forwardRef. `...rest` is spread onto BOTH the and the
  • (L163, L230), so unknown props (intent, tier - declared in types but unused) leak to DOM as invalid attributes and any handler passed lands twice. cols/rows ternary is a no-op (variableSize ? 1 : 1). elevation typed as string union but default 0.
fake_complexity: 'intent' and 'tier' props are declared but do nothing.
duplicates: Paired with ImageList; overlaps gallery/masonry items.
justification: The material and motion are sound. The API and ARIA are buggy: rest props are spread twice and leak to the DOM, role=button on an li breaks list semantics, aria-expanded is misused on hover, and intent/tier are dead props. Fix it by rendering an inner <button> for interactive items, keeping the li semantic, spreading rest props once, and deleting the dead props.

name: ImageListItemBar (+ GlassImageListItemBar)
material_impl: CSS module with aura tokens; text color hard-coded to rgba(var(--glass-color-black)/.95) for title/subtitle, so the bar is dark-text-only and illegible on dark/photographic glass in dark themes; color-mix with black tint.
motion: Opacity transition with reduced-motion handling in both JS and CSS.
a11y: showOnHover reveal is mouse-only (no :focus-within), so keyboard users never see the bar's actions (pointer-events:none while hidden). Title is a div, not heading/figcaption.
api: forwardRef (untyped generic on base), className/style/rest. title/subtitle typed string only (no ReactNode).
fake_complexity: None.
justification: Simple and close to acceptable. Swap the hard-coded black text for an on-glass text token so it works in dark themes, reveal on :focus-within as well as hover, accept ReactNode titles, and render as a figcaption. Keep it as part of the ImageList family.

name: GlassImageProcessingProvider (ImageProcessingProvider)
material_impl: Non-visual (wrapper div).
motion: None.
a11y: N/A.
api: Exported from root but its consumer hook useImageProcessing is NOT exported (src/index.ts:716 only), so external apps cannot read the context - the provider is only usable by GlassIntelligentImageUploader. Not forwardRef; passes 'data-glass-component' onto Context.Provider (ignored). 30+ method surface, most stubs.
ssr: 'use client'; reads process.env.IMAGE_SERVICE_URL (non-public) in client code; new Image()/document.createElement in callbacks only.
fake_complexity: Self-labelled @demo. analyzeImage returns Math.random brightness/contrast after 1s; detectFaces returns 0-3 random faces with random landmarks; optimizeImage appends '?optimized=true&q=85' to a blob: URL (which breaks the object URL); compressionRatio is random; removeBackground waits 3s and flips hasAlpha; rotate/replaceBackground/upscale return the input unchanged; uploadToCloud returns https://cloudinary.example.com URLs; templates use dead via.placeholder.com thumbnails. Functional bugs: addImage auto-optimize calls optimizeImage via a stale getImage closure -> 'Image not found' unhandled rejection; createImageFromFile creates two object URLs and leaks one; draws to an unused canvas.
duplicates: Overlaps input/GlassFileUpload and any AI/media service providers.
justification: This 1.4k-line mock 'AI image service' fakes analysis, face detection, optimization and cloud upload with Math.random and setTimeout. It returns example.com URLs and corrupts blob URLs, and its context hook isn't even exported. Shipping it in a design system is a liability: it implies capabilities that do not exist. Remove it from the package, or at most move it to a demo/examples workspace.

name: GlassIntelligentImageUploader

stories.note: also GlassIntelligentImageProcessor.stories.tsx (47 lines) with no matching component file

material_impl: Glass primitive shell; inner surfaces via glass-surface-* utilities; mixes raw Tailwind 'bg-red-500'/'bg-blue-500'/'h-2 rounded-full' and inline style overrides (padding:12, overflow hidden, display:grid). Editor modal backdrop uses utilities. Unicode glyphs (◎ ⇧ ⌁ ↯) as iconography instead of the icon set.
motion: Spinner animate-spin, hover scale; no reduced-motion handling.
a11y: Editor is a fixed overlay without role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, Escape, or labelled title; close button is a bare '✕' without aria-label. Dropzone div is not keyboard-focusable (only the inner button works). Filter range inputs have <label> not associated (no htmlFor/id). Hover-only overlay actions (Edit/Remove) invisible to keyboard/touch. Progress bars lack role=progressbar.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no rest/style passthrough. Requires the provider for any persistent state: under the default context addImages returns objects that are never stored, so uploads silently disappear. handleDrop is useCallback([]) capturing the first-render handleFiles (stale maxFiles/images.length). Several buttons have no handler (Crop & Resize, Add Watermark, Download, Batch Optimize, Batch Download).
ssr: 'use client'; DataTransfer constructed in handler only.
fake_complexity: Marketed as 'AI-powered image optimization and editing' with 'Reduce file sizes by up to 80%' copy; all AI actions route to the mock provider; filter sliders never change the previewed image (no CSS filter/canvas applied).
duplicates: Overlaps input/GlassFileUpload.tsx (the real upload control) and media/LiquidGlassPhotoInspector.
target: src/components/input/GlassFileUpload.tsx
justification: A demo uploader that fronts a fake AI backend. It has at least five dead buttons, filters that don't affect the preview, a modal without dialog semantics or focus management, and uploads that vanish without the unexported provider. Remove it with the provider. If a premium image dropzone is needed, extend GlassFileUpload with real preview, accessible drop target and progress.

name: Glass360Viewer
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell + controls bar (level3/strong) with redundant glass-backdrop-blur-md/border classes. Canvas hotspots use fillStyle 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))' and strokeStyle 'var(--glass-white)' - canvas cannot resolve CSS vars, so these assignments are ignored and hotspots draw in default black. Dynamic Tailwind 'duration-[${...}ms]' classes never generated.
motion: rAF render loop; auto-rotate via setState every frame, and currentView is a dependency of the rAF effect, so the loop is torn down and recreated every frame while rotating. Uses useMotionPreference (matchMedia-backed) to gate the hotspot pulse only - auto-rotate is NOT disabled under reduced motion.
a11y: Drag/wheel only; no keyboard panning, no aria on canvas, no text alternative for the scene. Control buttons are emoji (🔄 📱 🗖 ▶ 🎛) with title only, no aria-label/aria-pressed. Fullscreen state not synced with fullscreenchange (Esc leaves state stale).
api: forwardRef + rest passthrough; rich props (sources, controls, quality, performanceMode, minZoom/maxZoom) of which sources, quality (config computed then unused), performanceMode, maxZoom/minZoom, vr and volume are ignored.
fake_complexity: Not a 360 viewer: 'projection' is a source-rect crop of 1/4 of the equirectangular image (no spherical reprojection, no wrap at the seam); cubemap/cylindrical/dome are ignored; fov is tracked and displayed but never affects rendering, so wheel 'zoom' changes a number only. The canvas is never sized (default 300x150 bitmap stretched to the container -> blurry). React onWheel preventDefault is passive and does not block page scroll. Certification DOM inspection recorded hasCanvas:false for this story, i.e. the canvas was not present at capture.
duplicates: Overlaps media/LiquidGlassPhotoInspector; no other panorama viewer.
justification: The name promises a 360° panorama viewer. The implementation crops a rectangle of a flat image onto an unsized 300x150 canvas: zoom, projections, VR and quality are no-ops, and hotspots render black because canvas ignores CSS variables. A correct viewer needs WebGL spherical projection, which is out of scope for a glass design system and is better left to dedicated libraries. Remove it. At most, offer a glass controls overlay that wraps a third-party viewer.

name: GlassARPreview
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell + 3 nested OptimizedGlass panels; raw Tailwind bg-red-500/20, text-red-400, bg-green-500, bg-gray-500 mixed in. Canvas fillStyle uses 'rgba(var(--glass-color-black) / …)', 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))', 'var(--glass-white)', 'var(--glass-text-secondary-dark)' - all invalid for canvas, so objects/labels/debug render in whatever fillStyle was last valid (black).
motion: Continuous rAF loop (renderScene recreated on every dependency change); 'pulse'/'rotate' object animations apply ctx.scale/rotate AFTER drawing and are immediately restored - no visible effect. useReducedMotion imported, unused; loop runs regardless of reduced motion.
a11y: Canvas-only objects; selection via mouse click only; no keyboard access, no text alternative; status chip not a live region.
api: forwardRef + rest; huge prop surface (markers, lighting, environmentMap, quality, xrMode, onObjectMove/Rotate/Scale, renderObject) with most ignored: lighting/environmentMap/config unused, renderObject branch is empty, move/rotate/scale callbacks never fired.
ssr: 'use client'; navigator/window inside effects. Camera effect lists cameraStream in its deps and calls setCameraStream inside -> with background='camera' it re-requests getUserMedia on every stream update (infinite permission/stream churn), stopping only the previous-previous stream.
fake_complexity: Self-labelled @demo: no WebXR session is ever started ('In a real implementation, this would start WebXR session'); marker 'tracking' is setInterval + Math.random found/lost; markers are drawn at random positions each frame (flicker); canvas DPR scaling then hit-testing in device pixels mis-targets clicks on HiDPI screens.
duplicates: None functional; overlaps the other immersive canvas demos.
justification: A fake AR component. There is no XR session, tracking is random, renderObject and the lighting props are dead, and canvas colors are invalid. In camera mode a dependency bug loops getUserMedia, which is a privacy and battery hazard. It cannot be polished into a real AR feature inside a design system. Remove it from the public API.

name: GlassFluidSimulation
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell + controls panel; controls override text tokens inline to black (rgba(var(--glass-color-black)/.9)) and force colorScheme light - breaks dark themes. Canvas strokes use named colors 'red'/'blue'/'purple'/'green'/'yellow'. Canvas fixed 800x600 inline width/height (no responsive sizing, overflows mobile).
motion: rAF + setState per frame of all particles. animate depends on render, which depends on particleHistory/fps/mousePos (all updated every frame), so the rAF effect is cancelled and re-registered every frame. Under reduced motion (only via MotionPreferenceProvider context; default ignores OS) the loop returns immediately and nothing is ever drawn - blank canvas instead of a static frame.
a11y: Canvas has no role/label/text alternative. Controls: 'Trails' checkbox is bound to the showTrails prop and only clears history; 'Debug' checkbox onChange is a no-op; preset select changes state but the preset effect body is empty - three controls that look functional do nothing.
api: forwardRef + rest; many physics props. 'preset' does not apply any preset (L235-239). 'paused' prop only seeds initial state.
fake_complexity: Labeled SPH but is an O(n^2) naive neighbor loop with density clamped to restDensity (pressure always >= 0). Particles are mutated in place inside setState and history stores shallow array copies of the same mutated objects, so 'trails' render the current positions repeatedly instead of history.
duplicates: Overlaps GlassParticleField, GlassVortexPortal, advanced/GlassParticles, backgrounds/ParticleBackground, effects/SeasonalParticles (5+ canvas particle systems).
justification: A toy O(n^2) particle demo branded as an SPH fluid simulation. Trails are broken by in-place mutation, the preset, debug and trails controls are no-ops, it uses a fixed 800px canvas, re-subscribes rAF every frame, and draws nothing under reduced motion. It is not a design-system component. Remove it. If ambient liquid motion is wanted, it belongs in one consolidated, GPU-backed background effect.

name: GlassHologram
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell with inline radial-gradient background built as `${colors.primary}10`; for blue/green/red/white schemes primary is 'hsl(var(--…))' or 'var(--glass-white)', so the concatenated hex alpha makes the background, grid lines, scanlines, shape fills and drop-shadows invalid CSS. Hard-coded hex palettes for purple/cyan/rainbow (#FF0080/#00FF80/#8000FF). Injects global @keyframes named 'float', 'noise', 'interference' (generic names colliding with app CSS) per instance.
motion: setAnimationTime every rAF frame re-renders the entire component at 60fps. Render-time Math.random in background 'matrix'/'particles' and glitch means positions re-randomize every frame (constant jitter). Reduced motion via context only (OS ignored by default).
a11y: role=region aria-label present. Layers have pointerEvents:'none' unless already selected, so they can never be clicked to select (onClick unreachable). Emoji control buttons with title only.
api: forwardRef + rest, but rest is spread after style so a consumer style prop replaces width/height/background entirely. containerRef is never attached to any element, so handleMouseMove always returns early and 'interactive' does nothing; if it were wired it would accumulate angle per mousemove event (runaway spin). customShaders, ambientLight, depthOfField unused.
ssr: 'use client'; render-time Math.random -> hydration mismatch if SSR'd.
fake_complexity: Not a hologram: CSS 3D transforms on absolutely positioned divs plus scanline gradients; 'customShaders' prop does nothing.
duplicates: Overlaps effects/holographic and shimmer effects, GlassParticleField background particles.
justification: A sci-fi decoration with severe correctness bugs. Interaction is unwired (detached containerRef), layers cannot be selected (pointer-events none), positions re-randomize every frame, half the color schemes emit invalid CSS, and the whole tree re-renders at 60fps. It carries generic global keyframe names and does nothing a premium glass system needs. Remove it.

name: GlassParticleField
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell overridden by inline background 'rgba(255,255,255,0.22)' (hard-coded, defeats tint/theme). Canvas colors properly sanitized via resolveCanvasColor (rejects var() strings) - the only canvas component here that handles the CSS-var problem. Hard-coded hex palettes per colorScheme. Canvas bitmap fixed to bounds (360x240) while CSS width is 100% (blurry when stretched, no DPR).
motion: rAF with setState of whole particle array every frame plus setParticleCount inside the updater (setState-in-updater). When paused the loop keeps spinning rAF doing nothing. Seeds a deterministic static constellation for reduced motion (good), but reduced-motion detection uses context only (OS ignored by default).
a11y: role=region + aria-label. Play/pause is an emoji button with title only. Decorative canvas not aria-hidden.
api: forwardRef, className/style merged sensibly. Unused props: collisions, physics, performance (culling/lodDistance), effects.sparkle; 'renderParticle' renders a DOM node per particle (up to maxParticles=1000) - perf trap.
fake_complexity: Moderate: real simple particle physics, but 'collisions', 'culling', 'LOD', 'bloom' are names without implementations (bloom = CSS drop-shadow).
duplicates: Strong overlap with advanced/GlassParticles.tsx, backgrounds/ParticleBackground.tsx, effects/SeasonalParticles(.r3f).tsx, GlassFluidSimulation, GlassVortexPortal particles.
target: backgrounds/ParticleBackground (single ambient particle effect)
justification: The least broken of the immersive canvases: colors are sanitized and there is a reduced-motion static seed. It is still one of five or more overlapping particle systems, with dead feature props, hard-coded white fill, setState-per-frame rendering and no DPR handling. Merge its good ideas (deterministic seed, color sanitizer) into one ambient particle background that keeps state in refs, is DPR-aware, sits behind content as aria-hidden, and reads OS reduced motion. Then delete this one.

name: GlassVortexPortal
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell; canvas has a hard-coded light gradient background, and each frame fillRect('rgba(0,0,0,0.1)') accumulates over it, so the light canvas progressively darkens to near-black. COLOR_SCHEMES were desaturated to near-gray (e.g. 'blue' = [210,216,224]) so schemes are indistinguishable. Hard-coded rgba throughout.
motion: rAF + three setStates per frame. updateRings multiplies ring.opacity by currentIntensity EVERY frame (opacity: ring.opacity * currentIntensity) and updateParticles does the same for particle opacity, so with intensity 0.8 rings/particles decay exponentially to invisible within ~1s; particle lifetime decremented by 0.016 from thousands so particles never expire. opening/closing timers not cleared on unmount. Reduced motion via context only.
a11y: Canvas without label; Type select, Color select and Pulse/Distortion/Debug checkboxes all have onChange={() => {}} - five controls that do nothing (and controlled checkboxes without handlers).
api: forwardRef + rest; 'type' prop (dimensional/energy/void/quantum/temporal) is never read by rendering; distortion types unused.
fake_complexity: 'dimensional distortion', 'quantum', 'temporal', 'event horizon' are radial gradients; type has no effect.
justification: Its control panel is mostly inert: type, color and three toggles are empty onChange handlers. The core animation decays itself to nothing through per-frame opacity multiplication, and the canvas darkens to black over the light gradient. Thirteen stories and a 'certified' screenshot mask a component that does not work as named. Remove it.

name: GlassCheckbox
material_impl: OptimizedGlass (=OptimizedGlassCore) wraps the visual box. intensity/depth/tint/border props are silently discarded by OptimizedGlassCore (src/primitives/OptimizedGlassCore.tsx:244-266), so tint='primary' on checked does nothing. variantConfig (bg-primary, bg-green-500, bg-amber-500...) is computed at :162-191 but NEVER applied to any className, so the checked state has no fill; only the icon appears. OptimizedGlassCore also sets an inline borderRadius of 8px by default (:225-241), which overrides glass-radius-lg. Hard-coded Tailwind palette names (green-500, amber-500, red-500, blue-500) don't exist in library CSS.
motion: Motion (MotionFramer) scaleIn on the icon. It defaults to reduced on SSR and respects matchMedia (MotionFramer.tsx:232-252). animation='float' on OptimizedGlass is a dead prop because OptimizedGlassCore ignores `animation`. animate-spin loader is gated by shouldAnimate. Reduced-motion handling works, but most of what it gates doesn't exist.
a11y: Exposes two checkbox nodes: an sr-only native input plus an OptimizedGlass div with role=checkbox and aria-checked (:250-257). The div is not focusable and has no click handler, so clicking the visible box does nothing; only the <label htmlFor> toggles (:194-298). The bare variant without a label can't be toggled with a mouse at all. aria-checked ignores indeterminate (never 'mixed'), and input.indeterminate is never set. The focus ring uses Tailwind focus-within:ring-* classes that aren't present in src/styles, so keyboard focus is invisible. labelPosition 'left' and 'top' render identically to 'right' and 'bottom' (:366-373). Hooks are called conditionally (useA11yId inside ternaries, :95-99).
api: forwardRef to the input. className goes to the wrapper. Controlled/uncontrolled via checked/defaultChecked. Has both onCheckedChange and onChange. Unused imports: GlassInput, ContrastGuard, ANIMATION, useReducedMotion.
ssr: 'use client'. No module-scope window access. announceToScreenReader touches document only in effects/handlers.
fake_complexity: Moderate. Variant/tint/animation props look like a rich material system but are no-ops.
justification: A checkbox you can't click and whose checked state has no fill doesn't meet the bar. Rebuild it as a native input inside a <label> with a peer-styled glass box, using real token-driven checked/indeterminate fills, a defined :focus-visible ring and a native indeterminate property, and drop the dead OptimizedGlass props. Every group, tree and table should then compose this one primitive.
evidence: src/components/input/GlassCheckbox.tsx:216-258 visual box has role=checkbox, no onClick, no tabIndex

name: GlassCheckboxGroup
material_impl: Each option is a full OptimizedGlass card (elevation level1, liftOnHover) holding a second nested OptimizedGlass for the square: two glass layers per option. The checked indicator uses glass-text-primary over bg-primary/20. The indeterminate bar uses glass-bg-transparent, so it's invisible (:323). The 'inner glow' div repeats glass-gradient-primary three times (:344). The info variant is hard-coded to blue-500.
motion: Motion scaleIn on the square and indicator (reduced-motion safe through MotionFramer). animation='float' is a no-op.
a11y: Implements its own div role=checkbox with tabIndex and Space/Enter handling plus an sr-only native input. It doesn't reuse GlassCheckbox. role=group carries aria-required, which isn't a valid ARIA attribute on group. The group label is a <label> with no associated control. minSelections blocks unchecking below the minimum, which can trap users. Each click calls announceToScreenReader, which creates and removes a DOM node.
api: Both items and group use forwardRef. GlassCheckboxItem claims a standalone mode (:137-146), but useCheckboxGroup throws without context (:106-112), so that branch is dead. className is applied to both the container and the inner group (:509, :537). renderItem output isn't wired to selection. Not exported from root: GlassCheckboxItem.
ssr: 'use client'. Hooks called conditionally (:405-409). useGlassSound is imported per item.
fake_complexity: Sound design via useGlassSound on every toggle is decoration.
target: GlassCheckbox (group = fieldset + legend composing GlassCheckbox)
justification: This is a second checkbox implementation with different markup, focus model and visuals from GlassCheckbox, and it nests two glass layers per row. Replace it with a thin fieldset/legend group that composes the redesigned GlassCheckbox. Keep the min/max and option-card ideas, and remove the dead standalone path and the sound effects.

name: GlassColorPicker
material_impl: Bespoke glass-* utilities (glass-bg-white/25, glass-backdrop-blur-xl, glass-surface-dark/30) inside a GlassCard. Colors are set imperatively through refs and style mutation in effects instead of render. The default palette mixes CSS vars ('var(--glass-black)') with hex, and hexToRgb can't parse the vars. The material palette is hard-coded to Material Design hex values. The class glass-text-primary-glass-opacity-60/80 is undefined in src/styles.
motion: Motion fadeIn on the popover, reduced-motion safe.
a11y: Element IDs are hard-coded ('hue-slider', 'red-input', 'palette-label', 'color-picker-title'), so two pickers on one page produce duplicate IDs and broken label associations. The popover declares role=dialog with aria-modal but has no focus trap, no Escape key and no focus return. Palette swatches are 16px dots inside 32px buttons. Native range inputs redundantly get role=slider. aria-valuenow is put on number inputs.
api: React.FC with no forwardRef. ...props go to the trigger div, not the root. format/showAlpha are supported. The 3-digit hex regex is accepted but hexToRgb fails on it. The alpha fallback `rgb.a || 1` turns alpha 0 into 1. Initial hsl/rgb state is hard-coded to the default blue and ignores defaultValue unless `value` is passed. Cancel doesn't revert; Done and Cancel do the same thing. placement left/right still add mt-2. There's no 2D saturation/brightness area, only three linear sliders. GlassColorPalette (not root-exported) has unlabeled swatch buttons.
ssr: 'use client'. A document mousedown listener is always attached, even when closed.
fake_complexity: The 'comprehensive color picker' is three HSL sliders, RGB number inputs and two fixed palettes.
justification: A premium picker needs a 2D saturation/value plane, a hue strip, an alpha checkerboard, an eyedropper where available, and real popover behavior (portal, positioning, focus trap, Escape). The current version has duplicate global IDs, a Cancel that doesn't cancel, and ignores defaultValue for its initial slider state. Rebuild it on primitives/positioning and primitives/focus, and share swatch and gradient-stop pieces with GlassGradientPicker.

name: GlassCombobox
material_impl: Bespoke glass-* utility strings: glass-bg-white/8 input, glass-bg-white/25 + glass-backdrop-blur-xl listbox. No shared primitive or tokens. Options are bordered glass-bg-white/12 pills with gap-2 between them, which reads as a stack of buttons rather than a list.
motion: None (instant open/close). Acceptable.
a11y: The best ARIA in this shard: input role=combobox, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant, aria-autocomplete=list, grouped options with role=group. Defects: the listbox never closes on blur or outside click (onFocus opens it and only Escape or a commit closes it). aria-activedescendant is still set while closed. Option IDs embed raw values, so spaces produce invalid IDs. Options are <button>s, which adds tab stops inside the listbox. After a commit the query stays equal to the label, so reopening shows a filtered list.
api: forwardRef to the root div. value/defaultValue/onChange(value, option). label is required in practice (defaults to 'Combobox'). No size variants, no clear button, no async or creatable support.
fake_complexity: None.
target: Unified GlassCombobox/GlassSelect family (single + multi) on the GlassMultiSelect engine + primitives/positioning + dismissable-layer
justification: Small and fairly correct, but it's one of at least six select/combobox implementations. Keep its ARIA pattern (input-as-combobox with activedescendant) as the reference model for a single unified Select/Combobox that supports single/multi selection, groups, async, creatable and a portal popover. Fix blur-dismiss before retiring it.

name: GlassDateField
material_impl: Delegates entirely to GlassInput (type=date plus a Calendar icon), so it inherits all of GlassInput's inline-style issues.
motion: None.
a11y: Native date input semantics. The label defaults to 'Date'. The native calendar affordance plus a leftIcon gives two calendar glyphs in Chromium.
api: forwardRef, all GlassInput props except type and leftIcon.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: An honest thin wrapper over the native date control. It's the right fallback for mobile and for low-JS forms. It improves automatically once GlassInput is redesigned. Hide the native picker indicator or drop the leftIcon to avoid the doubled glyph.

name: GlassDatePicker
material_impl: GlassInput trigger plus a Glass primitive popover (glass-w-80). Each of the 42 day cells is a full GlassButton. Native <select> elements for month and year (201 year options, 1900-2100) are styled glass-bg-transparent, so the OS dropdown renders unstyled.
motion: Motion wrapper with no preset (none). No range-highlight animation.
a11y: The day grid is a plain div of buttons with no role=grid, no arrow, PageUp/PageDown or Home/End navigation, no aria-selected/aria-current on today, and no focus move into the calendar on open. Escape/Enter work only on the input. Day aria-labels are numeric (MM/DD/YYYY) and lack weekday/month names. The '‹'/'›' IconButtons use text glyphs.
api: forwardRef, but the ref lands on an inner div (:454), not the root. The `format` prop is accepted and ignored. Week numbers are fake: they render weekIndex+1 with the comment 'Week number calculation would go here' (:592-596). showWeekNumbers adds an 8th cell to a grid-cols-7 grid and breaks the layout. mode='range' duplicates GlassDateRangePicker, and the DateRange interface is declared in both files. Free-text input is parsed with `new Date(string)`, which is locale-unsafe. ...props spread to the root.
ssr: 'use client'. `new Date()` in initial state causes a hydration mismatch risk around midnight and timezones.
fake_complexity: Week numbers are faked.
target: Single GlassDatePicker (single|range|multiple) over one shared GlassCalendar grid
justification: Date pickers are a showcase surface for a premium system, but this one has no grid keyboard model, fake week numbers, an ignored format prop, a 201-option native select, and 42 heavyweight GlassButtons per month. Build one calendar grid (role=grid, roving focus, locale weekdays, ISO week numbers) shared with GlassCalendar, and use it for single, range and presets. Put it in a positioned, portal popover with a focus trap.
evidence: src/components/input/GlassDatePicker.tsx:610-636 GlassButton per day, no grid role

name: GlassDateRangePicker
material_impl: Bespoke trigger (glass-surface-subtle/10 + glass-backdrop-blur-md) and popover (glass-surface-dark/30) wrapping a transparent GlassCard. Presets and the calendar sit side by side inside a glass-w-80 (320px) popover, which is too cramped for both. Undefined classes include glass-text-primary-glass-opacity-60/80.
motion: 42 Motion scaleIn instances per render, one per day cell. They're reduced-motion safe through MotionFramer but heavy.
a11y: The trigger is a div with onClick only: no role, tabIndex or key handler, so the component is entirely keyboard-inaccessible. The clear <button> is nested inside the clickable div. Prev/next month buttons have no accessible name. Weekday headers are hard-coded English ('Su'..'Sa') and ignore locale and first day of week.
api: React.FC with no forwardRef. ...props are destructured and never spread. Range selection by clicking is broken: after the first click sets `from`, the second click hits `!currentRange.to` (:205) and resets `from` again, so `to` can only be set via presets. Cancel and Apply both just close; neither reverts or commits. Not truly controlled: internal state is mirrored from `value` only when truthy.
ssr: 'use client'. Global mousedown listener always attached.
fake_complexity: The Apply/Cancel footer implies a staged-commit model that doesn't exist.
target: GlassDatePicker (mode='range' with presets slot)
justification: Its core job, picking a range by clicking two dates, is broken by the selection logic, and the trigger can't be reached by keyboard. The test suite only smoke-renders, so the defect shipped. Fold presets and the dual-month layout into the redesigned GlassDatePicker range mode, then deprecate this export.
evidence: src/components/input/GlassDateRangePicker.tsx:198-216 second click resets from (to never set)

name: GlassFieldGroup
material_impl: A fieldset with glass-border-white/10 and glass-bg-white/6. White alpha is hard-coded and there's no blur, which is fine for a grouping container but light-theme blind (white-on-white).
motion: None.
a11y: Correct semantics (fieldset/legend). The description isn't linked through aria-describedby.
api: forwardRef, native fieldset props, columns 1-3 at md breakpoint.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: Simple and semantically right. Swap the hard-coded white alpha for a surface token that works in light and dark, link the description to the group, and make it the standard group wrapper used by the checkbox and radio groups.

name: GlassFileUpload (input/)
material_impl: Glass primitive dropzone with Tailwind border-dashed/border-primary/bg-primary/5 classes, which aren't in library CSS. Emoji are used as file-type icons (🖼️🎥📄📦) and as dropzone and status glyphs (📁⏳✓✗✕).
motion: CSS transition only.
a11y: A label with tabIndex=0 is the dropzone, and its aria-label overrides the visible content. Hard-coded IDs ('file-upload-instructions', 'uploaded-files-heading') collide across instances. The progressbar has no visible label association. Validation errors surface through window.alert().
api: React.FC, no forwardRef. No controlled `files` prop. With onUpload, progress jumps from 0 to 100. showPreview shows an emoji, not a thumbnail. The uploadUrl XHR path posts to an arbitrary URL with no headers or auth hook.
fake_complexity: showPreview claims a preview but renders an emoji.
duplicates: src/components/interactive/GlassFileUpload.tsx (767 lines, the one actually exported from root at src/index.ts:423)
target: src/components/interactive/GlassFileUpload.tsx (the root export)
justification: This file isn't reachable from the package: root exports interactive/GlassFileUpload, and input/index.ts doesn't export it. It's an orphan with its own story, test and certification screenshot, which inflates counts. It uses alert(), emoji icons and colliding IDs. Delete it and fold anything unique (the XHR progress path) into the exported upload component.

name: GlassForm (+ GlassFormItem/Label/Control/Description/Message, useFormField)
material_impl: A near-verbatim shadcn/ui Form port on react-hook-form. Optional OptimizedGlass item container. GlassFormControl glass mode uses Tailwind bg-background/50 and border-border/20. GlassFormMessage colors are Tailwind text-red-400/amber-400/green-400/blue-400, which aren't in library CSS.
motion: None.
a11y: Good pattern: Slot injects id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid into the control. aria-describedby always references formDescriptionId even when no description is rendered (dangling ID).
api: Only `GlassForm` (the FormProvider alias) is exported from root (src/index.ts:213). GlassFormItem/Label/Control/Description/Message and useFormField aren't, so the documented composition in the story is impossible for package consumers. Root `GlassFormField` comes from a different file (GlassFormField.tsx, a layout div), while this file's GlassFormField is the RHF Controller wrapper: a name collision. useFormField checks `!fieldContext` after already using it, and the context default is {}, so the guard never fires. data-glass-component is passed to a Context.Provider, where it's a no-op. react-hook-form is a peer dependency (package.json:379).
fake_complexity: None. It's shadcn with a glass label.
target: Merge with GlassFormField.tsx into one forms module exported under the ./forms subpath
justification: The RHF binding pattern is sound, but the public surface is broken: consumers get a bare FormProvider and a different GlassFormField with the same name. Rework it into a single forms API: Form, FormField (Controller), FormItem (layout, absorbing GlassFormField.tsx), FormLabel, FormControl, FormMessage. Export all of it from root or ./forms, and use semantic message tokens instead of Tailwind palette names.
evidence: src/index.ts:213-217 only GlassForm exported; GlassFormField from other file

name: GlassFormField
material_impl: No material, just layout. The required asterisk uses Tailwind text-red-800, which is dark red on a glass library and isn't in library CSS.
motion: None.
a11y: Without htmlFor, the label points at a generated ID that no child receives, so the label is orphaned. Description and error aren't connected to the control through aria-describedby. The asterisk is aria-hidden but there's no programmatic required state.
api: forwardRef div. Doesn't clone or inject IDs into children (unlike GlassForm's Slot approach). Same exported name as GlassForm.tsx's RHF field.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassForm (FormItem + Slot-based FormControl)
justification: This is the same concept as GlassForm's item/label/message but without control wiring, so the label and error aren't associated unless the caller does it manually. Merge it into the forms module, where the Slot-based control gets the ID and describedby automatically, and resolve the export-name collision.
evidence: src/components/input/GlassFormField.tsx:32-33 generated id not passed to children

name: GlassFormStepper (+ GlassCompactStepper)
material_impl: No glass primitive. glass-surface-* state circles in the main stepper. GlassCompactStepper (not root-exported) switches to raw Tailwind bg-green-500/bg-red-500/bg-white/10 and w-6 h-6, two styling dialects in one file. The vertical variant mixes Tailwind (border-2 flex hover:scale-110) with glass-* classes. The optional-step indicator is a yellow dot with no legend.
motion: Motion scaleIn/fadeIn/slideRight per step (reduced-safe). hover:scale-110 and glass-hover-lift on circles.
a11y: Steps are Motion divs with role=button, tabIndex and Enter/Space, and aria-current=step is used correctly. Headings are <h3> per step, which pollutes the outline. allowClickCompleted gates only 'pending' steps, despite the name. The compact stepper buttons have no aria-label. In horizontal mode the connector line is top-aligned (items-start) rather than centered on the circles.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef. ...props are destructured but never spread. data-testid is applied only in vertical mode. config.fontSize.replace('text-','text-') is a no-op.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassStepper (single stepper primitive used by GlassWizard)
justification: It's at least the fifth stepper in the library and uses two styling dialects internally. Fold its useful bits (error/optional states, compact mode) into one GlassStepper that GlassWizard and form templates consume, then deprecate this export.

name: GlassFormTable
material_impl: Plain table with glass-bg-white/12 rows and borderSpacing set inline. Classes glass-border-white-15, glass-surface-white-5 and glass-text-primary-70 use a different naming dialect from the rest of the file.
motion: None.
a11y: Inputs get per-cell aria-labels, which is good. role='gridcell' is used inside role='table' (should be cell), and redundant roles are added on native elements. Removing a row shifts the labels because rows are keyed by index.
api: Generic <T>, controlled only (rows/onChange). Every cell is a text input, with no column type, validation, renderer or required flag. Index keys lose focus and state on removal. Imports cn from '@/lib/utils' while siblings use utilsComprehensive.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassDataGrid editable-cell mode
justification: This is a minimal repeatable-rows widget with string-only cells and index keys, which isn't premium and overlaps with three table/grid components. Deprecate it in favor of an editable-cell mode on GlassDataGrid, or a FieldArray recipe in the forms module.

name: GlassInput
material_impl: Two paths: OptimizedGlass (default) or LiquidGlassMaterial (material='liquid'). Both get a hard-coded inline style: background var(--glass-primary-level3-surface), border 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.24), and a fixed box-shadow (:308-318, :432-438). That inline style overrides variantClasses and stateClasses, so variant outlined/minimal/filled and the error/warning/success border colors effectively don't render. OptimizedGlassCore's inline 8px radius also overrides glass-radius-2xl. liftOnHover and press are applied to a text field, so the field translates on hover and press. glass-pulse-ring is undefined.
motion: No animation beyond transitions. The spinner uses glass-animate-spin without a reduced-motion gate (the default path relies on CSS).
a11y: Builds the label, helper and error wiring with createFormFieldA11y. Defects: a user-supplied `id` is spread after a11yProps through validProps and overrides inputId, so the component's own
api: forwardRef with a ref merge. className is applied to both the outer wrapper and the inner glass surface (:250, :455). A user's onFocus/onBlur in props are re-spread after the internal handlers and replace them, so isFocused never updates and the focus ring disappears for anyone who passes onFocus. clearable works only for controlled `value`. GlassTextArea is re-exported as an alias. Unused imports: ContrastGuard, ANIMATION, useReducedMotion.
ssr: 'use client'. LiquidGlassMaterial is imported eagerly into every input bundle, even though material='glass' is the default.
fake_complexity: materialProps.ior/thickness ('index of refraction') on a text field. Whether that does anything visible depends on LiquidGlassMaterial; here it's mostly a tint and the inline style dominates.
justification: GlassInput is the foundation of every form, picker and search field, and it's the most important component in this shard. Several of its documented props don't work: variants and state borders are masked by inline styles, a custom id breaks the label, and a custom onFocus kills the focus state. Rebuild it as a token-driven field (surface, border, focus, and state tokens through CSS variables) with no inline material, no hover lift, a slot-based adornment API, a correct describedby, and lazy liquid material. Then GlassDateField, GlassTimeField and GlassSearchField become trivial.
evidence: src/components/input/GlassInput.tsx:552 error p id vs describedby helperTextId

name: GlassLabel
material_impl: Variant colors are Tailwind text-slate-950/slate-700/emerald-800/amber-900/red-800 (:53-60), none of which exist in library CSS. Without consumer Tailwind every variant renders the same inherited color. With Tailwind, the labels go near-black on dark glass, which is unreadable and the opposite of every other component's glass-text-primary.
motion: transition-colors only.
a11y: Native <label>. The required asterisk span uses aria-label='required' on a non-interactive span (unreliable). The description isn't associated with anything. A <div> wrapper prevents inline use inside flex rows or sentence text.
api: forwardRef. Generates an id even when it's not needed. `enhanced` just adds glass-focus to a non-focusable label.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: A label should be a trivial, rock-solid typographic primitive. This one ships undefined, theme-inverted colors and an extra div wrapper. Switch to semantic text tokens, drop the wrapper (or make it optional), and make every control in the library use it instead of six bespoke label snippets.

name: GlassMultiSelect
material_impl: A CSS module (GlassMultiSelect.module.css) built on design tokens: --aura-radius-*, --aura-space-*, --aura-color-semantic-primary via color-mix, and --glass-neutral-level2-surface with backdrop-filter blur from --aura-glass-neutral-level2-backdrop-blur. This is the most token-disciplined material in the shard. Gaps: the dropdown has the surface color but no backdrop-filter, so it's inconsistent with the trigger. 'galileo-' class prefixes are leftovers. Option text color is an inline style.
motion: Dropdown toggles display:none/block with no transition. The spinner keyframes have no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
a11y: Partial combobox. role=combobox sits on the container div (ARIA 1.1 style) while the input carries aria-autocomplete. There's no aria-activedescendant and options have no IDs, so the screen reader doesn't follow the keyboard focus highlight. The creatable option lacks role=option. Error and helper text aren't linked through aria-describedby. searchable=false disables the input entirely (:679), which leaves the component with no keyboard focus target. Backspace removes tokens, which is good. Token remove buttons are labeled.
api: Generic forwardRef with a ref merge. A rich, consistent API: groups, creatable, async loading, render props, maxSelections, density and compact. closeOnSelect defaults to true, which is unusual for a multi-select. `size` uses small/medium/large while the rest of the library uses sm/md/lg. ContrastGuard wraps every text node. Unused imports: ANIMATION, useReducedMotion.
ssr: 'use client'. window.innerHeight is read only in an effect.
fake_complexity: None.
target: Becomes engine of unified Select/Combobox family
justification: It has the best engineering foundation here: token-based CSS module, real interaction tests, and a complete feature set. It needs proper combobox ARIA (input role=combobox, activedescendant, option IDs), a positioned/portal popover with a blur-consistent material and an entry transition, sm/md/lg naming, and closeOnSelect=false by default. After that it should absorb GlassCombobox, GlassSelect and GlassSelectCompound as single/multi modes.
evidence: src/components/input/GlassMultiSelect.tsx:651-688 combobox role on div, no activedescendant

name: GlassMultiStepForm (+ GlassFormStep, useFormContext)
material_impl: GlassCard shell. Step indicators use Tailwind bg-green-500/bg-primary/bg-red-500/20/text-slate-700. text-slate-700 is dark text for inactive steps on dark glass, and it's undefined in library CSS. The progress fill repeats glass-gradient-primary three times. glass-min-400px and glass-min-glass-w-24 are malformed or undefined classes.
motion: Motion fadeIn and slideRight on the progress bar (reduced-safe). Inactive steps render an empty Motion each, which is wasted work.
a11y: Step indicators are role=button divs, all tabbable, and they let users jump forward past unvalidated steps (goToStep validates only the current step, and only in onChange mode). Both 'Step X of N' and the percentage are aria-live, so they announce twice per step. The progressbar is labeled.
api: React.FC, ...props go to GlassCard. Exports a `useFormContext` that shadows react-hook-form's identically named hook, which invites wrong imports. FormStep type name collides with GlassFormStepper's FormStep. The 'Data Saved' badge only means the key exists in local state; nothing is persisted. data-glass-component is put on a Context.Provider.
fake_complexity: The 'Data Saved' badge implies persistence that doesn't exist.
target: GlassWizard
justification: This is one of four or more wizard and multi-step implementations, with skippable validation, misleading 'Data Saved' UI, and export names that collide with react-hook-form and GlassFormStepper. Merge its async step validation into GlassWizard, built on the unified stepper and forms module, and retire this export.

name: GlassRadioGroup (+ GlassRadioGroupItem, useRadioGroup)
material_impl: Each item is OptimizedGlass with inline hard-coded backgrounds: rgba(56,189,248,0.12) when selected, rgba(5,11,24,0.18-0.22) otherwise (:453-458, :549-554). These bypass tokens and are dark-theme-only. The selected dot is glass-surface-subtle (low contrast). tint='primary' and animation='shimmer' are discarded by OptimizedGlassCore. liftOnHover and press move the row.
motion: Motion scaleIn on the dot and the card variant (reduced-safe). shimmer is a dead prop.
a11y: role=radiogroup with role=radio divs, but every radio has tabIndex=0 and there's no arrow-key navigation or roving tabindex, which violates the WAI-ARIA radio pattern. There's no native input, so the `name` prop does nothing and the group doesn't submit with a <form>. aria-describedby falls back to a nonexistent `${groupId}-description` ID. Each selection triggers announceToScreenReader, which duplicates the aria-checked change. The outer wrapper has overflow-auto and max-h-full, which can clip focus rings.
api: forwardRef to the inner group. className goes to the inner element. No ...props passthrough. defaultValue uses `|| ''`, so a value of 0 is dropped. GlassRadioGroupItem requires parent-supplied isSelected/onSelect even though a context exists (the context is created but never consumed). useRadioGroup is a trivial useState wrapper. GlassInput is imported and unused.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: A radio group without arrow keys or native form participation is a correctness failure, not a polish issue. Rebuild it on native radio inputs (or primitives/roving-focus) inside a fieldset, with token-driven selected surfaces for both themes. Share the option-card layout with the redesigned checkbox group, and remove the dead context and announce calls.
evidence: src/components/input/GlassRadioGroup.tsx:175,316 name passed but no input rendered

name: GlassSearchField
material_impl: Thin wrapper over GlassInput (shared). No material of its own; clear button is GlassButton ghost/sm. Inherits whatever GlassInput renders.
motion: None of its own.
a11y: type=search plus a redundant role=searchbox. Default label 'Search'. Icon is aria-hidden. Clear button has aria-label. The clear button only renders when the field is controlled AND onClear is passed; uncontrolled usage (the 'Empty' story) never shows a clear affordance. GlassSearchField sets its own clearable=true default but does not forward it, so GlassInput's built-in clear button is bypassed.
api: forwardRef to HTMLInputElement and extends GlassInputProps, so it gets className/style passthrough. Clear behaviour is controlled-only. No Escape-to-clear and no onSearch/submit semantics.
fake_complexity: None. It is honest and small.
target: LiquidGlassSearchField (single search field), or make it a documented preset of GlassInput
justification: This is a reasonable 60-line preset, but the library ships two root-exported search fields (GlassSearchField and LiquidGlassSearchField) plus GlassIntelligentSearch. The clear button only works when the field is controlled and onClear is passed, and the role is redundant. Keep one search field as the canonical one. Implement clear internally for uncontrolled usage, add Escape-to-clear, and forward clearable correctly. No certification screenshot exists for it.

name: GlassSelect (legacy, options-array)
tests: src/components/input/GlassSelect.test.tsx (8 boilerplate tests: smoke, axe on empty select, snapshot; none open the menu or select an option)
material_impl: Mixed. The trigger is GlassButton with ~15 ad-hoc classes (glass-surface-dark/20, glass-border-white/20, glass-backdrop-blur-sm). Non-default variants wrap it in OptimizedGlass. The dropdown is OptimizedGlass plus raw Tailwind (shadow-2xl shadow-black/50, ring-white/10, bg-white/20). The repo has no Tailwind compiler, so many classes (h-10, rotate-180, bg-white/15, border-destructive/50) resolve to nothing. The intensity/depth/tint/border/animation props passed to OptimizedGlass are discarded by OptimizedGlassCore. The variantClasses and stateClasses maps are defined but never applied. The chevron and checkmark are the text glyphs '▼' and '✓'.
motion: Motion preset slideDown, reduced-motion aware via MotionFramer. The chevron rotation uses the non-existent rotate-180 class. useReducedMotion and ANIMATION are imported but unused.
a11y: Serious defects. (1) A visually hidden native <select> stays focusable alongside the trigger button, giving two tab stops and duplicate labels. (2) Options have no ids and there is no aria-activedescendant, so arrow-key 'focus' is visual only. (3) The FocusTrap wraps a list with no focusable items unless searchable is set. (4) The document mousedown outside-handler checks only triggerRef. The listbox is portalled outside the trigger, so mousedown on an option should close the menu before click fires. Mouse selection is likely broken; verify in a real browser. (5) The trigger lacks role=combobox, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant. (6) The helper/error text is not linked via aria-describedby.
api: forwardRef targets the hidden <select>, which is not the interactive element. Controlled-only: there is no defaultValue path, and the custom UI never fires native onChange, so onChange users get nothing. ...props (including the non-DOM 'label') is spread onto the <select>. className is applied twice (outer and inner wrapper). Marked @deprecated in favour of a 'Radix-based compound Select', but the compound is not Radix-based.
ssr: 'use client'. createPortal targets document.body after a mount flag. OK.
fake_complexity: Claims searchable/multi/grouping/validation states. Search and grouping work. State styling and variant styling are dead maps. 'Radix-based' replacement claim is false.
target: GlassSelectCompound (after it is rebuilt on a real listbox/combobox primitive)
justification: The legacy select is already self-declared deprecated, yet it holds the root `GlassSelect` name. It has broken focus semantics (a duplicate hidden select), mouse selection likely broken by its outside-click handler, controlled-only state, dead variant/state maps, and text-glyph chevrons. Tests never open it. It should become a thin adapter over the compound select, with options mapped to Item children, for one major version, and then be removed. The certification screenshot could not be visually inspected in this run (the image reader returned nothing). Certification marked it 'passed' after inspecting only the storybook-default-dark theme.

name: GlassSelectCompound (GlassSelectRoot/Trigger/Content/Item/Value/Label/Group/Separator/ScrollUp/ScrollDown)
material_impl: Bespoke. Uses no OptimizedGlass/LiquidGlass. The content uses raw 'glass-backdrop-blur-lg bg-white/10 ring-1 ring-white/15 shadow-2xl shadow-black/40' plus tailwindcss-animate classes (animate-in, zoom-in-95, slide-in-from-top-2). Those animate classes do not exist in this repo, which has no Tailwind compiler. The trigger uses glass-surface-subtle/10 and focus:ring-primary. The error state is hard-coded border-red-400 (undefined class). The material does not match the rest of the library.
motion: Motion preset scaleIn (reduced-motion aware). The tailwind-animate data-state classes are dead.
a11y: Better skeleton than the legacy select: role=combobox, aria-expanded/controls, role=listbox/option, aria-selected, typeahead on the trigger. Gaps: (1) no arrow-key navigation inside the listbox. Items are tabIndex -1, focus never moves into content, data-highlighted is never set, and Home/End are absent. (2) The trigger hard-codes aria-label='Select option', which overrides the visible GlassSelectValue text and any external <label>. (3) ScrollUp/ScrollDown 'buttons' always render, are aria-hidden and do nothing. (4) DismissableLayer dismisses on pointerdown on the trigger, then the trigger click toggles open again, so clicking the trigger to close it re-opens the menu. (5) Escape does not restore focus to the trigger. (6) Items register labels only when content is mounted, so typeahead and defaultValue labels do not work until the menu has been opened once.
api: Clean Radix-like API shape with controlled/uncontrolled value and open state, name with a hidden input, and forwardRef on parts. But the root export naming is confusing: `GlassSelect` (root) is the legacy component, while this one is `GlassSelectRoot`/`GlassSelectCompound`, and the file-internal name is also GlassSelect. position/variant props are accepted and ignored (variant: _variant).
ssr: 'use client'. The Portal primitive is used. Fine.
fake_complexity: The doc comment in the legacy file calls it 'Radix-based'. It is hand-rolled. The scroll buttons are decorative fakes.
target: Canonical AuraGlass 5 Select built on primitives/roving-focus + positioning, with a shared Liquid material listbox surface
justification: The compound API is the right shape and is the obvious foundation for the single 5.0 select. The internals are not production grade: no in-list keyboard navigation, an anchor-dismiss toggle bug, a hard-coded aria-label, dead scroll buttons, and dead Tailwind animation classes. Its material does not use the library's own glass primitive. A premium select is a flagship surface in any glass system (Apple's pop-up menus are its most recognisable 'material' moment). Rebuild it on RovingFocusGroup/Positioner, render content through LiquidGlassMaterial, and make it the only select with legacy GlassSelect as an adapter. Screenshot not viewable in this run.

name: GlassSlider
tests: src/components/input/GlassSlider.test.tsx (10 tests, boilerplate; no keyboard or drag tests)
material_impl: The thumb is OptimizedGlass (level3, border='glow', animation='float') with an inline background var(--glass-neutral-level3-surface). OptimizedGlassCore discards animation/intensity/depth/tint/border, so 'float' and 'glow' are no-ops. The track uses glass-surface-subtle and the fill uses glass-surface-{primary|success|danger}. The fill has a 'glass-sheen' overlay class that is not defined in any CSS. The background div repeats glass-gradient-primary three times, with a garbled class list. The 'warning' and 'info' variants reuse the primary border and info reuses the primary fill.
motion: The fill has an inline 'transition: all 150ms ease' that is not reduced-motion gated. useMotionPreferenceContext gates only the no-op float. glass-scale-110 is applied on drag.
a11y: Critical: role=slider thumbs have tabIndex=0 but no onKeyDown handler at all, so there is no Arrow/PageUp/Home/End support. Keyboard users cannot operate the slider. There is no aria-orientation. aria-label and aria-labelledby are both set, and range thumbs share the same label. announceToScreenReader fires on every pointermove, flooding screen readers. A 20px thumb is below 24/44px touch targets. The <label htmlFor> points to a div, not a labelable element.
api: forwardRef on the container. value/defaultValue are fine. onChange and onValueChange fire identically. onValueCommit uses the stale valueArray captured at pointerdown, so it commits the value from before the drag. useA11yId is called conditionally (label ? useA11yId(...) : undefined), a Rules of Hooks violation that breaks when label/description/error toggle. material, neutralValue, showTickLabels and interactionGlass are rendered only as data-attributes that no CSS reads (fake props). thumbContent, inverted and range exist.
ssr: 'use client'. Document listeners only in handlers. OK.
fake_complexity: material='liquid', interactionGlass, neutralValue and showTickLabels are advertised but inert. 'float' and 'glow' do nothing.
justification: A Liquid Glass slider (a refractive thumb that magnifies the track) is one of the most recognisable Liquid Glass controls and is flagship material. The current one fails basic WCAG because there is no keyboard operation at all. It also violates hook rules, commits stale values, floods the live region, and advertises four inert props. Rebuild it on pointer capture with keyboard support (step/page/home/end), aria-orientation and a single debounced announcement. Use a real LiquidGlassMaterial thumb and token-driven fill, and drop the fake props. Screenshot not viewable in this run.

name: GlassStep
material_impl: OptimizedGlass (intent/elevation/tier) per step, wrapped in Motion. Hover uses 'hover:bg-glass-light-primary/5 glass-hover-scale-1-01', which are undefined/raw classes. Each step is its own glass slab, so a stepper made of these would stack N blurred surfaces.
motion: A Motion wrapper with no preset (no-op). CSS transition-all 300ms (not gated).
a11y: role=button when clickable, else role=listitem with no list parent. A verbose aria-label duplicates the visible text. aria-current=step. Keyboard Enter/Space works when clickable.
api: Internal-shaped API: requires step/index/active/completed/orientation. The local GlassStepProps interface is dead; the component uses GlassStepInternalProps from types.ts. No composition parent consumes it: interactive/GlassStepper, GlassFormStepper and GlassWizard all render their own step markup.
fake_complexity: None, but it is an orphan building block.
target: single Stepper/Steps component (interactive/GlassStepper) with Step as a composable child
justification: This is an internal step cell that nothing in the library composes, yet it is root-exported alongside its own icon and label sub-pieces. The library already has at least five other step-indicator implementations. Fold it into one Steps component (Steps.Root/Steps.Item) with a single shared material rail rather than per-step glass slabs, and stop exporting it standalone.

name: GlassStepIcon
material_impl: OptimizedGlass circle with state classes 'bg-primary-500 border-primary-300 shadow-[0_0_12px_3px_hsl(...)]' (active) and 'bg-success-500' (completed). These Tailwind classes are not defined in the repo's CSS (no Tailwind build), so active and completed states fall back to the neutral glass surface. Hard-coded w-6/h-6.
motion: No-op Motion wrapper.
a11y: aria-hidden (correct as decoration). The 24px size is fine for decoration.
api: React.FC with no forwardRef. The props interface is not exported. `typeof icon === 'string' ? icon : icon` is a no-op branch.
fake_complexity: None.
target: internal part of consolidated Steps component
justification: This is a decorative sub-part with no consumer outside GlassStep. Its state colours depend on Tailwind classes that do not exist here, so active and completed states are visually indistinguishable unless the consumer runs Tailwind with the library in its content paths. It should not be public API.

name: GlassStepLabel
material_impl: A plain span. It imports OptimizedGlass and never uses it. Colours are hard-coded 'text-slate-950' (active) and 'text-slate-700' (completed and default are identical). These classes are not defined in repo CSS, and if Tailwind were present they would be dark-on-dark in dark themes. It accepts intent/elevation/tier and ignores them.
motion: No-op Motion wrapper.
a11y: No semantics. Completed and upcoming states differ only by nothing (identical classes).
api: React.FC with no forwardRef. intent/elevation/tier are inert props.
fake_complexity: Glass props are accepted and ignored.
duplicates: Step label markup in interactive/GlassStepper, GlassWizard, GlassFormStepper
target: internal part of consolidated Steps component
justification: This is a span with theme-breaking hard-coded slate colours (undefined in this repo), identical completed and default states, and three ignored glass props. It has no consumer besides GlassStep. Remove it from the public surface.

name: GlassStepper (input; numeric spin button)
material_impl: The +/- buttons and input well are OptimizedGlass (animation='float', depth, tint, which are all discarded). The variant colours are raw Tailwind (border-green-200/30, bg-amber-50/30, bg-blue-50/20) that do not exist in repo CSS. Inline SVG plus/minus.
motion: The Motion scaleIn preset is gated by isMotionSafe. 'float' is a no-op. glass-hover-scale-105/active:scale-95 classes are undefined. useGlassSound plays a 'tap' sound on every increment.
a11y: Input role=spinbutton with aria-valuenow/min/max and ArrowUp/Down. Buttons are divs with role=button plus Enter/Space. Issues: touch fires both onTouchStart and the synthetic onMouseDown, giving a double increment per tap. The long-press interval re-invokes an increment closure that captured the old currentValue, so holding repeats the same value instead of accumulating. There is no PageUp/Home/End. Buttons are not disabled semantically (no aria-disabled). The outer div gets id={id} while the input gets finalId, which duplicates the id when the user passes one. Every change is announced.
api: forwardRef on the inner div. ...props is destructured but never spread, so data-*/aria-*/event props are silently dropped. The name collides with the root-exported GlassStepper (interactive/GlassStepper.tsx, a progress stepper). It is semantically a NumberField, not a stepper. Conditional useA11yId calls violate hook rules.
fake_complexity: None, but there are hidden side effects (sound).
target: new GlassNumberField (built on GlassInput + spinbutton semantics)
justification: It is not exported anywhere, so it is effectively dead code with a misleading name that collides with the public progress GlassStepper.
