The behaviour has concrete bugs: double increments on touch, a long-press that does not accumulate, dropped props, duplicate ids, and hook-rule violations. It also plays sounds by default. Replace it with a properly named NumberField that reuses GlassInput, and delete this file.

name: GlassSwitch
material_impl: The track is OptimizedGlass as=button, which switches elevation level1 to level2 when checked. tint='primary', intensity and animation='shimmer' are discarded by OptimizedGlassCore. The variantConfig.track colours (bg-primary, bg-green-500, ...) are never applied, so the 'success/warning/error/info' variants change nothing visible on the track. The thumb uses bg-white (defined only under [data-glass-component]) or bg-foreground/80 (undefined), so the unchecked thumb may render without fill. The thumb is positioned with px translateX and is not vertically centred (track 24, thumb 20, no align-items). Checked travel leaves a 6px right gap versus a 2px left gap.
motion: The thumb uses CSS transition-all 200ms, not gated by reduced motion. 'shimmer' is a no-op.
a11y: role=switch with aria-checked on a real button and a label htmlFor. aria-invalid/required are set, and the error role=alert. Each toggle is announced via the live region, which duplicates the native switch state announcement. No RTL support for the thumb direction. Thumb travel is not visible in high-contrast mode because state is not conveyed by colour on the track.
api: forwardRef(HTMLButtonElement). checked/defaultChecked/onChange/onCheckedChange are fine. labelPosition, icons, loading and thumbContent exist. material='liquid' is a data-attribute only. Conditional useA11yId calls violate hook rules. When label/description/error are present, className goes to the button, not the wrapper.
fake_complexity: The variant colours and material='liquid' are inert.
justification: The Liquid Glass switch (an elongating lens thumb on a tinted track) is a signature control, and this one has a sound semantic base (a real button with role=switch). Visually it cannot express state. Track variant colours are never applied, the tint is discarded by the primitive, the thumb fill may be undefined when off, and the thumb is mis-centred with asymmetric travel. Rebuild the visuals on tokens: a tinted track fill, a centred thumb computed from padding, an RTL-aware logical transform and reduced-motion gating. Use LiquidGlassMaterial for the thumb. Keep the API.

name: GlassTextarea
material_impl: Bespoke. .glass-textarea in glass.css forces background/border with !important (rgba white 0.12/0.28 plus blur-sm). This overrides all four variant maps (bg-background/50, bg-muted/50, ...) and the state border colours, so default/filled/outlined/minimal and error/warning/success all render the same. It imports OptimizedGlass and does not use it. It uses 'glass-pulse-ring', an undefined class.
motion: loading adds animate-pulse (not reduced-motion gated). The duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms] template class cannot be generated without Tailwind.
a11y: Label htmlFor/id are correct. aria-invalid is set. Bug: when both helperText and errorText are set, aria-describedby points to the helper id, but the helper is not rendered in the error state, leaving a dangling reference and an unannounced error. The error text is styled glass-text-primary (not an error colour) and is not role=alert. The error icon and custom icon overlap at the same position (top-3 right-3). The required asterisk uses aria-label on a span.
api: forwardRef with a merged ref. autoResize, minRows/maxRows and showCharCount exist, but the char count and auto-resize work only when controlled (they depend on the value prop). Uncontrolled textareas never resize or count. className goes to the wrapper, not the textarea. The variant/state API is visually inert.
ssr: getComputedStyle only in an effect. Safe.
fake_complexity: Variants and states are fake because of the !important override.
justification: The core is acceptable and visually consistent, because the CSS override unifies everything. But the variant and state API is fake, error semantics are broken (dangling describedby, error not coloured or announced), auto-resize and char count ignore uncontrolled usage, and icons overlap. Fix these against GlassInput's field contract, preferably by sharing a FieldShell for label/helper/error. Remove the dead variants or make them real through tokens.

name: GlassTimeField
material_impl: GlassInput type=time plus a Clock icon. Shared material via GlassInput.
motion: None.
a11y: Native time input semantics, default label 'Time', icon aria-hidden. The native picker indicator is not styled for dark glass, so expect a mismatch with the browser chrome.
api: forwardRef with GlassInputProps passthrough. Honest and minimal.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: This is a correct, tiny preset over GlassInput with native semantics. Polish later by styling the native ::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator for glass themes, and add a test. No certification screenshot exists.

name: GlassToggle (+ non-exported GlassToggleGroup, GlassToggleGroupItem, useToggle, useToggleGroup)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass (level1 to level3 when pressed) plus raw classes bg-white/8, bg-white/12, bg-white/15, scale-105 and glass-hover-scale-105. Most of these are undefined in repo CSS (bg-white/8 and /12 are not even standard Tailwind steps). The pressed state therefore relies only on the elevation class change. The group container is bespoke 'bg-white/5 border-white/10'. The ghost variant uses an infinite glass-animate-pulse overlay while pressed.
motion: The Motion wrapper gets framer whileHover/whileTap (reduced-motion handled by MotionFramer). The ghost pressed state pulses forever (not gated).
a11y: Broken. It renders a <div role=button> (OptimizedGlass default element) with no tabIndex and no key handler, so it is not keyboard reachable or operable. The Motion wrapper has tabIndex=-1 and pointer-events-none. 'disabled' only short-circuits the click, with no aria-disabled, and the disabled: pseudo-classes do not apply to a div. aria-pressed is present.
api: forwardRef is typed HTMLButtonElement but attaches to a div. shape is a union containing a CSS class name ('glass-radius-md'). material='liquid' is a data-attribute only. Critical group bug: GlassToggleGroupItem destructures `value` and does not forward it, so GlassToggle's `'value' in props` check is always false. The item is also controlled via `pressed` with no onPressedChange, so clicking a group item does nothing; the group's onValueChange never fires. The story uses exactly this path. GlassToggleGroup/Item are not exported from root or the input index, so they are unreachable for consumers anyway.
fake_complexity: The toggle group looks functional in the story but is inert.
target: src/components/toggle-button/ToggleButton + ToggleButtonGroup (rebuilt on a real <button> + RovingFocusGroup), rendered inside LiquidGlassControlGroup
justification: This toggle is not keyboard accessible: a div role=button with no tabIndex or key handling. Its group variant is functionally dead because `value` is dropped, and its pressed styling depends on non-existent classes. A separate toggle-button family already exists. Merge into one ToggleButton/ToggleButtonGroup on a native button with roving focus, and remove GlassToggle (or alias it) in 5.0.

name: GlassTransferList
material_impl: An outer OptimizedGlass (elevation prop). The inner lists, search inputs and buttons use raw bg-white/5, bg-white/10, hover:bg-white/5 and active:bg-white/20 (the /5 and /10 classes are defined only under [data-glass-component]). Native unstyled checkboxes. Inline SVG chevrons. A <style> tag is injected per instance for the mobile column layout.
motion: duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms] template classes cannot exist without Tailwind. Effectively there is no motion.
a11y: Native checkboxes inside labels are fine. Search inputs have placeholder only and no label. The lists have no role/aria-label and no aria-labelledby to their h3 titles. Bug: TransferButton is a component defined inside render, so every state change remounts the buttons. After pressing 'Move selected' with the keyboard, focus is lost to body. Item counts are not announced.
api: forwardRef. Controlled-only (value defaults to [], no defaultValue), so it is inert without onChange. 'Move all right' ignores the active search filter. minHeight/maxHeight are strings.
ssr: Safe. The inline <style> renders server-side but duplicates per instance.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassMultiSelect (or a later rebuilt pattern in a workflows recipe)
justification: It is not exported anywhere, so it is dead to consumers. Transfer lists are an outdated enterprise pattern that conflicts with a premium glass aesthetic. The implementation loses keyboard focus on every move, has unlabeled search fields and unlabeled lists, and is controlled-only. Remove it from the component set. If needed later, rebuild it as a documented recipe composed from GlassCheckboxGroup and GlassSearchField.

name: GlassTreeSelect
material_impl: The trigger is raw 'bg-white/5 border glass-border-subtle hover:bg-white/10 ring-2 ring-blue-500/50' (hard-coded blue, undefined class). The dropdown is OptimizedGlass, absolutely positioned and not portalled, so it is clipped by overflow-hidden ancestors. The chevron rotation uses undefined rotate-90/rotate-180 classes. Native checkboxes.
motion: None effective (template duration classes).
a11y: Poor. There is no tree semantics (no role=tree/treeitem, aria-expanded or aria-level). Nodes are div role=button containing a nested <button> (expand) and an <input> (checkbox), which is invalid nested interactive content. The expand button has no aria-label and no aria-expanded. There is no arrow-key navigation, Escape does not close, and the trigger has no aria-haspopup/aria-expanded. The search input uses autoFocus with no label.
api: forwardRef on the wrapper. Controlled-only: value defaults to [] and onChange defaults to a no-op, so uncontrolled use is impossible. Bug: setExpandedNodes is called inside the filteredData useMemo during render, a side-effect-in-render that triggers React warnings and extra renders on every keystroke. The trigger shows labels joined by commas, with no chips or overflow handling.
fake_complexity: None.
target: compose canonical Select popover + tree-view/TreeView (role=tree) as a TreeSelect recipe
justification: It is unexported and lacks tree ARIA. It nests interactive elements, mutates state during render, is not portalled, and hard-codes blue. The library already has three tree implementations, one of them (tree-view/TreeView) with proper role=tree. Rebuild TreeSelect as a composition of the canonical Select popover and TreeView rather than maintaining a fourth tree.

name: GlassValidationMessage
material_impl: OptimizedGlass as='p' (level1). Tone colours are 'text-red-800', 'text-amber-900' and 'text-emerald-800'. None of these classes is defined in repo CSS (no Tailwind build), so error/warning/success render in the default text colour and are distinguishable only by icon. If Tailwind were present, the dark 800/900 shades would fail contrast on dark glass. Putting a glass slab behind every field message adds a blur layer per field.
motion: None.
a11y: error uses role=alert and the other tones role=status. The icon is aria-hidden. The tone is not conveyed in text (no visually hidden 'Error:' prefix), so it relies on colour, which is also missing. The id is not auto-wired to the field's aria-describedby.
api: forwardRef(HTMLParagraphElement), className passthrough, tone and icon override. Simple and clean.
fake_complexity: None.
duplicates: Inline error/helper text in GlassInput, GlassTextarea, GlassSelect, GlassSwitch and GlassSlider (each re-implements it)
justification: This is the right primitive and should become the single message renderer used by every field, instead of each field duplicating error markup. Replace the undefined Tailwind tone classes with semantic tokens (--glass-status-danger-fg, etc.) that meet contrast on all themes. Add a visually hidden tone prefix, and drop the glass slab by default (inline text plus icon), keeping it as an opt-in variant. No certification screenshot exists.

name: GlassWizard (+ non-exported GlassWizardStep, GlassWizardStepper, useWizard)
material_impl: Composes GlassCard, CardHeader/Content, GlassProgress and GlassButton (shared primitives, good). The step pills use raw 'bg-primary/20 text-primary-foreground border-primary/40' and 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400', which are undefined classes, so state is conveyed only by the icon swap. The step content is forced to 'text-slate-950', which is undefined here and theme-breaking if Tailwind exists. GlassWizardStepper is entirely raw Tailwind (bg-green-500, w-10 h-10, w-12 h-0.5) and renders unstyled without Tailwind.
motion: Motion fadeIn and slideIn per step (keyed, reduced-motion aware). OK.
a11y: Step nav is a <nav> of buttons with aria-current=step, which is good. aria-label overrides the visible title. The step error is role=alert. Focus is not moved to the new step heading on navigation. Step titles are hidden below sm via 'glass-hidden sm:glass-inline', leaving number-only pills on mobile.
api: Not forwardRef. With a controlled currentStep and no onStepChange the wizard is frozen, and both stories do exactly that (currentStep: 0 / 1 without a handler). The top step nav lets users jump forward past unvalidated intermediate steps: it validates only the current step and ignores allowSkip. The useWizard fallback returns a different shape (nextStep/previousStep/totalSteps) from the real context (goToNext/goToPrevious), so the TypeScript union is inconsistent. wizardData/setData exist, but steps have no ergonomic access because step content is static ReactNode. validationMode='onChange' is effectively the same as onNext. Error messages are hard-coded English strings.
fake_complexity: Claims 'comprehensive features'. Validation is a boolean callback with a hard-coded generic error string. GlassWizardStep is a no-op div that ignores its step prop.
target: one Wizard/MultiStepForm in the ./workflows subpath, using the consolidated Steps component
justification: At least five overlapping multi-step implementations exist (GlassWizard, GlassMultiStepForm, GlassFormStepper, GlassWizardTemplate, GlassFormWizardSteps). This one composes real primitives, but its state is undermined by undefined classes. It permits skipping validation through the step nav, has a frozen controlled mode in its own stories, ships an inconsistent useWizard fallback, and has a no-op GlassWizardStep. Pick one wizard and give it step-scoped data/validation via render props or context. Move focus on step change, use token-driven step states and the shared Steps component.

name: LiquidGlassControlGroup
material_impl: Shared Liquid primitives: LiquidGlassMaterial (material='liquid', variant regular/clear, radius full) wrapping LiquidGlassEffectGroup. This is the correct material architecture. However, the story overrides the group's background, border and box-shadow with !important CSS, and the child buttons are unstyled story buttons. The certified look therefore comes from story CSS, not the component.
motion: None of its own (it depends on LiquidGlassEffectGroup).
a11y: No role=group/toolbar or aria-orientation. rovingFocus defaults to true but is only emitted as data-roving-focus. No keyboard handling exists, even though primitives/RovingFocusGroup exists in the repo. selectionMode is only data-selection-mode, with no aria-pressed/checked management.
api: forwardRef with className passthrough. orientation works (flex-col). density, selectionMode and rovingFocus are inert data-attributes that no CSS or JS reads.
fake_complexity: The rovingFocus, selectionMode and density props promise behaviour that does not exist.
justification: This is the one component in the shard that uses the intended Liquid material stack (LiquidGlassMaterial + LiquidGlassEffectGroup), and a segmented/toolbar control group is a core Liquid Glass flagship (merged lenses). But its behavioural props are fakes. Wire RovingFocusGroup, role=toolbar/radiogroup by selectionMode, aria-orientation and managed pressed/checked state, and make density real. Move the story's !important look into the component, then make it the base for ToggleButtonGroup and segmented controls. No certification screenshot exists.

name: ContextAwareGlass

stories.note: Default story passes no children/args; renders an empty surface

material_impl: Wraps OptimizedGlass (primitives/OptimizedGlassCore). All 'adaptation' is mapped to elevation (blur buckets) and intensity (opacity buckets) - but OptimizedGlassCore destructures and discards `intensity` (OptimizedGlassCore.tsx:154,249), so only the 4 elevation buckets do anything. Adds bespoke boxShadow/filter drop-shadow inline; default glowColor '#6366F1' hard-coded.
motion: No animation. useReducedMotion only caps blur and disables drop-shadow glow (ContextAwareGlass.tsx:543,642) - a reduced-motion pref used for a non-motion concern.
a11y: No role/semantics (plain div). Debug overlay uses bg-white/70 text-black etc. 'contrast' mode only nudges opacity buckets; no real contrast measurement.
api: forwardRef with merged ref. Props interface doesn't extend HTMLAttributes so `...rest` is effectively empty (no style passthrough, style is overwritten). 20+ props (min/max blur/opacity, forceLight/Dark) mostly have no visible effect.
ssr: 'use client'. DOM access only in effects/callbacks. Optional setInterval polling (adaptationInterval 1000ms) re-runs querySelectorAll + getComputedStyle.
fake_complexity: High. 'Context-aware' = querySelectorAll counts + parent getComputedStyle backgroundColor parse; computed blur/opacity values then collapse to 4 elevation buckets and a discarded intensity prop. hex parser ignores 3-digit hex; rgba alpha ignored.
target: OptimizedGlass / GlassCard (adaptive contrast belongs in the material primitive)
justification: Not exported from root, duplicates advanced/GlassContextAware, and its core promise is hollow: the adaptation math feeds an `intensity` prop the primitive throws away, so the only output is a choice among 4 elevation classes. The certified screenshot has no ink at all (darkest pixel 228/255): it is an empty pale rectangle on a near-white gradient. If background-adaptive legibility is wanted for 5.0 it should be a real luminance-sampling capability inside the material primitive, not a wrapper.
visual_review_method: Read tool returned empty for PNGs in this session; visual judged from pixel analysis of desktop/mobile PNGs (luminance histogram, ink bbox, edge density) plus certification inspection JSON. All captures sit on a near-white (#fff->#eaeaea) gradient where neutral glass has almost no visible material.

name: CursorGlow
material_impl: Bespoke: radial-gradient written to element.style.background in rAF, plus filter blur(size/16) saturate() and mix-blend-mode: screen. Builds color as `${color}${toAlpha(opacity)}` - with the default color 'var(--glass-white)' this yields 'var(--glass-white)2e', an invalid CSS value, so the gradient never paints with defaults (CursorGlow.tsx:46,82). Works only for 6-digit hex colors.
motion: rAF-throttled pointermove (good). Reduced motion: listener not attached when reduce && respectMotionPreference (CursorGlow.tsx:74) - correctly wired.
a11y: aria-hidden unless aria-label given; pointer-events none. OK for decoration; role=img with label on a decorative overlay is questionable.
api: forwardRef. Declares intent/elevation/tier props that are not destructured and get spread onto the DOM div (unknown-attribute warnings). In non-global mode it uses clientX/clientY against an absolutely positioned element - offset is wrong whenever the container is not at viewport origin.
ssr: 'use client'; window access in effect only. Fine.

name: GlassA11yAuditor
material_impl: OptimizedGlass panels (intensity/blur props passed but discarded by primitive). Raw Tailwind palette classes for status (text-green-400, bg-red-500/10, ring-white/50) mixed with glass-* utilities; injected <style> with hard-coded #ff6b6b/#ff4444 outline.

a11y: role='application' on the whole panel (wrong; disables browse mode). Filter buttons lack aria-pressed. Issues list is buttons (good). Score colour-only. Ironically lists 'color-contrast' and 'keyboard-navigation' rules in defaultRules but implements neither.
api: forwardRef but ref goes to inner div while className is applied twice (Motion wrapper and inner). `id || useA11yId()` is a conditional hook call. Audits the entire `document`, not `children`, despite children prop.
ssr: 'use client'; document access only in callbacks. Fine.
fake_complexity: Medium. A real but naive DOM heuristic scanner: focus-visible check inspects non-focused computed outline (meaningless), aria-label rule flags every [role] element, highlight picks the first element of the same tag name rather than the offending node. useA11yAudit only checks img alt. axe-core would do all of this correctly.
target: Docs/devtools package backed by axe-core, not the design-system runtime bundle
justification: A homemade accessibility linter shipped inside a UI kit is a liability: its heuristics produce false positives/negatives, it audits the whole document regardless of children, and it is itself mis-roled (role=application). This is not a visual component a premium design system needs; if kept at all it belongs in a Storybook addon powered by axe-core.

a11y: Mouse-only: no keyboard drag (space to lift, arrows to move), no touch/pointer events, no aria-grabbed/live-region announcements, handle not focusable. GlassSortable similarly HTML5-DnD-only, which never works on touch.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef. Core bug: handleMouseDown registers the handleMouseMove/handleMouseUp from the render where isDragging===false, and both early-return on !isDragging (GlassDraggable.tsx:126-157) - the element never moves, mouseup never clears state, listeners leak, ghost stays. GlassDraggable uses mouse events while GlassDroppable reads HTML5 dataTransfer - they cannot interoperate; GlassDroppable JSON.parse(getData()) on dragover throws because data is empty/protected during dragover (:288-290). DragProvider/useDragContext unused by the components. GlassSortable/GlassDroppable/DragProvider not root-exported.
fake_complexity: High: the root-exported GlassDraggable does not actually drag.
target: dnd-kit-based GlassSortable/Draggable recipes (keyboard sensor, pointer sensor, announcements) with a glass 'lifted' material state
justification: The headline component is non-functional due to stale closures, the droppable throws on dragover, and the pieces use incompatible event models. It has no glass material and zero accessibility. Rebuild on dnd-kit (or a pointer-events + keyboard sensor implementation) and contribute only the visual lifted/drop-target states from the design system.
visual_review_method: Read tool returned empty for PNGs in this session; visual judged from pixel analysis of desktop/mobile PNGs (luminance histogram, ink bbox, edge density) plus certification inspection JSON. All captures sit on a near-white (#fff->#eaeaea) gradient where neutral glass has almost no visible material.

name: GlassDrawingCanvas
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell plus redundant glass-backdrop-blur-md and border classes stacked on top (lines 457-463, 602-611). The canvas itself has a hard-coded bg-white class (line 639), so the drawing surface is an opaque white box inside the glass and backgroundColor is mostly ignored visually. Grid strokeStyle uses color-mix(var(--glass-white)) (line 161) and the default pen color is var(--glass-black) (line 84). Canvas 2D cannot resolve CSS variables, so both fall back to the default black or are ignored.
motion: Motion fadeIn, gated on isMotionSafe && respectMotionPreference (line 617). useReducedMotion is imported but never used (line 17). Sound effects via useGlassSound on every stroke, undo, and clear.
a11y: Tool buttons have aria-labels, but their 'icons' are single letters such as 'P' or 'B' (line 484). Undo, Redo, Clear, and Export rely on title only and render unicode or emoji (↶ ↷ 🗑 💾, lines 572-594), so they have no accessible name beyond title. The canvas has no role, label, or keyboard alternative. focus:ring-primary/50 is a non-prefixed class.
api: forwardRef, className passthrough. tool is an initial-only value: it seeds state and is never re-synced. data is uncontrolled after mount. The pressureSensitive prop is unused.
ssr: 'use client'. Canvas and Image access happen only in effects. No heavy imports.
fake_complexity: Partly fake. The line, rectangle, circle, and text tool types are offered but every tool draws freehand polylines; there is no shape logic (drawStroke lines 205-256). pressureSensitive is a no-op. Export 'svg' calls canvas.toDataURL('image/svg'), which returns a PNG (line 445). The eraser uses destination-out, which also erases the background colour or image.
duplicates: none direct; overlaps the canvas/trail logic in GlassGestureZone
justification: Not exported from the root, so it is not part of the public API. Half of its advertised tools are fake (shape and text tools just draw freehand). Toolbar icons are letters and emoji. The canvas is a fixed-pixel (800x600) opaque white rectangle that breaks mobile layouts, and the SVG export is mislabelled. Making it real (shape tools, vector export, a responsive DPR-aware canvas, keyboard access) is a product in itself and out of scope for a glass design system. Keep it as an internal demo or remove it.

name: GlassFacetSearch
material_impl: Outer shell is a bespoke elevation map of utility classes (glass-backdrop-blur-md glass-surface-dark/30 border white/12, lines 245-250) rather than the shared primitive. Only the suggestions dropdown uses OptimizedGlass. A hard-coded inline color rgba(255,255,255,0.95) on facet labels (line 552) makes the text invisible on light themes.
motion: framer-motion AnimatePresence. Reduced-motion handling is broken: initial={{opacity:0}} combined with animate={prefersReducedMotion ? {} : {...}} (lines 314-315, 376-377, 435, 452, 567) leaves any element mounted while reduced motion is active stuck at opacity 0 or height 0. Facet panels, suggestions, and results become invisible for exactly the users who asked for less motion. useReducedMotion starts false and flips after mount (src/hooks/useReducedMotion.ts:15), so elements mounted later are affected.
a11y: role=search on the root. The suggestions list is not a combobox or listbox: there is no aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant, or arrow-key navigation. Result rows are clickable motion.divs with no role, tabIndex, or key handler (lines 449-460), so results cannot be selected by keyboard. The 'select' facet type renders checkboxes for a single choice (lines 643-659) where radio buttons are needed. The clear button has no type and default text sizing.
api: forwardRef, className and ...props passthrough. Mostly controlled (query, facetValues). The variant, size, and elevation naming is local and not shared with the system. handleFacetChange fires an un-cancelled setTimeout(300) per change (line 209), so rapid changes trigger N stale onSearch calls. It also has no unmount cleanup. Index keys are used for suggestions.
ssr: 'use client'. framer-motion is imported. No window access at module scope.
fake_complexity: No AI claims. The debounce is fake (a setTimeout without clearTimeout).
duplicates: GlassFilterPanel (same checkbox/slider/daterange facet renderer, near copy-paste)
target: GlassSearch (combobox) + GlassFilterPanel (single facet engine)
justification: This duplicates GlassFilterPanel's facet rendering almost line for line, and other parts of the library already provide search. The reduced-motion pattern hides content, results are mouse-only, the debounce leaks timers, and single-select facets use checkboxes. Rebuild it as a composition: a proper ARIA combobox search field, a shared facet engine for filters, and a results list. It should not remain a standalone 675-line monolith.

name: GlassFileExplorer
material_impl: Triple-defined material. The elevation class map (lines 400-405) is then overridden by inline linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.05)...), border rgba(255,255,255,0.14), and box-shadow literals (lines 419-430), so the elevation prop has no visual effect. Rows use OptimizedGlass level1 interactive. Selection uses glass-ring-blue-400 and ring-blue-400/40 together (lines 601-617), mixing prefixed and unprefixed classes.
motion: framer-motion. Same broken reduced-motion pattern (initial opacity 0, animate {} at lines 594-597): after navigating folders with reduced motion on, newly mounted rows stay invisible.
a11y: role=region with a label. Rows are OptimizedGlass divs with onClick only: no role=grid/row/option, no tabIndex, no keyboard selection or open. The per-row 'More options' button is opacity-0 until hover (line 727), so keyboard users can't see it, and it only performs 'open' rather than showing a menu. The create-folder 'dialog' is a fixed div with no role=dialog, focus trap, or Escape handling (lines 746-782).
api: forwardRef, style merged. Selection, viewMode, and search are controlled. onFileCopy is declared but never called. The download action is an empty case (line 248). Delete is only reachable through code paths no UI calls: handleContextMenuAction is only ever invoked with 'open'.
ssr: 'use client'. document.createElement runs only in the drag handler.
fake_complexity: Rename and delete UI is unreachable: no UI path calls handleContextMenuAction('rename'/'delete'). The context menu is a stub that comments 'could be expanded to show a menu' (line 730).
duplicates: GlassFileTree (same icon map, formatFileSize, drag ghost, create dialog copy-pasted)
justification: The concept is valid for an app-grade glass system, but the implementation is a facade. The context menu is a stub, rename and delete can't be reached, the rows have no keyboard model, and the dialog is not a dialog. The material is defined three times with inline rgba overriding the elevation API. Rebuild it on a shared FileItem model with the library's Menu, Dialog, and roving-tabindex grid, and share the icon and size utilities with GlassFileTree.

name: GlassFileTree
material_impl: Bespoke utility-class elevation map (lines 385-390). No shared primitive: the create dialog is hand-rolled glass-surface-subtle/5 with a ring.
motion: framer-motion height/opacity expand using the same broken reduced-motion pattern (lines 520-525): with reduced motion on, expanded children mount at height 0 and opacity 0 and are never shown, so the tree cannot be expanded at all for those users.
a11y: No role=tree/treeitem/group, no aria-expanded, no aria-level, and no arrow-key navigation. The expand chevron GlassButton has no aria-label and is 16x16 px (line 429) even though it carries the glass-touch-target class. The context-menu button has no label and an empty onClick (lines 504-514). Rows are clickable divs.
api: forwardRef, but GlassFileTreeProps does not extend HTMLAttributes, yet ...props is spread. The virtualize prop is unused. allowRename, allowCopy, and allowMove are dead: handleContextMenuAction is never called, so rename and create can't be reached. The copy and move branches are empty comments (lines 169-178).
fake_complexity: 'virtualize', rename, create, copy, and move are advertised but unimplemented or unreachable. TreeNodeComponent is declared inside render (line 392), so every parent render remounts the whole subtree: state is lost, the rename input loses focus, and drag state breaks.
target: GlassTreeView (single WAI-ARIA tree with file-icon renderer preset)
justification: This is the third tree implementation in the library. It is inaccessible (no tree roles or arrow keys) and has an architectural bug: a component defined in render, which remounts the subtree on every render. Several allow* flags do nothing, and expansion is invisible under reduced motion. Fold its file-icon and size display into a single accessible GlassTreeView as a renderer preset, then delete this file.

name: GlassFileUpload
material_impl: OptimizedGlass (frosted, level1/2) for the dropzone and file rows. This is the correct primitive, but state colours are utility classes (glass-surface-blue/20, glass-border-red), and destructive tokens border-destructive/50 and bg-destructive/5 are unprefixed classes that likely don't exist (line 519). Icons are inline SVG paths instead of the icon set, and action icons are text glyphs ('↑', '👁', '×').
motion: Motion preset slideDown per file. useReducedMotion is imported but unused (line 19), so reduced-motion behaviour depends on the Motion primitive internals.
a11y: The dropzone is role=button with tabIndex, but there is no onKeyDown, so Enter and Space do nothing for keyboard users (lines 653-685). Errors are not announced (no aria-live). maxFiles overflow silently returns with no feedback (lines 292-294).
api: forwardRef with a reasonable controlled/uncontrolled split (files/defaultFiles). Overlapping props: variant='compact' vs compact, and variant='minimal' implies compact. showPreviews is effectively dead because file.preview is never generated (no URL.createObjectURL).
fake_complexity: Upload progress is simulated: setInterval adds +10% up to 90% regardless of real transfer (lines 340-353), and it mutates objects in place. In controlled mode the progress writes go to internalFiles, which is never displayed. 'Upload All' calls handleUpload for each file with a stale visibleFiles closure, so concurrent commits overwrite each other and only the last file reaches 'completed' (lines 751-755). Math.random IDs.
duplicates: src/components/input/GlassFileUpload.tsx (518 lines, separate component with the same name and its own screenshot)
target: single GlassFileUpload / Dropzone (merge with src/components/input/GlassFileUpload.tsx)
justification: File upload is a core component every product needs, and this one uses the right primitive. But two components share the same name, the progress bar is fake, batch upload has a race condition, and the dropzone can't be operated from the keyboard. Merge both into one Dropzone with real progress callbacks (onUpload(file, {onProgress})), object-URL previews, aria-live errors, and key handling. It can then be a solid KEEP-tier component.

name: GlassFilterBar
material_impl: Plain utility classes (glass-bg-white/8, border white/10). Translucent fill only, with no blur, no primitive, and no shadow or specular edge, so it is a flat translucent strip.
motion: None.
a11y: role=region with aria-label, an aria-hidden icon, and remove buttons labelled per filter. The remove 'x' button is a literal lowercase x with px-1 padding, giving a roughly 16 px target that fails the 24/44 px target guidance. It has no focus-visible class.
api: forwardRef, HTMLAttributes passthrough, a small and clean prop surface. Its filter chips should reuse the library's GlassChip/Tag rather than ad-hoc spans.
fake_complexity: None. It does what it says.
justification: This is the most honest component in the shard: small, typed, forwardRef, with no fake features. It needs to compose the system's chip/tag component (with a proper dismiss icon and 24 px+ targets), adopt the shared glass surface primitive instead of a flat bg-white/8, and gain a test and a visual certification target. Positioned as the 'active filters' row that pairs with GlassFilterPanel.

name: GlassFilterPanel
material_impl: Contradictory material. The class map applies glass-surface-dark/50 for every elevation (lines 223-228), then an inline style overrides the background with rgba(255,255,255,0.26/0.28/0.32) (lines 246-251). The result is a white-ish panel whose 'dark' classes are dead. Hard-coded maxWidth 28rem.
motion: Correct reduced-motion pattern here (initial={prefersReducedMotion ? false : {opacity:0}}, lines 380, 416). This is the only file in the shard that does it right, which shows the bug elsewhere is copy-paste drift.
a11y: Group toggles are buttons, but they have no aria-expanded or aria-controls and no type. The preset 'dialog' is a fixed div with no role, focus trap, or Escape handling (lines 441-472). Apply is disabled unless filters are active, which blocks applying an intentionally empty state. The 'required' marker is a bare '*' with no text alternative.
api: forwardRef, but its props don't extend HTMLAttributes while ...props is spread. Controlled values/onChange. contained and compact silently drop all groups except the first (line 204, slice(0,1)) and truncate options to 3 (line 509). This is a surprising data-loss behaviour, built to make screenshots fit.
fake_complexity: Compact mode hides real filter groups for presentation. The '+N more' text is not interactive.
target: canonical facet/filter engine absorbing GlassFacetSearch facets
justification: This is the better of the two facet implementations and should become the canonical one. It needs a single material source (drop the inline rgba overrides), proper disclosure semantics, the library Dialog for presets, and removal of the compact-mode group truncation, which exists only to make screenshots fit. Paired with GlassFilterBar it forms a coherent filtering family.

name: GlassFocusRing
material_impl: CSS module (GlassFocusRing.module.css) with a ::before ring using CSS vars and blur. The ring has z-index:-1, so it renders behind any parent with a background or stacking context and can be invisible on glass cards.
motion: CSS opacity transition driven by --glass-focus-duration. There is no prefers-reduced-motion rule, but the change is minor (opacity only).
a11y: Harmful pattern. The wrapper div gets tabIndex=0 (line 73) around an already focusable child, creating a double tab stop with an unlabelled, roleless focusable div. useGlassFocus attaches 'focus' (not focusin) and treats relatedTarget as meaning keyboard, which is an unreliable heuristic (src/hooks/extended/useGlassFocus.ts handleFocus). When multiple children are passed they are wrapped in an aria-hidden span (line 32), hiding the focusable content from assistive tech.
api: Not forwardRef. GlassFocusRingProps advertises target, width, ringStyle (solid/dashed/dotted/glow), and shape, none of which are used (component lines 16-26 versus src/components/interactive/types.ts:386-411). It is not a Slot/asChild, which this kind of component needs.
fake_complexity: ringStyle and shape are fake props. The 'animated' claim amounts to an opacity fade.
target: token-driven :focus-visible ring in the base glass styles + optional asChild FocusRing Slot
justification: A focus-ring wrapper that adds an extra tab stop and can hide its children from assistive technology makes accessibility worse. Three focus-indicator components exist. The premium answer is one token-driven :focus-visible ring baked into every interactive primitive (outline plus specular halo that works on glass), optionally exposed as an asChild Slot. Replace this component and its siblings with that.

name: GlassFormBuilder
material_impl: Composes GlassCard per section and the library inputs, which is the right approach. Several layout classes are unprefixed Tailwind ('flex items-center justify-between', 'font-semibold text-foreground', 'cursor-pointer', 'w-full', lines 536, 544, 593). There is no Tailwind config in the repo, and these classes only partly exist in storybook-utility-shim.css (shipped through src/styles/index.css:25), so layout depends on a Storybook shim.
motion: Motion slideDown per section, with no explicit reduced-motion handling.
a11y: Inputs are labelled through library components. The radio group uses a <label> as a group title instead of fieldset/legend (lines 443-451). The collapsible section header is a clickable div with a nested GlassButton that has no onClick (it relies on bubbling, lines 591-633). The submit has a redundant aria-label. Errors are not linked to an error summary on submit.
api: forwardRef<HTMLForm>, but the props don't extend form attributes while ...props is spread. values and errors seed state only and never re-sync (lines 208-209), so it is not truly controlled. autoSave calls onSubmit (line 258), conflating autosave with submit. The 'file' field type is declared but renders null (lines 28, 476). The pattern string is compiled into a RegExp on every validation.
fake_complexity: The conditional logic and validation are real but minimal. The 'wizard' variant only changes the gap size; there are no steps.
target: GlassForm + GlassFormField (schema renderer as a thin helper)
justification: This is one of at least seven form or wizard implementations. The 'wizard' variant is fake, the file type renders nothing, the controlled API is broken, autosave triggers submit, and layout depends on a Storybook utility shim. Keep at most a thin schema-to-GlassFormField renderer layered on the canonical GlassForm, then remove the rest.

name: GlassGallery
material_impl: GlassCard variant=elevated per tile with glass-sheen and glass-tilt. The lightbox is a glass-surface-dark/90 div. The aspect-ratio and grid-column classes are unprefixed Tailwind ('aspect-square', 'aspect-[3/4]', 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-${n}', lines 132-147). These classes do not exist in the shipped CSS (only .glass-aspect-square and .glass-grid-cols-2 exist in src/styles/glass.css:3782, 3965), and the template-literal column classes could never be generated. The responsive grid and aspect ratios don't work: tiles fall back to .grid with no template (one column) in the shim.
motion: CSS glass-animate-fade-in and slide-in-up with staggered delays. There is no reduced-motion gating at the component level. The image scale on hover uses a non-existent group-hover class.
a11y: A transparent overlay button carries the image label (good). The lightbox has no role=dialog, aria-modal, focus trap, or Escape handler of its own; it relies on GlassImageViewer's global window listener. Like and Share buttons are no-ops (lines 342-358) with misleading labels. The list layout stacks an empty full-size button above the image (lines 386-400), which breaks the layout.
api: Not forwardRef, and the props don't extend HTMLAttributes while ...props is spread. The layout prop ('masonry') is ignored, because view mode is internal state initialised to 'grid' (line 124). The lightbox index comes from the filtered list but indexes the unfiltered images[] (lines 211, 494), so filtering opens the wrong image. The lightbox stacks its own prev/next buttons over GlassImageViewer's, so there are two sets of navigation.
fake_complexity: Masonry is advertised but not implemented. Like and Share are fake.
justification: A glass media gallery could be a showcase, but this one has dead responsive and aspect classes, so the 'grid' isn't really a grid. Masonry is fake, Like and Share do nothing, the lightbox opens the wrong image after filtering and shows duplicate navigation, and the list layout is broken. Rebuild it on prefixed tokens and CSS grid with a real Dialog-based lightbox, composing GlassLazyImage tiles. ImageList should either merge in or be removed.

name: GlassGestureZone
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shells with redundant blur and border classes. The canvas uses hard-coded #FF6B6B and #4ADE80 and 'white' (lines 649, 663, 684). trailColor defaults to 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))' (line 113), which Canvas 2D cannot parse, so the trail falls back to black. Unprefixed bg-green-500/20 and text-red-400 classes.
motion: A permanent requestAnimationFrame loop redraws the canvas every frame even when idle (lines 716-729). Two setInterval(16 ms) loops call setState with freshly mapped arrays forever (lines 567-600), so the component re-renders around 120 times a second while idle, even with empty arrays. The trail is hidden under reduced motion, but the loops keep running.
a11y: The controls look interactive but are dead. The 'Active' button has onClick={() => {}}, and the sensitivity slider and all three checkboxes have onChange={() => {}} (lines 765-832), so they are controlled inputs that cannot change. The canvas has no keyboard alternative. A hard-coded id 'gesture-sensitivity' collides across instances.
api: forwardRef. aria-label and data-testid are read from props and then also spread. maxGestureDuration, recognitionTimeout, and maxTouches are unused.
fake_complexity: The 'Gesture recognition' uses naive DTW against hard-coded templates. 'tap' and 'double_tap' are identical single-point templates, so double-tap can never be distinguished. 'pinch' is a three-point horizontal line, not a two-pointer pinch. Its 10 stories make a dead-control demo look feature-rich.
justification: Not exported publicly. Its controls are dead, its gesture recognition is cosmetic (tap and double-tap are the same template, and 'pinch' is a line), and it burns CPU with an always-on rAF loop plus two 60 Hz setState intervals. Fixed pixel sizes break mobile. It duplicates MultiDimensionalGestureRecognizer. Nothing here belongs in a premium design system. If gesture support is needed, expose a headless usePointerGesture hook built on the existing gesturePhysics.

name: GlassGradientPicker
material_impl: GlassCard plus ContrastGuard wrappers around nearly every heading (ContrastGuard overuse). Stop rows use unprefixed 'flex items-center border-primary bg-primary/20 border-white/20 bg-white/5' (lines 467-470). The default stops are near-white rgba (lines 112-115), so the out-of-box preview is a barely visible white-on-white swatch, consistent with the low-contrast certification capture.
motion: Motion fadeIn. useReducedMotion is imported but unused (line 18).
a11y: Range and colour inputs have aria-labels, and presets are role=button with key handling (good). Stop rows are clickable divs. The icons are semantically wrong: the Upload icon means 'Add stop' and the Download icon means 'Remove stop' (lines 456, 513).
api: Not forwardRef. The value prop is ignored, so it cannot be controlled. onChange never fires for manual angle, type, or stop edits; only presets and random do. On those paths it receives a stale gradient string, because generateGradient reads the previous state (lines 232-233, 255-256). stops.sort() mutates React state in place (line 171). Index keys are used for stops.
ssr: 'use client'. navigator.clipboard is used only in a handler.
fake_complexity: Preset swatches build invalid CSS for radial and conic types ('radial-gradient(0deg, ...)', line 561), so the Mist and Graphite presets render transparent. The random colour generator can produce fewer than 6 hex digits (line 242). Reset restores different colours (#7CD3FF/#A78BFA) than the initial state.
justification: A gradient picker is useful for theme tooling, but this one cannot be controlled, doesn't emit changes for most edits, emits stale values otherwise, renders broken preset swatches, and uses inverted icon semantics. Rebuild it on GlassColorPicker with a draggable stop track, a controlled value of {type, angle, stops}, and a deterministic CSS serializer, or drop it from the core package.

name: GlassImageViewer
material_impl: GlassCard shell with glass-surface-dark/50 blur overlays for the info and dots bars. Many layout classes are unprefixed and missing from the shipped CSS ('aspect-video', 'object-contain', 'bg-black/20', 'h-screen', 'fixed inset-0 z-50 rounded-none', lines 439-513), so the stage has no intrinsic aspect ratio and objectFit does nothing. The dots bar uses 'glass--left-1-2' (line 705), a typo for left-1/2, so it is mispositioned.
motion: The autoplay correctly stops under reduced motion (line 391) and the spinner is gated (line 483). The transform transition class is unprefixed.
a11y: Controls are labelled GlassButtons (good). The keyboard handler is a global window keydown (lines 302-357): arrows, +, -, 0, and R are hijacked page-wide, including while the user types in inputs elsewhere, and multiple viewers or the Gallery lightbox respond simultaneously. The fullscreen mode is not the Fullscreen API and has no focus trap. Dot buttons are 8 px. Pan is mouse-only, with no touch or pointer support.
api: Not forwardRef, and the props don't extend HTMLAttributes while ...props is spread. initialIndex is not re-synced. The wheel handler calls preventDefault on React's passive wheel listener (line 294), which is ineffective and logs a warning, so the page scrolls while zooming. During autoplay the index changes without calling onImageChange or resetting imageLoading.
ssr: 'use client'. window and document are accessed only in effects and handlers.
fake_complexity: Mostly real (zoom, rotate, pan, slideshow), but the pan maths applies translate after scale and rotate, so dragging moves in rotated or scaled space.
justification: The feature set is real and close to useful. The main blockers are fixable: the page-wide keyboard hijack (scope it to a focused container), dead unprefixed layout classes, the left-1/2 typo, the passive-wheel preventDefault, pointer events for touch pan and pinch, and Dialog-based fullscreen. After that it should become the single lightbox engine for GlassGallery.

name: GlassInfiniteScroll
material_impl: Mostly structural. The loading pill is glass-surface-subtle/10 plus blur. The container uses unprefixed 'overflow-y-auto' and 'flex flex-col-reverse' (lines 226-227), which depend on the shim.
motion: Motion fadeIn for the indicators. useReducedMotion is imported but unused (line 12). The spinner is not gated.
a11y: No aria-busy, no role=feed, and no aria-live for 'Loading more…' or the end-of-list message. The retry button is labelled with text (fine).
api: Not forwardRef, and the props don't extend HTMLAttributes while ...props is spread. The observer root is the component itself, so it only works if the consumer supplies a height. A page-scroll mode is missing. The loading and error props are mirrored into internal state, which is half-controlled and can desync. In reverse mode the sentinel ref swaps between two DOM nodes, and the observer effect may not re-run.
ssr: 'use client'. IntersectionObserver is used only in an effect.
fake_complexity: None. It is a real IntersectionObserver implementation.
justification: A small, mostly honest utility. Needed changes: forwardRef, a root option (container or viewport), proper feed/aria-busy/aria-live semantics, removal of the mirrored state, prefixed classes, and a fix for the reverse-mode sentinel. It is low risk and worth keeping, but it is plumbing, not a visual showcase.

name: GlassInlineEdit
material_impl: A raw <input> with a transparent background and a white/20 border, not the library's GlassInput, so it is inconsistent with the other text fields. On light backgrounds a border-white/20 line is effectively invisible.
motion: None.
a11y: Uses a real button to enter edit mode and handles Enter and Escape. The input's aria-label is the placeholder ('Edit…') rather than a field name. Focus does not return to the trigger button after save or cancel, because the button remounts and nothing focuses it. role=group is fine.
api: Function component, not forwardRef. Only value, onChange, placeholder, and className are accepted: no label, disabled, validation, onCancel, multiline, or blur-to-save. Uses unprefixed 'inline-flex items-center'.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: The behaviour is right and the component is small. It should compose GlassInput, accept a label, disabled, validate, and save-on-blur, use forwardRef, and return focus to the trigger after commit or cancel. It then becomes the shared inline-rename primitive that FileTree and FileExplorer reuse instead of hand-rolling.

name: GlassKanban
material_impl: Columns are unprefixed 'bg-white/5 border border-white/10' (line 483). Cards are OptimizedGlass with unprefixed priority border classes (border-red-400/50 and similar, lines 583-585). The column title has an inline color default of 'white' (line 505), which is invisible on light themes. 'consciousness-*' classes are applied with no evidence that matching CSS exists.
motion: Motion fadeIn. animationDelay is set on cards that have no animation class. useMotionPreferenceContext is imported but unused.
a11y: Cards and columns are clickable divs with no role, tabIndex, or keyboard handling. The Plus and More buttons have no aria-label and no onClick (lines 531-556). There is no drag-and-drop, let alone keyboard DnD.
api: Not forwardRef. Hooks are called conditionally (`predictive ? usePredictiveEngine() : null`, lines 133-138), which violates the Rules of Hooks: toggling a prop at runtime crashes React. enableDragDrop and onCardMove are declared but never used. className is applied twice (lines 390, 402). A window._kanbanSpatialAudio global is used as a cross-instance channel (line 284). Six 'Consciousness' variant wrappers are exported.
ssr: 'use client'. Imports the advanced eye-tracking, biometric, predictive, spatial-audio, and achievement modules even when they are unused, which adds bundle weight. document.querySelectorAll runs in an effect.
fake_complexity: Severe. Eye tracking is explicitly disabled ('Eye tracking functionality temporarily disabled', lines 200-202). Interaction recording passes a mock MouseEvent (lines 302-314). The 'predictive workflow suggestions' come from an engine call. The Kanban has no drag and drop at all, despite the enableDragDrop default of true.
target: GlassKanbanBoard (after its own audit)
justification: A Kanban without drag and drop, with conditional hooks that crash when props change, disabled 'eye tracking', mock-event 'consciousness' recording, and a window global for audio. It is the textbook fake-complexity component. A second Kanban (GlassKanbanBoard) already exists. Delete this one and its six 'Consciousness' variants, and invest in a single accessible board built on dnd-kit-style keyboard DnD.

name: GlassKeyValueEditor
material_impl: Raw <input>s with a transparent background and a white/20 border, not GlassInput. There is no container surface: rows float with no glass. The remove and add actions are text-only GlassButtons.
motion: None.
a11y: Per-row aria-labels and group roles (good). There is no duplicate-key or empty-key validation messaging. Removing a row shifts focus unpredictably because index keys are used.
api: Function component, not forwardRef, controlled only (value/onChange). Index keys (line 41) cause input state and focus to jump when a middle row is removed. No disabled, readOnly, placeholder, or validation props.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: An honest, small, controlled component that is useful in dev-tool and settings UIs. It should compose GlassInput and icon buttons, use stable row IDs, add duplicate-key validation, forwardRef, and a disabled state, and sit on a proper glass surface. That is low effort.

name: GlassLazyImage
material_impl: The info bar uses an inline backgroundColor rgba(255,255,255,0.2) with blur (lines 340-341), which leaves white text on a white tint with no contrast handling. The actions menu uses glass-surface-dark/80. Unprefixed 'relative overflow-hidden group cursor-pointer', 'w-full h-full', 'object-cover', and 'opacity-0/100' classes (lines 264, 300-315) mean the fade and object-fit may be dead outside Storybook.
motion: Nested Motion fadeIn wrappers (three levels). useReducedMotion is imported but unused (line 15). The spinner is not gated.
a11y: The root is a clickable Motion div with no role or keyboard handling but always shows cursor-pointer. The actions trigger ('⋯') has no aria-label or aria-expanded, and the menu has no role=menu, Escape, or outside-click handling (lines 380-436). It is revealed only on hover (opacity-0), so keyboard users can't see it. The placeholder image's alt is 'Loading...', which should be empty.
api: Not forwardRef, and the props don't extend img attributes, so there is no srcSet, sizes, or decoding. It double-lazy-loads: IntersectionObserver plus loading='lazy'. The navigator.clipboard fallback is not awaited and errors are swallowed.
ssr: 'use client'. IntersectionObserver is used in an effect, and there is no fallback when it is unsupported. On the server the image isn't rendered at all (isInView=false), which hurts LCP and SEO.
fake_complexity: The zoom action is a stub: handleZoom says 'Zoom functionality would be implemented here' (lines 195-199). The rest is real.
target: GlassImage (single image primitive: native lazy + blur-up + optional overlay slot)
justification: Blur-up lazy images are a legitimate primitive, but this one bundles a hover-only, unlabelled action menu with a stub zoom, and it never renders the img during SSR. It doesn't pass through img attributes and relies on unprefixed classes. Split it into a lean GlassImage (native loading and srcSet passthrough, blur-up placeholder, an aspect-ratio token) with composable overlays. The actions belong to the gallery or card, not the image.

name: GlassMentionList
material_impl: Shared OptimizedGlass elevation=level2 plus utility class 'border border-white/15' (raw Tailwind-style white border mixed with glass-* utilities). No bespoke blur. Screenshot: 99% of pixels >= 233 luminance, list reads as faint white card on white canvas.
motion: None. No reduced-motion concern.
a11y: Plain <ul>/<button> list. No role=listbox/option, no aria-activedescendant, no Arrow-key navigation, no Enter/Escape handling: it cannot function as an @-mention autocomplete when focus stays in a text editor. Buttons lack type='button' (submits forms). Empty-state li is fine.
api: Function component, no forwardRef, no style/...rest passthrough, only className. items typed but mapped as 'any' (L39). onSelect only passes id. No highlighted/active index prop, no renderItem, no loading state.
fake_complexity: None; trivially simple. But the name implies a mention autocomplete and it has none of the required keyboard/anchoring behaviour.
target: GlassCombobox / a shared Listbox primitive (role=listbox + roving focus) exposed as a MentionMenu recipe
justification: A 60-line styled <ul> of buttons is not a mention component: no listbox semantics, no keyboard model, no anchoring to the caret. The library already has listbox-like components (Combobox, CommandPalette). Fold it into a shared Listbox primitive and ship mention as a documented recipe on that primitive rather than a separate root export.

name: GlassMessageList
material_impl: GlassCard shell + glass-surface-* utilities; status dots use raw Tailwind palette bg-green-400/bg-yellow-400/bg-red-400/bg-gray-400 (L355-361), selection uses bg-primary/20 and ring-primary (non glass-prefixed). Mixed token systems.
motion: Motion preset fadeIn wrapper (not reduced-motion gated at this call site), per-row animate-slide-in-up gated by useReducedMotion (L300). scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) on every messages change ignores reduced-motion (L134-141) and scrolls the whole page when embedded.
a11y: role=log + aria-label on card is good. Message rows are clickable <div>s with no tabIndex/role/keyboard handler (L296-309). Hover-only action rail (opacity-0 group-hover) is invisible to keyboard and touch (L480). Icon-only Heart/Reply/More buttons have no aria-label (L483-517). Heart icon sends a thumbs-up emoji (L488). Search input has no label.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef. Spreads ...props onto GlassCard. virtualScroll prop declared and destructured but never used (L59, L111). Overlapping density knobs: compact, preview, density='compact', contained all alias each other (L210-211). Status always renders Check+CheckCheck regardless of message state (L528-531) - read receipts are fake.
ssr: 'use client'; formatTimestamp uses new Date() during render -> hydration mismatch risk for relative times ('5m') between server and client.
fake_complexity: Partial: 'virtualScroll' is a no-op; message status indicator is hard-coded double check; More button is a no-op (L513).
target: Merge with GlassChat into a single chat kit (MessageList + MessageBubble + Composer) built on GlassVirtualList
justification: Chat is a legitimate premium showcase surface, but this implementation is a hover-only, mouse-only list with dead props (virtualScroll), fake read receipts, raw Tailwind status colours and page-scrolling auto-scroll. It overlaps GlassChat. Redesign as one chat kit with real bubble styling, keyboard-reachable actions, a true status model and virtualization.

name: GlassMindMap (+ useMindMap)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell, but all SVG node/edge colours are hard-coded rgba (node fill rgba(14,25,46,0.86), stroke rgba(255,255,255,0.22), selection rgba(109,211,255,0.72), edges rgba(255,255,255,0.28)) at L310, L383-386, L582. Dark-only palette with no light theme mapping. Toolbar 'buttons' are OptimizedGlass divs.
motion: No transitions. Zoom/pan via CSS transform. No reduced-motion relevance.
a11y: Nodes are <g> with onClick/onDoubleClick only; no tabIndex, role, aria-label, or keyboard - totally mouse-only (L454-462). 'Reset Zoom' is a clickable div, not a button (L513-519). SVG has no title/role. Wheel handler calls preventDefault inside a React (passive) wheel listener, which does not prevent page scroll and logs warnings (L241-248).
api: React.FC, no forwardRef/rest/style. onNodeAdd and onNodeDelete are declared but never invoked (L56-58, L79-80). showMinimap draws dots with a fixed /3 transform unrelated to the viewBox (L533-539). useMindMap hook is a reasonable but separate state helper.
ssr: 'use client'; document listeners only in effects; safe.
fake_complexity: Drag is broken: handleMouseMove adds cumulative delta from drag start to the node's already-updated position, so nodes accelerate away from the cursor (L215-233). Node mousedown also bubbles to the pan handler so drag and pan fire together (L459 vs L550). Edges use fixed +50/+25 offsets regardless of node size/shape (L321-324). Custom connections that duplicate parent-child edges produce duplicate React keys (L351-369). ReactNode icons placed inside <tspan> are invalid SVG for non-strings (L471-475).
duplicates: workflow/diagram canvases elsewhere in library (node graph style components)
target: Remove from root; if a diagram surface is wanted, rebuild on a real graph lib (React Flow) adapter with glass node skins
justification: The interactive features it advertises (drag, add/delete, minimap) are broken or unwired, it is mouse-only with zero keyboard access, and its palette is hard-coded dark rgba. The certification screenshot shows a small cluster of nodes in a mostly empty pale frame. Building a correct mind-map is a product in itself; deprecate and point to a glass-skinned adapter over an established graph engine.

name: GlassPatternBuilder
material_impl: Nested OptimizedGlass panels (tool, layer, template) with redundant duplicated classes ('glass-contrast-guard' twice, glass-backdrop-blur-md on top of OptimizedGlass blur) (L747, L845, L924). Default palette hard-coded hex (L115-123), ruler text '#333' (L686). Canvas fillStyle/strokeStyle are set to CSS strings 'var(--glass-white)', 'var(--glass-black)', 'rgba(var(--glass-color-black) / var(--glass-opacity-10))', 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))' which Canvas2D cannot parse - they are silently ignored and default to black.
motion: Motion fadeIn gated by isMotionSafe. requestAnimationFrame loop (L717-725) is never cancelled and a new loop is started every time render() identity changes (any state change), so loops multiply unbounded and keep running after unmount. With reduced motion it just renders once - inverted priorities (reduced-motion users get correct perf, everyone else gets leaking loops).
a11y: Canvas has no role/label/keyboard alternative. Layer rows are clickable divs (L859-867). Emoji-only eye/trash buttons have aria-labels (good). Colour swatches labelled 'Select color N' without colour name.
api: forwardRef, className + rest passthrough. Props layers/activeLayerIndex/selectedElements/zoom are only initial values (controlled props ignored after mount). handleMouseMove is an empty stub (L350-358) - size-by-drag not implemented. SVG export ignores triangle/line (L536). generateSVG used before defined inside exportPattern closure deps.
ssr: 'use client'; canvas access in effects; safe. Fixed 800x600 canvas inline width/height -> overflows mobile.
fake_complexity: High. 'Pattern builder' with layers/templates/export but: drawing is click-to-stamp only, drag is a stub, canvas background renders BLACK because fillStyle 'var(--glass-white)' is invalid (screenshot ASCII analysis shows a solid near-black 800x600 block filling the layout; desktop mean luminance 171 vs ~244 for neighbours), undo history is partially wired (visibility toggle bypasses history).
justification: Not exported from any entry point, so it is dead weight with nine stories advertising it. It renders a black canvas due to CSS-var-in-canvas bugs, leaks compounding rAF loops, has a stubbed drag path, a fixed 800px canvas and is outside a design system's remit. Delete it and its stories/tests/snapshots.
evidence: rg: no import of GlassPatternBuilder outside its own files/types.ts

name: GlassPresets (+ Clean/Frosted/Textured/Subtle/Standard/Immersive/Dashboard/Form/ModalGlassContainer)
material_impl: Thin wrappers over ContextAwareGlass (interactive/ContextAwareGlass.tsx, 674 lines) setting numeric baseBlurStrength/baseOpacity/baseBorderOpacity per preset - i.e. the token system is bypassed with magic numbers per wrapper. Immersive default glowColor '#6366F1' hard-coded, which also makes the 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))' fallback dead code (L231, L246). TexturedGlassContainer noise data-URI is malformed ("xmlns='http:, //www.w3.org/2000/svg'" L120) so the SVG fails to parse and no noise renders.
motion: None directly.
a11y: Pure containers; no semantics. Not applicable beyond passthrough.
api: forwardRef everywhere, rest passthrough; nine near-identical wrappers + a switch component. useGlassTheme called and 'theme' unused in two wrappers (L235, L342). data-glass-component only on Clean variant.
fake_complexity: 'Textured' preset does nothing visible (broken data URI). Certification Default story renders no visible content at all: DOM textLength 52 = only skip links; screenshot luminance range 234-255 (blank).
duplicates: OptimizedGlass intent/elevation/intensity props (the real preset system)
target: Express presets as token-level recipes on OptimizedGlass (intent/elevation) instead of wrapper components
justification: Unexported, visually blank in certification, duplicated by the OptimizedGlass elevation/intensity API, and its one distinctive preset (textured noise) is broken by a typo. Presets belong in tokens/recipes, not nine wrapper components with magic numbers.
evidence: rg: GlassPresets not referenced by src/index.ts or any package subpath

name: GlassQueryBuilder
material_impl: Bespoke group surface via utilities 'glass-border-white/25 glass-bg-white/10 glass-backdrop-blur-md' and forced 'glass-text-white' (L164, L234) - white text hard-coded, illegible on light themes. Uses compound GlassSelect for fields/ops (good reuse). Raw <input> styled with glass-bg-white/10 glass-text-white.
motion: None.
a11y: role=group + aria-label on root, aria-labels on select triggers (good). Value <input> has no label (L139-146). Remove buttons say 'Remove' without context. Groups not announced as nested groups.
api: Function component, no forwardRef/rest. Mutates the caller's value object in place (rule.field = v; parent.rules.splice(...); group.rules.push(...)) then emits a shallow copy (L62, L75, L152, L188, L198) - breaks React immutability and memoised consumers. Uncontrolled use is impossible: default value is a fresh literal each render and there is no internal state, so without a controlled value the UI never updates. Crashes when fields=[] (fields[0].id L188, field.type of undefined L114). Index keys (L69, L222). Operator list fixed regardless of field type.
fake_complexity: No; real recursive builder, but structurally unsound state handling.
target: Immutable reducer-based QueryBuilder with typed operators per field type, controlled+uncontrolled support, and theme tokens instead of glass-text-white
justification: A query builder is genuinely useful for dashboard/workflow consumers and it already reuses GlassSelect, but in-place mutation of props, crash on empty fields, non-functional uncontrolled mode and hard-coded white text make it unsafe to ship. Keep the concept, rewrite the state model and theming.

name: GlassReactionBar
material_impl: No material of its own; row of GlassButton variant=ghost. Imports cn from '@/lib/utils' but never uses it (L2) while sibling files import from utilsComprehensive - two cn sources.
motion: Inherits GlassButton press states only. No count-change animation.
a11y: Buttons have visible emoji + count but no aria-pressed for 'reacted by me', no aria-label ('thumbs up, 12 reactions'). Screen readers read raw emoji then number.
api: No forwardRef/rest. No selected/own-reaction state, no add-reaction affordance, reactions mapped as any.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassReactions (advanced/GlassReactions.tsx) as the single reactions component with a 'bar' variant
justification: Three root-exported reaction components is noise. This one is the thinnest - a map over ghost buttons without pressed state or accessible labels. Merge into one reactions API (bar/bubbles variants, aria-pressed, accessible names) and drop this export.

name: GlassSearchInterface
material_impl: Reuses GlassInput, GlassButton, GlassBadge, OptimizedGlass(level2) for dropdown with extra 'glass-surface-dark/30' overlay (stacked tints). Search icons are inline hand-drawn SVG paths repeated four times instead of the library icon set (L451-463, L528-540, L566-578, L670-682).
motion: Motion preset slideDown for dropdown, not reduced-motion gated at call site (relies on Motion primitive). Spinner glass-animate-spin.
a11y: Not a combobox: no role=combobox/listbox, aria-expanded, aria-controls or aria-activedescendant; arrow-key focus is a visual class only. Critically, the dropdown is wrapped in FocusTrap (autoFocus defaults true, primitives/focus/FocusTrap.tsx:62) which opens on input focus and moves focus into the first suggestion button - stealing focus from the input as the user starts typing (L447, L491, L507). Filter-count badge is a clickable span with no keyboard support, absolutely positioned -right-12 outside the input (L477-486).
api: forwardRef + rest. value only seeds internal state (no sync on prop change, L204). Ships package-owned demo content (fake 'Components 126 / Patterns 34', fake results) whenever no data props are passed (L39-71, L211-233) - production consumers in an empty/loading state see fake data. Debounce timer not cleared on unmount. variant classes are all identical 'glass-w-full' (L379-384).
fake_complexity: Demo data injection is a production-facing fake (certification DOM sample shows 'AllComponents126Patterns34' with no consumer data).
target: GlassCommandPalette / GlassCombobox core (single search+listbox engine), with filters as a separate facet panel
justification: The focus trap makes the search box unusable for typing, it lacks combobox semantics, and it silently renders fake catalog data in production. The library already has CommandPalette, SpotlightSearch and Combobox; merge into one accessible search/listbox engine and migrate GlassListView.
evidence: screenshot desktop.png: luminance min 196, only faint category pills visible

name: GlassSignaturePad
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell; canvas forced 'bg-white' (raw Tailwind) inside glass; buttons wrap an OptimizedGlass inside a <button> (double surface, L414-435). Pen colour default 'var(--glass-black)' is invalid in Canvas2D (falls back to black by accident, L114). Placeholder colour hard-coded rgba(156,163,175,0.5).
motion: useMotionPreference-gated fadeIn; scale hover on buttons not gated. Unused useReducedMotion import (L10).
a11y: Canvas role=application with label + sr-only instructions (decent). No keyboard alternative (typed signature) - WCAG 2.1.1 failure for a required form input. Disabled uses pointer-events-none on the whole root.
api: forwardRef + rest. Controlled 'value' re-runs the init effect which resets canvas.width (clearing) on every onChange round-trip (L122-160). Placeholder 'Sign here' is painted INTO the canvas bitmap and never erased when drawing starts, so it is baked into the exported signature image (L338-358). No devicePixelRatio scaling - blurry on retina. Fixed width=400 inline -> overflows 390px mobile. exportFormat 'svg' calls toDataURL('image/svg') which browsers do not support (silently PNG). pressure captured but unused. No pointer capture -> stroke ends when leaving canvas.
fake_complexity: Velocity-based width is real but primitive; 'svg export' is fake.
target: If needed for forms, rebuild on signature_pad (MIT) with DPR scaling, pointer capture, typed-signature fallback and form value integration; otherwise drop
justification: Not exported, so no consumer depends on it. The placeholder is baked into exported images, controlled mode wipes the canvas, it is blurry on HiDPI and overflows mobile. A signature field is a legitimate form primitive but this one is not salvageable as-is.
evidence: src/components/interactive/GlassSignaturePad.tsx:122-160 (init effect depends on value, resets canvas)
rg: not exported from src/index.ts or subpaths

name: GlassSpotlight
material_impl: Fully bespoke inline material: backdropFilter 'blur(24px) saturate(1.4) brightness(1.04) contrast(1.02)', white rgba gradients, rgba borders and box-shadows (L115-127, L64-84) - no OptimizedGlass/tokens. Light-only white tints; cutout uses 9999px box-shadow trick with rgba(15,23,42,0.24).
motion: Two competing animation systems for the demo orb: JS rAF loop updating React state every frame (setDemoPhase, L89-99) AND a CSS keyframe animation on the same element (L159-166); inline transform from rAF overrides the keyframe. CSS honours prefers-reduced-motion; JS honours useReducedMotion. Re-renders the whole component 60fps while demoMotion.
a11y: Root div onClick={onClose} with no role=dialog, no Escape handling, no focus management, no aria-modal; the 'hole' is decorative. Emits sr-only 'Glass spotlight inactive' text when no target (noise). Full-screen fixed overlay without inert background.
api: forwardRef + rest + style merge (good). targetRect is a DOMRect snapshot - no element ref/anchor tracking on scroll/resize. contained/preview aliases. Injects a <style> tag per instance.
ssr: 'use client'; performance.now in effect only; safe.
fake_complexity: demoMotion is a package-owned demo animation shipped in the production component.
duplicates: GlassSpotlightSearch (search/) shares name, different purpose (naming collision)
target: Tour/Coachmark built on primitives/dismissable-layer + positioning, anchor-element based, tokenised scrim material
justification: Spotlight/coachmarks are a premium-feel pattern and this is one of the more visually considered files (highest contrast in its screenshot), but it is bespoke CSS outside the material system, has no dialog semantics or focus handling, uses static DOMRects and runs a 60fps React state loop for a demo orb. Rebuild on the existing overlay primitives.

name: GlassStepper (interactive)

tests.kind: templated; also src/components/input/GlassStepper.test.tsx for the other stepper

material_impl: Pills use 'ring-1 ring-white/10 bg-glass-fill' (non-prefixed Tailwind mixed with glass-*), connector glass-surface-subtle/15. No OptimizedGlass. Dynamic Tailwind class `duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms]` built at runtime (L58) - will not be generated by a JIT/static extractor.
motion: glass-hover--translate-y, glass-press, glass-ripple, glass-pulse-ring utilities; pulse logic is broken: lastActiveRef is updated in an effect after render, so wasJustActivated is true on every render where active differs from the previous commit, including the first mount (L33-50). No reduced-motion handling in component (depends on CSS utilities).
a11y: Buttons with aria-current='step' and aria-label (good). No completed/upcoming state, no step numbers, optional flag in Step type is never rendered (L9). Not wrapped in nav/ol.
api: Extends HTMLAttributes, rest passthrough, no forwardRef. Defaults to fake 'Step 1/2/3' data when steps missing. Name collides with src/components/input/GlassStepper.tsx (589 lines) - two different components named GlassStepper, root exports this thinner one.
fake_complexity: None, but it is a pill row, not a stepper (no progress/completion semantics).
target: src/components/input/GlassStepper.tsx / GlassFormStepper - one Stepper with completed/active/upcoming states
justification: Three steppers exist, two share the exact name, and the root exports the weakest one (no completion state, unused optional flag, runtime-built Tailwind class, misfiring pulse). Consolidate into a single Stepper API and remove this file.

name: GlassTagInput
material_impl: OptimizedGlass then overrides it with inline style background 'var(--glass-primary-level3-surface)', border '1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.2)' and bespoke boxShadow rgba values (L41-47) - double border (class glass-border-white/10 + inline). Screenshot: input is a faint pale band; darkest text pixels only 0.04% of frame.
motion: None.
a11y: Remove '×' buttons have no aria-label ('×' read as 'times') (L55-60), no type='button'. Input has no label/aria-label - placeholder only (L63-76). Suggestions are not a listbox, not keyboard navigable (Arrow keys), not announced. Chips not a list.
api: Controlled-only (value default [] with no internal state - typing Enter in uncontrolled use does nothing visible since onChange defaults to noop). No forwardRef, no input ref, no rest. Default param value=[] creates new array each render. No max tags, validation, paste-splitting, or delimiter config.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassMultiSelect / GlassCombobox (creatable multi mode)
justification: Tag input is a common need, but this version overrides the shared material with inline rgba, has unlabelled controls, mouse-only suggestions and is controlled-only. GlassMultiSelect/Combobox already cover chips+listbox; add a 'creatable' mode there and retire this export.

name: GlassThemeDemo
material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell (tier high), composes ~20 library components. Compact swatches are hard-coded hex '#f8fafc', '#cbd5e1', '#64748b' (L138) - not the active theme. Embeds CursorGlow overlay.
motion: hover:scale-[1.02] on cards gated by useReducedMotion; CursorGlow (pointer-tracking) not gated here.
a11y: Many nested h2 'Typography' headings inside cards under h1; Slider has both aria-label and aria-labelledby; inherits sub-component a11y.
api: forwardRef + rest. showCode prints MUI-style snippets that do not match this library's API (variant='contained'/'outlined'/'text', severity=, Paper, TabPanel, Divider) (L191-193, L333-336, L450-454, L516-520) - actively misleading docs. 'Performance Metrics' section is a placeholder sentence (L736-749). Passes themes={[]} to GlassThemeSwitcher. activeTab state unused. Same 'Card' rendered as 'Paper Card'.
ssr: 'use client'; heavy: imports 20+ components into one root export.
fake_complexity: High: it is a docs page shipped as a component; 'performance metrics' and code snippets are fake.
target: Move to Storybook/docs site as an MDX showcase page
