justification: A demo page has no place in the package's public API and inflates bundle/import graph. Its code samples document a different library (MUI), and its metrics panel is placeholder text. Move the showcase into docs, rewrite snippets against the real API, and drop the export.

name: GlassThemeSwitcher
material_impl: GlassCard shell; option tiles use non-prefixed 'ring-primary bg-primary/20 ring-white/10 bg-white/5' (L262-265). Preview colours hard-coded hex (#64748b, #0f172a, #94a3b8, #cbd5e1, #f8fafc, #1e293b) rather than reading actual theme tokens (L111-149).
motion: Motion fadeIn/scaleIn presets per tile, hover:scale-[1.02] not reduced-motion gated in component.
a11y: Theme tiles are Motion divs with onClick - not buttons/radios, no tabIndex, no keyboard, no role=radiogroup/aria-checked (L254-267, L333-346). Settings icon button has no aria-label (L225-232). Colour text inputs have no label association (L403-427: visible <label> not linked).
api: React.FC, no forwardRef. currentTheme only seeds state (no controlled sync). 'themes' typed required but defaulted. Does not integrate with the library's ThemeProvider/useGlassTheme - it only fires onThemeChange; selecting 'Dark' changes nothing by itself. 'System' option does no prefers-color-scheme detection despite enableSystemTheme prop.
fake_complexity: Yes: presents as a theme switcher but switches nothing and 'System' detection is fake.
target: ThemeSwitcher bound to the theme subpath provider (useGlassTheme), segmented-control/radiogroup semantics, real system detection
justification: A theme switcher is a core design-system piece, but this one is a mouse-only grid of divs with hard-coded preview colours that does not actually change the theme or detect system preference. Rebuild as a radiogroup/segmented control wired to the real theme provider.

name: GlassUserPresence
material_impl: GlassCard shell; status uses raw Tailwind bg-green-400/yellow-400/red-400/gray-400 and text-green-400 etc (L122-161), avatar ring 'border-2 border-black' hard-coded (L302, L568) - black ring breaks on dark glass and is off-token.
motion: Motion fadeIn on card and every row; not reduced-motion gated at call site.
a11y: Status conveyed by colour dot only in compact mode (WCAG 1.4.1). Rows are Motion divs with onClick, no keyboard (L531-537). Status-setter buttons have aria-labels but online/busy/invisible all use the same Circle icon (L127, L143, L149) - visually indistinguishable apart from variant. 'More options' button is a no-op.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef; ...props spread onto GlassCard though props type has no HTML attrs. getStatusConfig, getRoleBadge and formatLastSeen are duplicated verbatim inside UserPresenceItem (L446-528) and the outer copies of getRoleBadge/formatLastSeen are unused. groupByStatus ignores maxUsers. 'glass-gap-2' applied to non-flex divs (no effect) and typo class 'glass-min-glass-w-0' (L576). Hard-coded title 'Team Presence'.
ssr: 'use client'; formatLastSeen uses new Date() in render (hydration mismatch risk).
fake_complexity: None (presentational), no real-time wiring - fine.
target: GlassPresenceIndicator + GlassAvatar(status) composed into a PresenceList recipe
justification: Three presence components exist; this one duplicates its own helpers, uses raw Tailwind status colours and a hard-coded black avatar ring, and has typo'd/no-op classes. Fold the useful parts (list grouping, status setter) into a PresenceList built on GlassAvatar status and GlassPresenceIndicator tokens.

name: [internal] UserPresenceItem / GlassVirtualGrid / preset wrapper containers
material_impl: See parent records.
motion: See parent records.
a11y: See parent records.
api: UserPresenceItem is file-private. GlassVirtualGrid is a named export of the module but not re-exported from src/index.ts. CleanGlassContainer..ModalGlassContainer are module exports of an unexported file.
fake_complexity: n/a
target: Follow parent disposition
justification: Noted for completeness; not separately scored. They follow the fate of their parent files.

name: GlassVideoPlayer
material_impl: GlassCard shell with glass-surface-dark video area, gradient scrim utilities, GlassButton controls, GlassBadge title. Reasonable reuse; no bespoke blur.
motion: Fade preset; controls auto-hide after 3s via timeout; no reduced-motion relevance beyond Motion.
a11y: Icon buttons have aria-labels (good). Seek bar is a clickable div: no role=slider, no keyboard, no aria-valuenow (L524-534). Volume bar is display-only, not adjustable (L572-577). Global document keydown handler hijacks Space/Arrows/M/F for the entire page - typing a space or 'f' in any input elsewhere toggles playback/fullscreen, and multiple players all react (L235-282). Controls hidden by timeout also hide from keyboard users.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef. enablePiP declared, never used (L64, L114). Settings button toggles showSettings but no settings panel is ever rendered (L141, L468-476). currentQuality/playbackSpeed state never changeable; playbackSpeeds prop unused. Fullscreen state not synced to fullscreenchange events (Esc exit leaves isFullscreen true).
ssr: 'use client'; document access in effects/handlers only.
fake_complexity: Yes: PiP, settings, quality and speed selection are advertised but unimplemented. Certification DOM shows '0:00 / 0:00' and fallback text 'Your browser does not support the video tag' - the story never loaded a playable video.
target: GlassAdvancedVideoPlayer (media/) - single player, after fixing scoped keyboard shortcuts and slider semantics
justification: Two root-exported video players; this one has dead settings/PiP features, a non-accessible seek bar and a page-wide keyboard hijack that breaks any form on the same page. Merge into the media player, scope shortcuts to the focused player, and use a real slider for seek/volume.

name: GlassVirtualList (+ GlassVirtualGrid)
material_impl: No glass material at all - plain overflow div (only the loading pill uses glass utilities). 'Glass' prefix is cosmetic. GlassVirtualGrid is exported from the module but not from root.
motion: Motion fadeIn wrapper; 'scroll-smooth' class on by default (smoothScroll=true) not reduced-motion gated.
a11y: No role=list/listitem, no aria-setsize/aria-posinset for virtualised items, no keyboard scroll-to-index. Loading pill has no aria-live.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no scrollToIndex/imperative handle. Unusual item API: each item must carry a React component + props (component: ElementType) instead of renderItem(index). Variable-height mode is incorrect: visibleRange divides scrollTop by estimatedItemHeight while offsetY sums real heights, so the rendered window drifts from the viewport (L104-142). O(n) offset loop per scroll. onEndReached fires on every scroll event within threshold (no guard) (L152-157). GlassVirtualGrid: rowHeight is 0 until containerWidth measured -> divide-by-zero range on first render; window resize only (no ResizeObserver). Loading pill uses odd class 'glass--left-1-2' (L222).
ssr: 'use client'; window listener in effect; safe.
fake_complexity: Partially: 'dynamic sizing' is claimed but not implemented correctly.
target: @tanstack/react-virtual behind the existing useVirtualization hook; expose renderItem API and reuse in GlassVirtualTable/MessageList
justification: Virtualisation is infrastructure, not a visual component, and this hand-rolled version is wrong for variable heights, spams onEndReached and has no a11y semantics. Replace the engine with a proven virtualizer behind useVirtualization, and keep a thin glass-styled list wrapper only if needed.

name: GlassVoiceInput
material_impl: Nested OptimizedGlass panels with duplicated classes (glass-contrast-guard twice) plus raw Tailwind bg-red-500/20, text-red-400, bg-green-500 etc (L683-684, L805). Canvas gradient stops use 'color-mix(in srgb, hsl(var(--glass-color-info)) ...)' strings (L535-546, L618) - Canvas2D cannot resolve CSS vars, addColorStop throws SyntaxError, so the visualizer throws inside rAF as soon as audio is non-zero. Imports ContrastGuard and useReducedMotion but never uses them.
motion: Visualizer rAF loop (L634-644) is never cancelled and depends on renderVisualizer, which changes on every audioData update (every frame) - so a new uncancelled loop is spawned every frame while listening: exponential rAF growth. Reduced-motion disables the visualizer (good intent). Audio analysis loop setState per frame (setAudioLevel, setFrequency, setAudioData).
a11y: role=region + aria-label. Language/style selects and Continuous/Visualizer checkboxes have onChange={() => {}} - they are inert controls presented as interactive (L704-760). Hard-coded ids 'voice-language'/'visualizer-style' collide across instances. Status uses colour dot (red = Ready). No aria-live for transcript.
api: forwardRef + rest. Real Web Speech API + getUserMedia (not fake), but: checkCommands is captured stale in recognition.onresult (not in init deps) so updated commands are ignored; wake-word only checked on results while already listening (cannot wake); 'timeout' prop unused; stopListening missing onError dep. global Window interface augmentation (declare global) leaks types into consumers.
ssr: 'use client'; window access inside effects only.
fake_complexity: Mixed: speech recognition is real, but controls panel is decorative, wake-word is non-functional, 'particle' visualizer is Math.random noise, and Hz readout from FFT peak is mislabelled 'frequency' of voice.
target: VoiceGlassControl (voice/) remains the single voice component
justification: Unexported duplicate of VoiceGlassControl with twelve stories advertising inert controls, an exponentially growing rAF leak, a canvas gradient that throws on real audio, and non-functional wake-word. Delete it; if voice is kept, harden VoiceGlassControl instead.
evidence: rg: not exported from src/index.ts or subpaths

name: GlassWhiteboard

tests.notes: Template smoke/axe/snapshot; focus test is conditional (if element) and asserts outline!=='none' which jsdom always satisfies; no drawing, tool, eraser, select or export behavior tested.

material_impl: OptimizedGlass shell (intent=neutral, level1) at :652-661; inner text modal uses OptimizedGlass level2 :815. Canvas painting is hard-coded: grid 'rgba(48,48,48,0.16)' :374, dots 'rgba(255,255,255,0.20)' :390, text font '…px Arial' :472. Palette type is a closed union mixing var() tokens and raw rgba :18-30. Canvas strokeStyle given CSS var strings ('var(--glass-white)' :495, 'var(--glass-white)80' :588) which canvas rejects, so selection outlines inherit the previous stroke color; text fillStyle uses unresolved element.color :473. Classes glass-z-20 :812 and glass-surface-dark/20 do not exist in shipped CSS (only glass-z-10/30/40/50 in src/styles/glass.css).
motion: None. useReducedMotion and ANIMATION imported :5,:7 but never used; only CSS transition-colors classes on buttons.
a11y: role='application' + aria-label on root :663-664 (application role removes browse-mode for SR without providing any keyboard model). Tool buttons have no aria-pressed (:677-689) while color swatches do (:708) - inconsistent. Color swatch labels read raw CSS strings ('Select color rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.30)') :707. Hard-coded ids 'brush-size'/'brush-opacity' :720,:726,:751,:757 collide with multiple instances. Canvas has no keyboard alternative, no text description of content. Text 'modal' :809-836 is not a dialog (no role, no focus trap, no label; placeholder-only input). Mouse-only: no touch/pointer handlers on canvas :857-860 despite getCanvasPosition handling touches :201 - unusable on mobile/tablet.
api: forwardRef, className passthrough, ...props spread. Uncontrolled only: initialData seeds state once :141, no value/controlled data, no imperative clear/export/undo. Props collaborative, userId, showMinimap destructured and never used :113-121 (dead API). enabledTools default slices off text/select :115. Root style hard-coded and placed before {...props} only partially (style prop overrides maxHeight entirely).
ssr: 'use client'. window/document touched only in callbacks/effects (resolveCanvasColor :159, export :645) - SSR-safe. No heavy imports.
fake_complexity: High. 'collaborative'/'userId'/'showMinimap' do nothing (no network, no presence, no minimap). Eraser paints a white stroke rather than clearing (color 'var(--glass-white)' :228, no globalCompositeOperation='destination-out'), so it draws white lines over the glass. 'select' only highlights + allows delete; no move/resize. No undo/redo. No devicePixelRatio scaling, so strokes are blurry on retina. Every mousemove clones the full points array and redraws all elements :283-286,:556-610 (O(n) per move).
duplicates: src/components/social/GlassSharedWhiteboard.tsx (697 lines, also root-exported at src/index.ts:747, has framer-motion, sound, a11y ids) - direct functional overlap
visual_note: Image Read returned empty in this session; judged via pixel analysis + code. Desktop cert shot: content band y=232-880, only 0.59% of pixels darker than mid-gray; toolbar is a single row of small text-only chips and swatches above a small grid canvas with a thin rectangle and polyline - reads as a dev tool panel on a flat light page, not a premium surface. Canvas does not scale to container (fixed intrinsic width/height attrs, CSS height clamp(180px,32vw,300px) :847 crops it).
target: GlassSharedWhiteboard (single Whiteboard with real pointer events, controlled data, adapter-based collaboration)
justification: A working-but-naive canvas sketchpad dressed as a collaborative whiteboard. Three advertised props are dead, the eraser paints white, canvas color handling is broken for var() tokens, there is no touch/pointer support, no DPR scaling, no undo, and the a11y story is role=application with nothing behind it. It overlaps almost entirely with GlassSharedWhiteboard, which is also root-exported. Merge into one Whiteboard built on Pointer Events with controlled document state, a collaboration adapter interface (not a boolean), destination-out erasing, DPR-aware rendering and token-resolved colors; deprecate this export behind an alias for one major.

name: LiquidGlassCommandSurface

tests.notes: 8-line test: renders one option. No keyboard, filtering, escape, disabled, or a11y tests.

material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial material='liquid' radius='2xl' :63-66 (shared primitive) but immediately overridden by an inline hard-coded white gradient 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.30)…)' :73-74 and forced slate text '--glass-theme-text: rgba(15,23,42,0.94)' :76-77, making it light-only regardless of theme. Item fills hard-coded rgba(255,255,255,0.24/0.12) :122-127. Backdrop is a utility blur 'glass-bg-white/20 glass-backdrop-blur-md' :60. Several classes used do not exist in shipped CSS: glass-z-1200 :56 (overlay has no z-index), glass-place-items-start, glass-max-h-[min(24rem,…)] :103 (list never constrains height). Button reset (border:0, transparent bg, font:inherit) exists only in the story's injected <style> (stories :51-57), so consumers get UA button borders.
motion: None in component; LiquidGlassScrollEdge provides scroll-edge fade :106-110. No open/close transition, no reduced-motion concern.
a11y: Weak. Not a dialog: no role='dialog', aria-modal, label, portal, focus trap, scroll lock or focus restore. Input has role='combobox' with aria-expanded hard-coded true :95-96, no aria-controls, no aria-activedescendant, no aria-label (placeholder only). listbox :102 has no id/label. Options are focusable <button role=option> creating tab stops inside a listbox. No autofocus on open. Disabled items remain arrow-reachable and Enter fires onSelect regardless of disabled :93. Selection highlight is color-only.
api: forwardRef targets the panel; className/...props passthrough. Controlled open only (no defaultOpen, no trigger/hotkey). Query uncontrolled with no onQueryChange. selectedIndex not reset when query changes :43-51, so it can point past filtered length and Enter becomes a no-op. Item.group declared :12 but never rendered. Selecting an item doesn't close the surface. No empty state.
ssr: 'use client'; no window access at render; returns null when closed. Fine.
fake_complexity: Moderate: billed as a Liquid Glass command surface but is a simple label substring filter with color-only highlight; story copy promises 'groups' that the component does not implement.
visual_note: Image Read returned empty; judged by pixel analysis of reports/audit/liquid-glass-command-surface/desktop.png: near-white canvas (mean 251), only 0.75% dark pixels, text rows clustered at the far left rather than in a centered panel - consistent with missing glass-place-items-start/max-width utilities. Low tonal separation between panel, backdrop and story cards: white-on-white glass without depth.
target: GlassCommandPalette (rebuilt on the library Dialog/Portal/FocusScope + combobox primitives, with LiquidGlassMaterial as a material option)
justification: Command palettes are a flagship-grade surface in premium systems, but this is the weakest of four overlapping implementations: no dialog semantics, broken combobox ARIA, missing utility classes that silently drop z-index and list height, light-only hard-coded colors that defeat the LiquidGlassMaterial primitive, and styling that only looks right because the story injects CSS. Fold its one useful idea (Liquid material + scroll edge) into a single CommandPalette as material='liquid'.

name: LiquidGlassMapControls

tests.notes: 8-line test: one labelled button renders.

material_impl: Wraps LiquidGlassControlGroup -> LiquidGlassMaterial (shared primitive) :46-55, but passes an inline hard-coded white gradient background :51-54 that overrides the 'clear' vs 'regular' materialVariant, so the variant prop has no visible effect on background.
motion: None.
a11y: Buttons get aria-label from control.label :61 (good for icon-only). Group labelled 'Map controls' :49 (hard-coded, not overridable). No role='toolbar', and LiquidGlassControlGroup's rovingFocus is only a data attribute (src/components/input/LiquidGlassControlGroup.tsx:37) - no arrow-key navigation exists. Buttons have no intrinsic size (glass-p-2 only :62); 42px target comes from story CSS (stories :58-66). No pressed/selected state for toggles like Layers.
api: forwardRef, className, ...props. placement prop only emits data-placement :43 and no CSS anywhere consumes it (rg for data-placement/liquid-glass-map-controls in CSS: none) - placement is a no-op; story positions via style top/right. Controls are data-driven objects rather than composable children; no toggle/pressed field, no tooltip.
fake_complexity: Low-moderate: name implies a map-control system but it is a vertical button stack with a non-functional placement prop.
visual_note: Image Read returned empty; pixel analysis of reports/audit/liquid-glass-map-controls/desktop.png shows a varied map-like backdrop (6.8k colors) with a vertical control column on the right - the strongest-looking story in this shard, but the look depends on story CSS for button size/typography and icons are placeholder letters (+, -, O, L).
target: Keep as thin recipe over LiquidGlassControlGroup; implement placement CSS, toolbar role + roving focus, intrinsic 44px targets, pressed state, remove inline gradient
justification: Small and honest in scope, built on the right primitive, and map/floating-control clusters are a legitimate Liquid Glass pattern. But the placement prop does nothing, the inline gradient overrides the material variant, keyboard roving focus is advertised but absent, and touch targets/typography live in the story instead of the component. Fix those and it is a reasonable recipe; it does not justify a standalone flagship.

name: PageTransitionDemo

tests.notes: Template smoke/axe/snapshot only.

material_impl: createGlassStyle({intent:'neutral', elevation:'level2'}) for section card :121 (shared mixin). Buttons fully inline-styled with color-mix rgba and color:'white' :143-151. Gradient tints use invalid CSS 'var(--glass-color-primary-light)33' (hex alpha appended to a var) :87,:93, so those gradients are dropped by the browser.
motion: framer-motion AnimatePresence + opacity/y/filter blur :59-103. useReducedMotion called :18 but prefersReducedMotion never used - reduced motion is NOT honored. filter: 'blur(var(--glass-blur-md))' cannot be interpolated by framer-motion, so the blur step snaps.
a11y: Tab-like buttons without role=tablist/tab, aria-selected or aria-controls :28-48; no type='button'. White button text on a light surface: pixel min luminance in the cert screenshot is 210/255 - labels effectively invisible.
api: Not forwardRef, fixed 520x320 inline size :25, only className/data-testid. Hard-coded copy 'Glass page transition demo' :132. Default export plus named export.
fake_complexity: It is a demo, not a component: three hard-coded pages with placeholder text.
visual_note: Image Read returned empty; pixel analysis of the desktop cert shot: luminance range 210-255, stddev 7, a faint blob in the center - essentially a washed-out near-blank frame with invisible white text. Fails the premium bar outright.
target: Move as a story example for GlassPageTransition (src/components/animations/GlassTransitions.tsx:258)
justification: Not exported from the root, fixed-size, placeholder content, broken gradients, invisible white labels on a light background, and reduced-motion is imported but ignored. It is demo code living in src/components and inflating the component count. Delete it and, if the pattern is wanted, show it as a GlassPageTransition story.

name: ThemedGlassComponents

tests.notes: Template tests render without required children; reduced-motion test asserts jsdom computed durations (always 0) so it cannot fail.

material_impl: OptimizedGlass with elevation mapped from glassIntensity :31-36,:111-116 - adds nothing over OptimizedGlass directly. Uses unprefixed Tailwind 'transition-all duration-300' :119 which exist only in src/styles/storybook-utility-shim.css:710,719 (not shipped); 'glass-transitioning' class :120 has no CSS anywhere.
motion: setTimeout toggles an isTransitioning flag :97-106 that drives a class with no styles - fake. Reduced motion is checked :116,:119,:125 (wired, but guards no-ops).
a11y: Plain div wrapper; nothing to evaluate. Default story renders an empty box.
api: forwardRef, but props interface is not exported (a different ThemedGlassComponentsProps exists in src/components/interactive/types.ts:323). variant/colorMode are string-typed and only trigger the timer; preserveOriginalStyle unused; contextData passed through a context whose hook useThemedGlass is not root-exported. Context value recreated every render.
fake_complexity: High: claims to 'apply themed glass styling to its children' but just renders OptimizedGlass with an intensity->elevation map; the transition system is a timer flipping an unstyled class.
visual_note: Image Read returned empty; pixel analysis: 23 distinct colors, luminance 233-255 - effectively a blank light page with an empty faint box.
target: OptimizedGlass (elevation prop) / theme provider
justification: Not publicly exported, functionally a renamed OptimizedGlass, with dead props, an unstyled 'transition' class driven by setTimeout, and Tailwind classes that only exist in the Storybook shim. Its story is blank. Remove it and its tests; nothing in the public API depends on it.

name: Box
material_impl: None. Plain polymorphic element; no glass at all despite living in a glass library. Story supplies all visual content.
motion: Applies 'motion-safe:transition-all' to every Box by default (respectMotionPreference=true), i.e. transition-all on arbitrary layout nodes; does not consult MotionPreferenceContext (Box.tsx:61-62).
a11y: Passes role/aria-label; auto-generates an id when aria-label is present (pointless). No semantics of its own, which is correct for a primitive.
api: forwardRef + 'as' (keyof JSX.IntrinsicElements only, not components). Name collides with a second, different 'Box' exported from GlassBox.tsx (system-props Box with displayName 'GlassBoxBase'); root exports this one, layout/index exports this one as Box and GlassBox's BoxProps as GlassBoxProps. Imports ContrastGuard/TextWithContrast unused.
ssr: 'use client' on a pure presentational primitive (unnecessary, blocks RSC usage). No window access.
fake_complexity: None, but 'respectMotionPreference' prop is misleading: it only toggles a Tailwind class.
target: Single layout primitive set: Box (polymorphic, asChild via primitives/slot) merged with GlassBox system-props variant
justification: Box is a 30-line div wrapper whose only behavior is adding transition-all to every node, which is a perf and visual-jank liability, and it shares its name with a second incompatible Box in GlassBox.tsx. Keep one polymorphic primitive (as/asChild, no default transitions, no 'use client'), and fold GlassBox's glass variant into it as a prop or a separate Surface component.

name: ContentSection
material_impl: OptimizedGlass frosted for variant='card'; plain section otherwise.
motion: Card variant defaults to animation='shimmer' when motion allowed (GlassAppShell.tsx:571).
a11y: section role=region + aria-labelledby title (good). Card variant gives region role to a div (fine).
api: forwardRef; elevation default 'level1' (string) vs declared numeric type; numeric path maps elevation+1.
fake_complexity: None.
target: AppShell redesign (Section slot) or GlassCard
justification: Useful pattern but undocumented, unstoried, untested, and its default shimmer is wrong for content. Fold into the redesigned shell/page primitives.

name: GlassAppShell

tests.quality: templated boilerplate; no test of sidebar collapse/mobile overlay

material_impl: Mixed: shell root is bespoke (Tailwind bg-gradient-to-br from-background..., which is not in shipped CSS, plus hard-coded inline boxShadow 'rgba(15,23,42,0.16)' and forced dark-on-light text vars --glass-theme-text: rgba(15,23,42,0.94)) (GlassAppShell.tsx:303-318). Content uses GlassContainer -> OptimizedGlass when contentElevation>0. ContentSection card uses OptimizedGlass with 'shimmer' animation.
motion: Page transition via primitives Motion preset fadeIn, gated by MotionPreferenceContext prefersReducedMotion (wired, GlassAppShell.tsx:197-199, 359-365). Also transition-all classes on root/main/footer. ContentSection card defaults to animation='shimmer' on every card (distracting for a content section).
a11y: Default role='application' on the whole shell (GlassAppShell.tsx:186) is an a11y anti-pattern: it forces screen readers out of browse mode for the entire app. main has redundant role='main' with aria-label. No skip link, no nav landmark of its own, focus not managed when mobile overlay opens. Hard-coded dark text vars break dark theme contrast.
api: forwardRef, className/props passthrough. Sidebar/header enhancement works only via React.cloneElement when element displayName is exactly 'GlassSidebar'/'GlassHeader' (GlassAppShell.tsx:251-295) - fragile, invisible coupling; any wrapped sidebar silently loses collapse/mobile overlay. collapsed state is uncontrolled only (no collapsed/onCollapsedChange props). maxWidth '2xl' maps to nonexistent 'max-w-8xl'. paddingClasses/getElevationLevel computed but unused. ContentSection elevation default 'level1' contradicts its numeric type. PageHeader exported from file but not from root.
ssr: 'use client'; window only inside useEffect (OK) but isMobile defaults false, so mobile SSR renders desktop layout then flips (layout shift). h-screen (100vh) on mobile Safari.
fake_complexity: Low; 'mobileOverlay' only works with GlassSidebar by name.
target: Single AppShell (absorb ZSpaceAppLayout) with explicit slots/context instead of cloneElement-by-displayName
justification: An app shell is a flagship surface for a premium system, but this one hard-codes light-theme text and shadow values on the root, ships a Tailwind gradient class the library CSS does not contain, defaults to role='application', and couples to GlassSidebar/GlassHeader by displayName string. Redesign around a shell context (sidebar state controlled/uncontrolled, mobile drawer with focus trap), token-driven material layers, CSS-container-query responsiveness, and merge ZSpaceAppLayout's depth idea as an optional material treatment.

name: GlassBox
material_impl: Shared primitive: OptimizedGlass (intent neutral, intensity medium, depth 2, border subtle) when glass=true (GlassBox defaults glass=true, elevation level2, radius 8). Non-glass path is a MUI-style system-props box.
motion: animation='none'; no motion. Commented-out motion code left in (GlassBox.tsx:399-400).
a11y: No semantics; onClick on a div with no role/keyboard handling (GlassBox.tsx:168, 385). Imports ContrastGuard unused.
api: MUI-clone system props (p/pt/m/mx, bgcolor, flexDirection) with an 8px unit; numeric spacing is mapped to Tailwind classes ('p-3', 'p-6', 'p-[40px]') via spacingToTailwind (GlassBox.tsx:179-195) - arbitrary-value and many plain Tailwind classes are not in the shipped dist/styles/index.css, so spacing silently does nothing for consumers who do not scan the library with their own Tailwind. Also rounds 5->'6', 7->'8' (lossy). 'component' prop is ignored when glass=true (always renders OptimizedGlass div). Elevation accepts both 0-5 and 'level1-4' strings. BoxProps does not extend HTMLAttributes, so aria-*/data-* are untyped.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassSurface / OptimizedGlass primitive (glass) + single Box primitive (layout)
justification: GlassBox is a thin preset over OptimizedGlass bolted onto a second MUI-style system-props Box whose spacing props compile to Tailwind classes that the library does not ship. It duplicates layout/Box under the same exported name and duplicates every other 'glass panel' in the library. Replace with one material primitive (Surface) plus token-based spacing props that emit inline CSS variables, not class names.
evidence: dist/styles/index.css (no arbitrary p-[..] or responsive utilities)

name: GlassContainer
material_impl: Shared primitives: OptimizedGlass (material='glass') or LiquidGlassMaterial (material='liquid') with hard-coded ior 1.45-1.5, thickness by size, black tint rgba. Non-glass path plain div.
motion: transition-all duration-300 always; 'animate-pulse' when preloadContent && visible (a content container pulsing forever is a visual bug). No reduced-motion handling at all in this file.
a11y: None specific; onClick/onFocus handlers attached to div for telemetry only.
api: Rules-of-hooks violation: hooks are called conditionally on props (GlassContainer.tsx:182-190: 'predictive ? usePredictiveEngine() : null' etc.); toggling any of these props at runtime changes hook order and crashes, and enabling them without the matching Provider throws (useEyeTracking/useBiometricAdaptation throw outside provider, GlassEyeTracking.tsx:459-466, GlassBiometricAdaptation.tsx:823-830). Ref handling is broken: useImperativeHandle(ref, () => localRef.current) where localRef is never attached, alongside a callback ref that also writes ref - the imperative handle can overwrite the forwarded ref with null (GlassContainer.tsx:173-177, 503-512). IntersectionObserver effect omits containerElement from deps (line 214), so preload observation may never attach. elevation default 'level1' is not in its own union type. Radius mapping duplicated as ternary chains twice despite a radiusClasses map existing unused. responsivePadding emits 'md:glass-p-6' classes that do not exist in shipped CSS. Exports Container alias, ConsciousGlassContainer, withConsciousness, ConsciousnessPresets.
ssr: 'use client'. Statically imports GlassAchievementSystem, GlassBiometricAdaptation, GlassEyeTracking, GlassPredictiveEngine, GlassSpatialAudio into the most basic layout container, so every app using GlassContainer (and GlassAppShell/ZSpaceAppLayout which use it) pulls those modules into the bundle.
fake_complexity: High. 'Consciousness' features: eye tracking handlers are commented out ('not yet implemented', lines 273-283); biometric adaptation assumes desktop with a hard-coded object (line 223) and polls a stress level every 5s to shrink the container; 'preloadContent' only adds animate-pulse; 'accessible' preset enables biometric/spatial-audio features that have nothing to do with accessibility.
target: Container (max-width + padding, no glass, server-safe) + Surface material primitive; delete consciousness API
justification: The core job (max-width, centering, padding) is trivial, yet this file bundles five 'advanced' engines, violates the rules of hooks, likely nulls forwarded refs, and markets mock biometric/eye-tracking behavior. It is also used internally by GlassAppShell and ZSpaceAppLayout, so its weight and bugs propagate. Rebuild as a server-safe Container plus an opt-in Surface material, and remove ConsciousGlassContainer/withConsciousness/ConsciousnessPresets.

name: GlassFlex
material_impl: None (despite 'Glass' name and doc 'with glassmorphism styling'). Gap tokens via var(--glass-space-N) fallbacks - good token use.
motion: transition-all classes on container and every GlassFlexItem by default.
a11y: Pass-through role/aria-label only. Fine for a primitive.
api: Both inline styles AND equivalent classes are emitted for every property (double source of truth). The 'responsive' prop is broken: inline flexDirection always wins over 'md:glass-flex-col' classes, and those responsive classes are not in shipped CSS anyway (GlassFlex.tsx:303-311, 323-340). gapX/gapY with gap: setting only gapY drops 'gap' entirely (line 330-335). GlassFlexItem is not exported from root, so flex-item control is unreachable from the public API. Many class maps reference nonexistent classes (basis-1/2, order-3).
fake_complexity: Claims glassmorphism styling; has none.
target: Stack (single flex primitive with responsive object props implemented via CSS variables + container queries)
justification: Flex, Stack, HStack, VStack (x2) and Box all solve the same problem with slightly different prop names (direction 'col' vs 'vertical', gap vs space vs spacing). The responsive API advertised here does not function. Collapse into one Stack/Flex primitive with working responsive props and no 'Glass' prefix.

name: GlassGrid
material_impl: None. Gap via --glass-space tokens inline.
motion: transition-all classes on grid and items.
a11y: Pass-through only.
api: Column count relies solely on 'grid-cols-N' classes (inline gridTemplateColumns deliberately omitted, GlassGrid.tsx:268-276), but shipped dist/styles/index.css only contains grid-cols-3, -4 and -12: cols=1,2,5-11 render as a single implicit column for any consumer not running Tailwind over node_modules. Default cols=12 for a generic grid. Responsive columns emit 'md:grid-cols-N' which are not shipped. align maps to 'flex-start' for alignItems (works but non-idiomatic). GlassGridItem (colSpan etc.) is not exported from root. xl gap uses 'gap-8' while others use glass-gap-*.
fake_complexity: Doc says 'with glassmorphism styling'; none.
target: Grid primitive emitting grid-template-columns via CSS variables (repeat(var(--cols),minmax(0,1fr))) with responsive/auto-fit support
justification: The story uses cols={4}, one of only three column classes that exist in the shipped CSS, which is why certification passed. In real consumption most column counts and all responsive overrides silently fail. A grid primitive must be self-contained; rebuild with inline CSS variables and export GridItem.

name: GlassMasonry
material_impl: None; CSS multi-column (column-count/column-gap).
motion: transition-all classes on wrapper and each cell.
a11y: Defaults role='grid' with children wrapped in role='gridcell' but no role='row' and no grid keyboard navigation - invalid ARIA structure that misrepresents a static layout as an interactive data grid (GlassMasonry.tsx:54, 86).
api: Fixed numeric columns with no responsive/min-width option (3 columns on a 390px phone). Column-flow ordering reads top-to-bottom per column, not left-to-right. Pixel gap only, no tokens.
fake_complexity: None.
target: components/layouts/GlassMasonryGrid (or a single Masonry with responsive columns)
justification: Two masonry components are exported from root. This one is a 40-line column-count wrapper with wrong ARIA roles and no responsive behavior. Merge into one Masonry with responsive column count, no grid roles, and tokenized gaps.

name: GlassScrollArea
material_impl: OptimizedGlass, then overridden with bespoke inline background linear-gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.28/0.14), borderColor rgba(148,163,184,0.24), boxShadow stack, plus classes glass-backdrop-blur-md ring-1 ring-white/10 bg-white/5 (GlassScrollArea.tsx:242-262). Material primitive's own output is largely overwritten; light-only values.
motion: OptimizedGlass animation='shimmer' by default on a scroll container (GlassScrollArea.tsx:238) - a permanent shimmer behind reading content. Reduced motion respected via context.
a11y: role=region + default aria-label 'Scrollable content area' (generic). The actual scroll element (inner div) has no tabIndex, so keyboard users cannot focus to scroll in browsers without auto-focusable scrollers. Custom scrollbar is mouse-only with no ARIA.
api: Custom scrollbar is effectively dead code: content size is measured with getBoundingClientRect on the element that itself has overflow+maxHeight, so contentHeight never exceeds containerHeight and the custom bars never render; isAtBottom edge-fade logic uses the same wrong measure (GlassScrollArea.tsx:148-168, 197-203, 226). GlassScrollBar listens for 'scroll' on the parent container while the scrolling element is the content div (scroll does not bubble), so the thumb never moves (lines 442-447); its ref fallback ignores function refs. useScrollArea queries '[data-scroll-area]' which no element sets (lines 596, 604). smoothScrolling class applied to the outer wrapper, not the scroller. scrollbarSize/position props mostly cosmetic. maxHeight default '200px' makes the '??' fallback dead.
fake_complexity: Medium: advertises 'custom scrollbars' that never appear; real behavior is native thin scrollbar via scrollbar-color.
target: ScrollArea on native overflow with LiquidGlassScrollEdge edge treatment; drop fake custom scrollbar or implement properly (Radix-like)
justification: Visually it can pass a screenshot because the native thin scrollbar and edge fades look acceptable, but most of its 620 lines (custom bars, thumb drag, useScrollArea) do not work. Rebuild as a lean native-scroll region with focusable scroller, scroll-edge material from the primitives layer, and no default shimmer.

name: GlassSeparator
material_impl: Bespoke Tailwind classes: bg-border/20, bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-border/20, glow = via-primary/30 + shadow-primary/20 + backdrop-blur on a 1px line. Shipped CSS lacks bg-gradient-to-r and via-border/20, so 'gradient' and 'glow' variants render invisible for non-Tailwind consumers. Length override uses runtime-built arbitrary classes `w-[${length}]` that Tailwind JIT can never generate (GlassSeparator.tsx:162-165).
motion: transition-all class only.
a11y: decorative default -> role=presentation (fine); non-decorative -> role=separator + aria-orientation. Content variant aria-label interpolates ReactNode into a string ('Separator with content: [object Object]' for elements, line 117). Standard path wraps the separator in an extra ContrastGuard div (lines 149-191), so ref/className land on the inner div while an unstyled wrapper div breaks vertical separators inside flex rows (h-full of a wrapper with no height).
api: forwardRef; dashed/dotted thickness via string .replace hacks (lines 171-176). Convenience variants (Horizontal/Vertical/Gradient/Glow) not exported from root.
ssr: 'use client' unnecessary; ContrastGuard adds a client effect to a 1px line.
fake_complexity: Running ContrastGuard contrast analysis on a decorative line is pointless overhead.
target: data-display/GlassDivider -> single Separator primitive (token hairline, specular gradient via CSS vars)
justification: Separator and Divider are both exported; this one has variants that depend on classes the library doesn't ship, an un-generatable length class, and a wrapper div that breaks vertical layout. One Separator with a token-driven hairline (and an optional refracted/specular edge) is all that's needed.

name: GlassSplitPane
material_impl: Root uses createGlassStyle from core/mixins/glassMixins (shared); panes use bespoke class strings 'glass-bg-white/10 glass-backdrop-blur-md glass-border-white/20' wrapped in ContrastGuard - three stacked glass layers (root + 2 panes) with nested backdrop-filter.
motion: Color transition on handle gated by motion context. No drag animation.
a11y: Separator has role=separator, tabIndex=0, aria-valuenow/min/max and Arrow/Home/End keys (good, GlassSplitPane.tsx:138-164, 221-249). But Arrow keys are not orientation-aware (Left/Up both decrease regardless). Root has both aria-label and aria-labelledby (redundant). Handle is 8-12px wide with no enlarged hit area (touch target fail). Focus ring classes 'glass-focus-ring-2' may not exist. Pane regions labelled 'Left pane' generic.
api: Drag math uses e.clientX / window.innerWidth (GlassSplitPane.tsx:115-119) instead of the container's bounding rect, so any split pane not spanning the full viewport from x=0 jumps/offsets while dragging. Mouse events only - no pointer/touch support, so it cannot be resized on mobile. Window listeners are attached permanently on mount, not during drag. Uncontrolled only (initial), no 'value'. 'left/right' prop names even in vertical mode. dragging stored in ref so the active-drag class never re-renders.
fake_complexity: None.
duplicates: any resizable panel in workspace subpath
target: ResizablePanels (pointer events, container-relative math, controlled value, orientation-aware keys, 24px hit area)
justification: The keyboard ARIA is a decent start, but the core drag behavior is wrong outside full-viewport usage and absent on touch. Rebuild with pointer capture and container-relative sizing, controlled/uncontrolled values, and a single material layer.

name: GlassStack
material_impl: None. Gap via --glass-space tokens (good).
motion: transition-all class by default.
a11y: Pass-through only. Dividers are wrapped divs with no role.
api: Same inline-style-beats-responsive-class bug as GlassFlex: 'responsive' direction and 'responsiveSpace' can never apply because inline flexDirection/gap always win and the md:/sm: classes are not shipped (GlassStack.tsx:196-215, 253-262). space + spacing alias. Also defines its own VStack/HStack (lines 372-388) which differ from root-exported HStack.tsx/VStack.tsx; layout/index.ts exports these while src/index.ts exports the others - two different VStack/HStack depending on import path. GlassStackItem not root-exported.
fake_complexity: None.
target: Becomes the single Stack primitive (absorbs GlassFlex, HStack, VStack); fix responsive props; rename to Stack
justification: Of the overlapping flex primitives, GlassStack has the best API (token gaps, dividers) and is already used internally (GlassAppShell imports VStack from it). Keep it as the survivor, but fix the responsive implementation (CSS variables per breakpoint), drop transition-all, drop 'use client', and delete the duplicate HStack/VStack files.

name: HStack

tests.quality: templated boilerplate (identical to GlassMasonry test except name)

material_impl: None. Declares intent/elevation/tier 'glass surface' props that do nothing and leak through {...props} to the DOM as unknown attributes (HStack.tsx:16-22, 61).
motion: Inherits GlassStack transition-all.
a11y: Adds role='group' when labelled (reasonable).
api: Wraps GlassStack in an extra ContrastGuard <div> (HStack.tsx:54-64): every HStack becomes two nested divs, so flex children sizing from the parent (flex-1, alignment) is applied to the outer unstyled wrapper and className lands on the inner one - a layout footgun. ContrastGuard runs contrast analysis per stack. Different implementation from GlassStack's own HStack export.
fake_complexity: intent/elevation/tier props are fake.
target: GlassStack (Stack direction='horizontal' / its HStack alias)
justification: A second HStack implementation that adds a wrapper div and fake glass props. Re-point the root export to the GlassStack alias and delete this file.

name: OptimizedGlassContainer
material_impl: OptimizedGlass with intensity/performanceMode/depth/animation chosen by an optimization level; plus additional glass-backdrop-blur-* classes layered on top of the primitive's own blur.
motion: Default level 'none' = intensity ultra + animation 'float' (the most expensive config is the default). Reduced motion via hooks/useReducedMotion (wired for animation).
a11y: Defaults role='region' + aria-label 'Optimized glass container' on every instance (landmark noise). When showIndicator, the whole container becomes aria-live polite, so all children content is announced on change and FPS ticks every second (OptimizedGlassContainer.tsx:284-285).
api: Each instance runs its own permanent requestAnimationFrame loop and setState every checkInterval (OptimizedGlassContainer.tsx:53-93), re-rendering the container and its children every second forever; N containers = N rAF loops. Adaptive logic oscillates (step up/down each second around threshold, no hysteresis window beyond 0.1). OptimizationLevel enum has MAXIMUM/AGGRESSIVE aliases equal to 'heavy'. PerformanceIndicator is a component defined inside render (remounts every render). performanceThreshold passed to hook unused there.
ssr: 'use client'; useRef(performance.now()) at render is OK in modern Node.
fake_complexity: Medium: 'auto optimization' measures main-thread rAF FPS (not GPU compositing cost of backdrop-filter) and the measurement itself adds per-second renders.
target: A single app-level GlassQualityProvider (one shared FPS/device-tier probe) consumed by OptimizedGlass/Surface
justification: Performance adaptation belongs at the provider level, measured once; a per-container rAF loop that re-renders its subtree every second is itself a performance problem. Deprecate in favor of a shared quality tier read by the material primitive.

name: VStack
material_impl: None; same fake intent/elevation/tier props leaking to DOM.
motion: Inherits GlassStack transition-all.
a11y: role='group' when labelled.
api: Identical copy of HStack.tsx with direction swapped; same extra ContrastGuard wrapper div. Root VStack differs from the VStack GlassAppShell uses internally (from GlassStack).
fake_complexity: intent/elevation/tier props are fake.
target: GlassStack (VStack alias)
justification: Copy-paste duplicate of HStack.tsx; delete and export the GlassStack alias from root.

name: ZSpaceAppLayout
material_impl: Every region wrapped in GlassContainer glass (OptimizedGlass) - header, sidebar, main, footer, overlay: five stacked backdrop-filter layers; sidebar toggle uses createGlassStyle from utils/createGlassStyle (a different createGlassStyle than GlassSplitPane's core/mixins one). Injects a <style> block per instance. Hard-coded font stack and focus ring rgba(99,102,241,0.3) fallback.
motion: translateZ per layer within perspective/preserve-3d; but nothing animates depth (no parallax/tilt), so 'Z-space' is visually inert except for slight perspective scaling. Reduced motion disables transforms (JS + CSS media query).
a11y: Header/sidebar/footer are plain divs (no header/nav/footer landmarks); only main is a landmark. Toggle button uses arrow glyphs as content with aria-label (OK). On <=768px the sidebar is translated off-screen and the 'mobile-open' class that would reveal it is never applied by the component (ZSpaceAppLayout.tsx:314-321) - sidebar is unreachable on mobile.
api: forwardRef but does not spread rest props (no data-*/id/aria-* other than aria-label). Uncontrolled collapse requires onSidebarToggle. Using position fixed inside a transformed/perspective parent changes containing block semantics. Toggle hover CSS assumes translateY(-50%) positioning that is never set.
ssr: 'use client'; inline <style> with interpolated values per render.
fake_complexity: Medium: 'Z-space depth layers' amount to static translateZ values with no perceptible depth behavior.
target: GlassAppShell (redesigned) with an optional 'depth' material treatment
justification: A second app shell with no mobile navigation path, missing landmarks, five nested blur layers and a depth gimmick with no visible payoff. Merge any valuable layering/elevation ideas into the single redesigned AppShell.

name: GlassFractalLayout
material_impl: Root is OptimizedGlass with hard-coded glassConfig blur 15/opacity .9/saturation 1.1 (L404-410). Each node is a bespoke Tailwind-ish div 'glass-surface rounded-lg border border-white/20 glass-backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10' (L449-459) — a nested backdrop-filter per node, untokenized white alpha borders. Connection lines are 1px border-l divs rotated in CSS (L470-497).
motion: framer-motion variants, but transitions use react-spring keys 'tension'/'friction' (L364-366, 373-374) which framer-motion ignores, so springs fall back to defaults. Growth animation is a manual rAF setState loop for 2s (L138-162) re-rendering the whole tree each frame. Reduced motion IS wired via useMotionPreference: growth skipped (L137-155), delay zeroed (L367).
a11y: role='application' with aria-label (L412-413) but nodes are clickable motion.divs with onClick/onMouseEnter only — no tabIndex, no role, no keyboard (L429-447). Certification DOM inspection: focusableElementCount=3 at both viewports, i.e. only the Storybook skip links — zero focusable component content. role=application without keyboard handling is an anti-pattern. Hover sounds on by default (soundEnabled=true, L92, L337-339).
api: forwardRef yes; className/style passthrough (string concat, not cn). Non-standard props: compact/contained/maxHeight/height overlap. Unused imports cn, ContrastGuard, TextWithContrast (L11, L16-19). handleWheel calls preventDefault in a React onWheel (passive) handler — it will not prevent page scroll and logs an intervention warning (L344-355).
ssr: 'use client'; no module-scope window access. useGlassSound imports a global WebAudio sound singleton.
fake_complexity: fractalType 'mandelbrot' computes an unused constant c and just lays nodes on a linear diagonal (L244-252); 'julia' and 'custom' are not implemented and fall to a default row layout (L254-260); 'sierpinski' is three points on a circle. It is a radial tree positioner with fractal branding.
justification: A novelty demo with no real product use case: the 'fractal' types are mislabeled positioning presets (mandelbrot/julia are fake), nodes are not keyboard reachable, springs are misconfigured for framer-motion, and the visible chrome is a debug HUD ('Type/Depth/Nodes/Zoom' badges L512-529). 24 stories on a component nobody should ship inflate surface area. Remove from 5.0; if a tree visualization is wanted it belongs in a data-viz package built on a real layout algorithm.

name: GlassGoldenRatioGrid
material_impl: OptimizedGlass root with hard-coded glassConfig (L405-411); every cell is a bespoke 'glass-surface rounded-lg border-white/20 glass-backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10' div (L500-510). Hard-coded gold spiral stroke rgba(255,215,0,0.3) (L434) and rgba(255,255,255,.24) legend (L590).
motion: framer-motion scale-in variants with invalid tension/friction keys (L347-368). Reduced motion only zeroes the stagger delay (L351); scale 0->1 still animates for reduced-motion users.
a11y: role='grid' > role='row' > role='gridcell' (L412, L496, L517) but no keyboard grid navigation, no tabIndex; cells are clickable divs. Certification focusableElementCount=3 (skip links only). ARIA grid semantics without the required interaction model is worse than none.
api: forwardRef with manual ref merge (L374-381). onLayoutChange is invoked inside useMemo during render (L269-277) — a side effect in render that fires on every recompute and can loop if the parent sets state. Fixed containerWidth/Height defaults (800x600) for a 'responsive' grid; items assigned to sections purely by area order, ignoring aspectRatio/minSize/maxSize props that are declared (L26-28) but unused.
ssr: 'use client'; ResizeObserver only in effect. OK.
fake_complexity: Golden-ratio BSP subdivision is real but trivially simple; declared aspectRatio/minSize/maxSize constraints are never honored (assignItemsToSections L247-267). The spiral is decorative and not related to the section geometry.
justification: A gimmick layout with a debug HUD ('Sections/Items/Golden Ratio/Levels' L561-576), fake ARIA grid semantics, render-phase side effects, and unused sizing props. Real apps use CSS grid; a premium design system does not ship a 'golden ratio' grid with a dashed gold spiral overlay. Remove.

name: GlassIslandLayout
material_impl: OptimizedGlass variant='frosted' root and per-island (L689, L824). Controls/stats bypass the primitive with inline rgba(255,255,255,.2) backgrounds, rgba(148,163,184,.3) borders and radius 14 repeated 4x (L593-596, L617-625, L637-645, L653-660, L673-681). Tailwind non-prefixed classes mixed with glass-* (bg-blue-400, ring-blue-400, border-yellow-400/50). Dynamic class 'duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms]' (L803, L826) cannot be generated by any static CSS build.
motion: framer-motion entrance; reduced motion half-wired: initial uses shouldAnimate but animate uses prefersReducedMotion ? {} (L815-821), so reduced-motion users can be left at initial state if hooks disagree. 'Physics' rAF loop: updatePhysics depends on physicsIslands (L273), so the effect tears down and restarts every frame (L276-291); physics never sets a boundary on right/bottom.
a11y: Zoom/connect/arrange controls are emoji-only buttons (🔍+, 🔍-, 🔗, ⚡) with no aria-label (L612-684). Minimize button has tabIndex=-1 (L850) — unreachable by keyboard. Dragging is mouse-only via document mousemove (L533-541); no touch/pointer or keyboard move. Connection canvas sets strokeStyle to 'var(--glass-bg-hover)' (L324, L349) — canvas does not resolve CSS variables, so the assignment is ignored and lines render in default black.
api: forwardRef. No style passthrough. config captured once in useState (L153-156) so later config changes are ignored. enableResizing renders a handle that sets isResizing but no resize logic exists; onIslandResize is never called (L870-881, L76). Header text 'Island Layout / Floating content islands with connections' is hard-coded (L736-741). Inner components Minimap/StatsPanel/Controls defined inside render remount every render (L543-686).
ssr: 'use client'; document listeners in effect only. Fixed 2000x2000 world canvas (L766-797) allocates a 16MB backing store regardless of content.
fake_complexity: 'Physics' is a naive O(n^2) repulsion loop with no right/bottom bounds; 'resizable' is a no-op; 'Auto-arrange' uses fixed +400 offsets. Story content is fake KPI cards ('Users: 1,234 Revenue: $5,678' per certification text sample).
justification: A half-built node-graph editor: resizing is a stub, connection colors silently fail on canvas, physics re-subscribes rAF every frame, controls are unlabeled emoji, and the minimize control is keyboard-unreachable. Not salvageable as a design-system primitive; a real canvas/graph editor is application territory (React Flow etc.). Deprecate in 5.0, remove in 6.0.

name: GlassMasonryGrid
material_impl: OptimizedGlass frosted root and one OptimizedGlass per item (L578, L694) — nested backdrop-filter on every tile (177 glass elements in certification DOM count). Root force-overrides text tokens with hard-coded dark slate rgba(15,23,42,.94/.76/.64) (L587-589), breaking dark themes. StatsPanel puts createGlassStyle(...).background (a CSS value) into className (L532-535) — a bug, yields a garbage class.
motion: framer-motion staggered entrance; reduced motion wired via both useReducedMotion and shouldAnimate (L668-679). Skeleton heights use Math.random() in render (L722) — they jitter on every render and mismatch SSR.
a11y: Items are clickable motion.divs with no role/tabIndex/keyboard (L650-693). Sort-order button is a bare arrow glyph with no aria-label (L507-517). Search input has no label (L452-458). FilterControls is a component declared inside render (L448) and rendered as <FilterControls/> (L630), so it remounts on every state change — the search input loses focus after each keystroke.
api: forwardRef but no style passthrough. config frozen in useState (L140-143). Props filterBy/sortBy only seed state; not controlled. enableDragReorder: onDragEnd calls handleDrop(event, item.id) with the dragged item's own id (L685-688), so dragged===target and reorder is a no-op. enableVirtualization never listens to scroll (updateLayout only on resize), so 'visible' set is computed once. Infinite-scroll sentinel is appended to the DOM each time loadingMore toggles and never removed (L390-399). Header copy 'Masonry Grid / Pinterest-style dynamic layout system' hard-coded (L607-612).
ssr: 'use client'; window resize + ResizeObserver in effects. Math.random in render (L722) causes hydration mismatch when loadingItems>0.
fake_complexity: Advertised drag-reorder, virtualization and infinite scroll are effectively non-functional (see api). Item heights are prop-driven, not measured, so real content clips/scrolls inside tiles (overflow:auto L700).
target: src/components/layout/GlassMasonry.tsx
justification: Masonry is a legitimate need, but this implementation is a demo panel (hard-coded header, stats HUD, footer 'Grid: WxH px') wrapped around broken features: search loses focus each keystroke, drag-reorder is a no-op, virtualization ignores scroll, sentinel leaks. The 107-line GlassMasonry already exists. Consolidate into one headless masonry (CSS columns or measured layout) with optional toolbar composition; drop the stats/filters baked into the layout.

name: GlassOrbitalMenu
material_impl: OptimizedGlass root with hard-coded blur 20/opacity .8/saturation 1.2 (L223-229) — the whole square bounding box is a glass slab, not just the buttons. Items are bespoke 'glass-surface rounded-full border-white/20 glass-backdrop-blur-md bg-white/10 text-white/90' (L297-306): hard-coded white text that fails on light themes.
motion: framer-motion variants with invalid tension/friction keys (L173-176, L183-186, L207-209, L366-370). autoRotate effect lists `rotation` in deps (L109-116) so the rAF loop is torn down and recreated every frame, and setRotation every frame re-renders the whole menu at 60fps; rotationValue/rotationTransform are computed but unused (L92-93). Reduced motion: disables stagger/rotation, but also hides the hover label entirely (L335) — reduced-motion users lose the only visible text label.
a11y: Center button has aria-expanded/aria-controls/aria-label (L249-251) — good. role='toolbar' (L231) without arrow-key roving focus; items redundantly set role='button' on <button>. No Escape-to-close, no focus return. Labels shown only on mouse hover (L335-345), never on focus.
api: forwardRef, className/style. Controlled-only isOpen (no defaultOpen); onOpenChange required to function. springTension/springFriction props are react-spring vocabulary and do nothing in framer-motion. Status text '{n} items' rendered in corner (L377-379).
fake_complexity: None major; it's a straightforward radial menu, but advertised spring tuning is non-functional.
target: GlassFab speed-dial / radial variant
justification: A radial menu is a plausible signature interaction for a Liquid Glass system, and the open/close semantics are partially right, but it needs a rebuild: per-item Liquid material instead of a glass box, roving tabindex + arrow keys + Escape, labels on focus, real framer spring params (stiffness/damping), and no 60fps setState rotation. Fold into a GlassFab 'radial' variant rather than a standalone 'layout'.

name: GlassTessellation
material_impl: OptimizedGlass root (L568-598); tiles are flat SVG paths with hard-coded rgba(255,255,255,.22/.34) fill and rgba(248,250,252,.36/.72) stroke (L448-456) — no glass material on tiles at all (SVG can't backdrop-filter). Has a real luminance-based readable-text helper (L77-125), the one good idea here. Grid pattern uses a global id='grid' (L625) that collides with any other SVG on the page.
motion: framer-motion rotate -180 -> 0 entrance per tile with invalid tension/friction keys (L532-565). Reduced motion only zeroes stagger delay (L546); spin-in still plays. morphPattern rAF setState loop guarded by reduced motion (L184-201).
a11y: role='application' (L599); tiles are motion.g with onClick/hover only — not focusable (certification focusableElementCount=3, skip links only). Content in foreignObject. No accessible names for tiles.
api: forwardRef, className/style. 'hexagonal' places hexes on a grid of size*sqrt(3) while drawing hexagons of width=size (L269-284 vs L469-477) so tiles don't actually tessellate; 'pentagonal' is admitted approximation with rotation (row*col*72) (L330-359). Fixed containerWidth 800 default. setTimeout without cleanup on click (L424).
fake_complexity: 'Tessellation' patterns do not tessellate (gap/overlap math mismatch); 'mixed' is sin-wobble scatter. Novelty with mathematical branding.
justification: No glass material on the tiles, no keyboard access, misconfigured motion, and the geometry doesn't actually tessellate. Pure novelty. Remove; salvage getReadableTextColor (L113-125) into the shared contrast utilities if not already duplicated there.

name: AuroraBackground
material_impl: Pure CSS in marketing.css with token fallbacks: --ag-aurora-a..d resolve from --aura-marketing-palettes-* then --glass-color-* (marketing.css:1-96), palettes via [data-ag-palette] (marketing.css:888-947). Blobs are conic gradients blurred 54px (marketing.css:452-462), SVG feTurbulence grain (L504-508), radial vignette. No JS glass primitive needed — appropriate for a backdrop.
motion: CSS keyframes (ag-aurora-drift, ag-particle-float). Reduced motion wired three ways: reducedMotion prop -> data-motion='none' (AuroraBackground.tsx:102,111), data-ag-reduced-motion kill switch (marketing.css:949-954), and @media (prefers-reduced-motion) for the whole scope (marketing.css:956-963). Correct.
a11y: aria-hidden defaults true when no children (L107-109); pointer-events none. Forced-colors handled in shared CSS. Good.
api: forwardRef, HTMLAttributes passthrough, cn. Deterministic seeded particles (FNV hash + LCG, L33-66) — SSR-stable, no hydration mismatch. data-attribute driven variants. Naming prefix 'ag-' differs from the rest of the library's 'glass-' utilities.
ssr: 'use client' though it has no client-only behavior (could be a server component). Side-effect CSS import './marketing.css' (L6) requires consumer bundler CSS support; Next pages-router disallows global CSS imports from node_modules in some configs.
fake_complexity: None — does what it says.
justification: The cleanest backdrop in the shard: tokenized, deterministic, SSR-safe, and the only component here with genuinely correct reduced-motion and forced-colors handling. It should become THE canonical atmospheric backdrop and absorb GlassAuroraDisplay/AuroraPro (DEPRECATE those). Polish: drop 'use client', reconcile 'ag-' vs 'glass-' naming, add more stories (palettes x intensity x light/dark), and get it into the visual certification set (no screenshot slug exists).

name: AuroraOrb
material_impl: CSS conic-gradient core + radial shine + drop-shadow glow from palette tokens (marketing.css:519-579). Not glass — a gradient sphere. Tokens used throughout.
motion: CSS pulse keyframe (marketing.css:576-579, 997-1005); pointer tilt via CSS variables set imperatively (L39-61) — no rerender, cheap. Covered by the shared prefers-reduced-motion kill (marketing.css:956-963), but pointer tilt still applies under reduced motion (it's direct manipulation, acceptable).
a11y: aria-hidden defaults to true even when children are passed (L77) — children content would be hidden from AT.
api: forwardRef, style merge, consumer onPointerMove/Leave are chained (L45, L60, L71). Clean.
ssr: 'use client' needed for pointer handlers; CSS side-effect import.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: Small, correct, cheap. It's a gradient sphere, not glass, so it's decoration for marketing pages only. Fix aria-hidden-with-children, keep in the ./marketing subpath, and avoid promoting it as a material showcase.

name: DisplayText
material_impl: N/A (typography). Gradient text via background-clip from palette tokens (marketing.css:626-637); forced-colors fallback (L965-969).
motion: None.
a11y: Semantic element via `as` (h1/h2/h3/p/span) decoupled from visual size — correct. Gradient text contrast not guaranteed on arbitrary palettes; forced-colors handled.
api: forwardRef, polymorphic `as` (limited union), size hero/section/title/label, balance. Default font stack is a generic 'ui-serif, Georgia, Times' fallback (marketing.css:584-592) unless --ag-marketing-display-font is set — out of the box it renders Georgia, not a branded display face. letter-spacing 0 on hero sizes (L594) — premium display type normally tightens tracking.
fake_complexity: None.
duplicates: any Glass typography/heading components in the library (not in this shard)
justification: Correct and tiny, but typographically generic: default Georgia fallback and zero tracking make hero text look like a blog, not a first-party system. Ship a real display type scale (font, optical tracking per size) in tokens, drop 'use client', and align with the main typography components so there aren't two heading systems.

name: FeatureTile
material_impl: Composes ShowcaseCard (shared marketing material) — good reuse. Index badge uses aurora gradient with white text (marketing.css:776-786).
motion: Inherits ShowcaseCard (none unless floating/interactive).
a11y: Title hard-coded as <h3> (L57) regardless of document outline. White index text on light aurora gradients may fail contrast.
api: forwardRef, passthrough. tone 'success'/'info'/'warning' all map to the same 'subtle' glow (L18-27) — tone prop is mostly cosmetic data-attr with no CSS for data-tone, so success/info/warning render identically to neutral.
fake_complexity: tone variants are non-functional (no [data-tone] CSS rules in marketing.css).
justification: Good compositional pattern, but tone variants are fake (no CSS for data-tone) and the heading level is fixed. Add headingLevel/as, implement or remove tones, verify index-badge contrast.

name: InstallCommand
material_impl: Reuses .ag-showcase-card classes directly by string (L60) rather than composing ShowcaseCard; subtle glass bg tokens.
motion: CSS color transitions, covered by reduced-motion kill.
a11y: Real <button type=button>, aria-label, visually-hidden role=status aria-live (L80-86) — good. Focus-visible outline tokenized (marketing.css:868-872).
api: forwardRef. Default commands hard-code the package name 'aura-glass' (L19-22) — this is docs-site chrome for AuraGlass itself, not a reusable component. 'Copied' state never resets (L53) and clipboard rejection is unhandled (await without try, L52) -> unhandled promise rejection in insecure contexts.
fake_complexity: None.
duplicates: any GlassCodeBlock/copy button in the library (not in shard)
justification: Accessible and small, but it's AuraGlass-docs chrome shipped as a library component. Generalize into a CopyableCode/Snippet (package name not baked in), reset copied state after timeout, catch clipboard errors, and compose ShowcaseCard instead of borrowing its class string.

name: LogoMark
material_impl: Conic aurora core + inner rounded square (marketing.css:647-664); launch-kit overrides add real backdrop-filter glass (L284-309).
motion: Optional CSS pulse, reduced-motion covered.
a11y: role=img + aria-label when label given, otherwise aria-hidden (L34-36). Correct.
api: forwardRef, size/palette/animated. Fine.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: It is the AuraGlass brand glyph rendered generically (rounded square of gradient). Fine for the docs/marketing subpath; does not belong in the root barrel. Move to ./marketing only and keep as brand asset.

name: ShowcaseCard
material_impl: Tokenized CSS glass: blur(var(--glass-marketing-glass-blur)) saturate(1.65) + --glass-filter-base, border/bg/shadow/highlight all from tokens with --aura-* overrides (marketing.css:666-678, 713-763). Specular top highlight ::before. This is a cleaner material than most JS-built glass in this shard, but is a parallel material system to OptimizedGlass/LiquidGlassMaterial.
motion: Optional CSS float + hover lift, reduced-motion covered.
a11y: interactive=true adds hover lift and a :focus-visible style but no tabIndex/role — 'interactive' card isn't actually focusable unless consumer adds it.
api: forwardRef, intensity/glow/radius/padding/highlight/floating/interactive via data-attrs. Clean.
fake_complexity: None.
target: src/components/card/GlassCard.tsx
justification: Good, token-driven CSS card — but it is a second card material system alongside GlassCard/OptimizedGlass/LiquidGlassMaterial. Fold its data-attribute + CSS-variable approach into GlassCard as the canonical implementation (or make ShowcaseCard a GlassCard preset) so there is one card material in 5.0.

name: GlassAdvancedAudioPlayer
material_impl: Glass primitive root but style overridden with createGlassStyle from core/mixins/glassMixins (a different createGlassStyle than utils/createGlassStyle used elsewhere) plus inline rgba borders/shadows (L1096-1105). Button styles hard-code rgba gradients and shadows (L70-102). Playlist/transcript rows use opaque light rgba(255,255,255,.74)/rgba(219,234,254,.9) backgrounds (L513-516, L629-631) — not glass, breaks dark mode. 180 lines of CSS injected via <style> per instance (L111-183, L1107). Canvas colors set to 'hsl(var(--glass-color-primary))'/'var(--glass-gray-200)' (L238-239, L363, L397) — canvas cannot resolve CSS vars, so these are silently ignored. Bars visualizer uses rainbow rgb() (L345-349). Emoji transport icons ⏪⏸️▶️⏩🔇🔊 (L913, L1024-1058).
motion: Canvas rAF for visualizer only. No reduced-motion handling for visualizer animation.
a11y: Buttons have aria-labels (good). Progress bar is a clickable div with no role=slider/keyboard (L998-1013); waveform canvas seek is mouse-only (L290-299). Transcript search input unlabeled (L603-609). Emoji icons render inconsistently across OSes.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no style/rest passthrough. showLyrics declared, never used (L18, L673). handleMediaSelect only calls provider play(media.id) — the <audio src> is bound to the mediaFile prop, so selecting a playlist track does not change what plays (L874-880, L1113). Search highlight builds RegExp from raw user input (L577) — typing '(' or '[' throws and crashes the panel. Player state depends on provider play(), which no-ops unless the file was registered via addMediaFile (GlassMediaProvider.tsx:407-431); the story does not register (GlassAdvancedAudioPlayer.stories.tsx:69-80), so isPlaying stays false and every click re-calls audio.play() — the button can never pause.
ssr: 'use client'; AudioContext created lazily on gesture (L729-749). OK. createMediaElementSource on cross-origin audio without CORS mutes output.
fake_complexity: 'Waveform' is mock sine data, not decoded audio (L774-786, comment 'Generate mock waveform data'). Transcript comes from the provider's mock transcription service (fake speakers, Math.random confidence). Story fixture src is 'data:audio/mpeg;base64,' (empty) with visualizer/waveform/transcript/playlist all disabled (stories L43, L72-76) — the certified screenshot shows a static shell with none of the 'advanced' features.
target: LiquidGlassMediaControls + headless useMediaElement hook
justification: Feature list is fiction: mock waveform, mock transcripts, playlist that doesn't change tracks, play/pause that can't pause without hidden provider registration, a RegExp crash on search, emoji icons, canvas colors that silently fail. Rebuild as a composition: headless media hook bound to the <audio> element as source of truth, LiquidGlassMediaControls for transport, icon set instead of emoji, real slider semantics, optional transcript slot fed by consumer data.

name: GlassAdvancedVideoPlayer
material_impl: Root is a plain div with inline bespoke glass: linear-gradient rgba whites, blur(16px) saturate(1.4) brightness(1.08) contrast(1.04) hard-coded (L1167-1175) — bypasses Glass/LiquidGlass primitives. Controls bar adds a second backdrop-filter level4 (L209-218, L462). Active menu items use hard-coded blue rgba(37,99,235,.96) + #f8fafc (L620-627, L664-673, L719-725). 260 lines of CSS injected per instance with many !important (L151-411). Emoji icons 🔇🔉🔊 ⊟⊞ ⚠️ and sentiment 😊😔😐 (L549, L689, L1243, L880-884).
motion: No motion system; controls auto-hide via setTimeout (L1028-1042) stored in state (re-render per mousemove). No reduced-motion concerns beyond spinner.
a11y: Buttons labeled. Progress bar is a div with click/drag mouse-only, no role=slider/aria-valuenow/keyboard (L473-507). Volume slider appears on hover only (L536-568) and has no aria-label. Speed/quality popovers have no menu semantics, no Escape, no outside-click close. Controls overlay is removed on mouseleave even when paused (L1183) — keyboard users tabbing in can find controls unmounted. No keyboard shortcuts (space/arrow/f/m). Captions/subtitles never rendered as <track> despite MediaSubtitle data.
api: React.FC, no forwardRef, no style passthrough. showAnalytics declared, unused (L20, L923). Quality menu only sets provider state; video source never changes (L1276, GlassMediaProvider.tsx:487-489) — 'quality' is cosmetic. buffered read from videoRef during render (L1265-1271). isStorybookDataMedia (L82-83, L985-986) swaps data: video sources for a poster — Storybook-specific logic in production code; the certified screenshot is of a static poster image, not a video. Same provider registration dependency as the audio player (play() no-ops unless addMediaFile was called).
ssr: 'use client'; document.exitFullscreen only in handler. OK.
fake_complexity: Quality selection fake; transcript keywords/sentiment/confidence come from mock service with Math.random (GlassMediaProvider.tsx:277-286); analytics flag unused; storybook poster hack hides the actual video path from visual QA.
target: single GlassVideoPlayer (merge with src/components/interactive/GlassVideoPlayer.tsx) built on LiquidGlassMediaControls
justification: Two video players exist; this one has fake quality switching, no keyboard model, hover-only volume, no captions, emoji iconography, hard-coded blue selection, and a Storybook-only poster swap that means the certification never saw a video. A media player is a strong flagship opportunity for Liquid Glass (floating controls over content is exactly the material's use case), but it must be rebuilt: element-as-source-of-truth state, slider semantics, keyboard shortcuts, <track> captions, LiquidGlassMaterial controls with local dimming.

name: GlassMediaProvider
material_impl: Non-visual provider; renders a wrapper <div> (L783) — the story builds its own visual card ('Live media context / Media workspace ready' per certification text) which is what got certified.
motion: N/A.
a11y: N/A.
api: Exported as both MediaProvider and GlassMediaProvider (L790; media/index.ts exports MediaProvider, root exports GlassMediaProvider). 35-member context value rebuilt every render, not memoized (L741-779) — every consumer re-renders on every timeupdate. Duplicated state: playbackState mirrors the media element and is fed by setPlaybackState({...playbackState}) from players using stale closures. play() silently no-ops if the file wasn't addMediaFile'd (L407-431). play/pause/seek reference trackEngagement before declaration and omit it from deps (L427, L430). useMedia() falls back to a no-op default context (L192-230, L792-795), so forgetting the provider produces dead players with no warning. Passes a stray data-glass-component prop to Context.Provider (L782). startRecording never stops stream tracks (camera/mic LED stays on) and ignores RecordingOptions (L672-699); stopRecording hard-codes type video/webm even for audio (L706-717); object URLs never revoked.
ssr: 'use client'; navigator guarded in effect. OK.
fake_complexity: Severe. 'AI Features' are a mockTranscriptionService (L239-306): setTimeout(2000) then canned sentences about 'advanced media components', fabricated speakers ('Alice Johnson', 'Bob Smith', 'Dr. Sarah Chen'), confidence = 0.85+Math.random()*0.15, random keywords and random sentiment (L249-286). generateSummary returns a hard-coded paragraph (L292-296). analyzeSentiment/extractKeywords just read back the random values. This ships in production bundles and the players call it automatically when showTranscript is on.
duplicates: any media state hook; GlassImageProcessingProvider follows same mock-AI pattern (src/index.ts:716)
target: headless useMediaElement(ref) hook + optional lightweight MediaSession context; no built-in AI
justification: Ships fake AI (canned transcripts with invented speaker names and random confidence/sentiment) in a production library — a credibility liability. Architecturally it duplicates the media element's state, requires undocumented registration for play() to work, re-renders all consumers on every time update, and leaks recording streams. Replace with a headless hook where the HTMLMediaElement is the single source of truth; transcripts/chapters become consumer-supplied data; recording moves out of the design system.

name: LiquidGlassMediaControls
material_impl: Shared primitive LiquidGlassMaterial material='liquid' variant clear/regular, radius full, data-local-dimming (L84-93) — the right foundation. Button uses createGlassStyle (core/mixins) + hard-coded light gradient rgba(255,255,255,.34)->rgba(248,250,252,.24) (L22-30); ranges hard-code accentColor #64748b and slate rgba shadows (L32-45). tintMode='light' fixed (L88) — no dark/adaptive option exposed.
motion: None of its own.
a11y: Native <button> and <input type=range> with aria-labels (L102-138) — keyboard works by default. Play button shows the words 'Play'/'Pause' (L108) instead of icons (functional but not premium); aria-label duplicates text. Seek range has no step and no aria-valuetext (screen readers announce raw seconds).
api: forwardRef, HTMLAttributes passthrough, controlled (playing/currentTime/volume + callbacks), variant/compact. Aliased in root as GlassMediaControls too (src/index.ts:721-726) — two names for one component.
fake_complexity: None — honest controlled component.
justification: The only honest media component in the shard: controlled, native semantics, built on LiquidGlassMaterial. It should become the canonical transport bar that both advanced players compose. Needs: real icon glyphs, tokenized range track/thumb styling (no #64748b), aria-valuetext with formatted time, skip/next slots, adaptive tint, and real visual certification (no screenshot slug exists). With that work, 'floating Liquid Glass controls over video' is a credible flagship screenshot.

name: LiquidGlassNowPlayingBar
material_impl: Composes LiquidGlassBottomAccessory -> LiquidGlassMaterial liquid, radius full (navigation/LiquidGlassBottomAccessory.tsx:14-22). Action button uses createGlassStyle (core/mixins) (L28-31). Progress uses glass-surface-primary token classes.
motion: None.
