a11y: Expand target is a full-width <button> with no aria-label/aria-expanded (L56-61) — accessible name becomes the concatenated title+subtitle, acceptable; progress bar is a decorative span with no role=progressbar/aria-valuenow (L79-84). Play button uses text 'Play'/'Pause'.
api: forwardRef, passthrough, controlled playing/progress (0-1). Clean.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: Correct composition on the Liquid primitives and a familiar OS-native pattern. Polish: icons instead of words, progressbar semantics, aria-expanded for the expand affordance, next/prev slots, and replace the audio player's 'compact' variant with this.

name: LiquidGlassPhotoInspector
material_impl: Thin preset over LiquidGlassInspectorPanel (LiquidGlassMaterial liquid radius 2xl + LiquidGlassScrollEdge) (navigation/LiquidGlassInspectorPanel.tsx:56-57).
motion: None.
a11y: Uses <dl>/<dt>/<dd> for metadata (L22-29) — good. Inherits aside+aria-label and section aria-labelledby, but section ids are static ('metadata-title', 'tags-title', 'rating-title' via navigation/LiquidGlassInspectorPanel.tsx:69-70) — duplicate ids with two inspectors on a page. Close button glyph is a lowercase 'x' (Inspector L63-65).
api: forwardRef, passthrough. Always renders all three sections even when empty (rating undefined -> empty 'Rating' section) (L17-42).
fake_complexity: None.
duplicates: LiquidGlassInspectorPanel (it is a preset of it)
target: src/components/navigation/LiquidGlassInspectorPanel.tsx (as a documented recipe/preset)
justification: 48 lines of section config over the inspector panel; doesn't warrant its own public component. Make it a story/recipe of LiquidGlassInspectorPanel, and fix the panel's static section ids and 'x' close glyph, plus skip empty sections.

name: GlassActionSheet
material_impl: Shared primitive OptimizedGlass (elevation level4) for the action group and cancel group; backdrop is raw Tailwind bg-black/40 -> bg-black/0; liquid branch delegates to LiquidGlassAdaptiveSheet. Hard-coded text-red-500 / text-blue-500 for destructive/primary variants instead of tokens. Several raw Tailwind classes (translate-y-full, bg-black/40, text-blue-500) are not defined in shipped src/styles CSS.
motion: CSS transitions keyed off isAnimating set via setTimeout(10ms); exit uses setTimeout(animationDuration). Slide/fade relies on Tailwind classes translate-y-full/translate-y-0/bg-black/40 that are absent from the shipped CSS, so the entrance animation only works if the consumer runs Tailwind. No reduced-motion handling. Swipe-to-dismiss writes style.transform directly with no spring back animation.
a11y: role=dialog + aria-modal on inner panel, but no focus trap, no initial focus, no focus restore. Hard-coded ids 'action-sheet-title'/'action-sheet-message' collide when two sheets mount. Escape handled globally. Buttons get glass-focus + glass-touch-target. Backdrop is role=presentation (fine). Liquid branch buttons have no focus/touch-target classes.
api: forwardRef but the ref lands on the inner OptimizedGlass while ...props (and className) land on the wrapper div — split targets. open/onClose (not onOpenChange) — inconsistent with GlassBottomSheet/GlassDialog. Rules-of-hooks violation: early return for material='liquid' (line 120) precedes useEffect/useCallback (lines 160-225); toggling material at runtime crashes React. Keys use array index.
ssr: 'use client'. createPortal(content, document.body) at render time is guarded only by isVisible (false on first render), so SSR-safe in practice. body.style.overflow lock without restoring previous value.
fake_complexity: None claimed; sourceTransition/sourceId props are forwarded to LiquidGlassAdaptiveSheet where they only become a data attribute (no real source transition).
target: Single GlassSheet (side=bottom) built on primitives/portal + FocusScope + DismissableLayer, with an 'actions' preset
justification: An iOS-style action sheet is a legitimate pattern, but this is one of at least five independent bottom-sheet implementations in the library. It has a rules-of-hooks bug on the liquid path, no focus management, colliding static ids, and its animation depends on Tailwind classes the package does not ship. The behavior should become a preset of one canonical sheet that owns portal, focus, dismissal and motion.
evidence: src/components/mobile/GlassActionSheet.tsx:256-261 (props on wrapper, ref on inner OptimizedGlass)
Pixel stats desktop.png: mean RGB 241/244/247, max chroma 20 -> fully achromatic grey-on-white render; destructive/primary colors did not render

name: GlassPullToRefresh
material_impl: OptimizedGlass for the indicator pill; no bespoke rgba. Fixed 60px offsets hard-coded.
motion: Inline CSS transitions (0.3s ease-out) and damped pull distance; glass-animate-spin spinner. No reduced-motion handling (spinner and translate transitions always run).
a11y: No aria-live/role=status for 'Refreshing...' text, no aria-busy on the scroll container, no keyboard/button alternative for triggering refresh. Indicator text is visible but not announced.
api: forwardRef to outer div, className/props passthrough. Controlled 'refreshing' mirrored into internal state (fine). onRefresh errors are swallowed silently (line 217). Native listeners re-bound on every pullDistance change because handleTouchEnd depends on pullDistance.
ssr: 'use client'; listeners attached in effect only. SSR-safe.
fake_complexity: None — it does what it says.
justification: Functionally honest and reasonably small. It needs an announced status region, aria-busy, reduced-motion handling, a ref-based pull distance so listeners stop re-binding every frame, and surfaced error state. Only one story exists and it cannot show the pulled state, so the visual is unproven.
evidence: src/components/mobile/GlassPullToRefresh.tsx:207-235 (handleTouchEnd depends on pullDistance -> effect re-binds listeners at 237-254)

name: AdaptiveGlassDensity
material_impl: Computes a density of light/medium/heavy from width and DPR, then maps all three to the identical createGlassStyle({level2}) and overrides that with the hard-coded rgba style.
motion: initial opacity 0, animate={} when reduced motion -> the content stays invisible (opacity 0) for reduced-motion users.
a11y: Content is invisible to sighted reduced-motion users.
api: Plain function, className only.
ssr: window access only in effect; SSR-safe.
fake_complexity: Entirely fake: the 'adaptive density' computation has no visual effect.
justification: It does nothing it claims, and it hides content from reduced-motion users. Remove it.

name: MobileGlassBottomSheet
material_impl: createGlassStyle + hard-coded rgba override; backdrop hard-coded rgba(32,32,32,0.32).
motion: framer slide. Under reduced motion initial y:'100%' with animate={} means the sheet never comes on screen, and the backdrop stays at opacity 0 but still captures clicks.
a11y: No role=dialog, no aria-modal, no label, no focus trap, no Escape. The handle is a decorative div.
api: Plain function, isOpen (a third naming convention). Snap-point math compares a pixel Y coordinate to parseFloat('25vh')=25, so snapping is wrong. drag='y' with constraints 0/0.
fake_complexity: snapPoints are advertised, but the math is broken.
target: GlassSheet (canonical)
justification: This is the fifth bottom sheet. It is invisible for reduced-motion users, has no dialog semantics, and its snap points are broken.

name: MobileGlassNavigation
material_impl: Same createGlassStyle + hard-coded channelBalancedGlassStyle override; radius 24.
motion: framer drag='x' with dragConstraints 0 plus a ±50px nudge animation after a swipe; reduced motion sets duration 0.
a11y: Not navigation: no nav landmark, no keyboard equivalents for onSwipe*. drag='x' means vertical swipe detection only works from velocity.
api: Plain function (no forwardRef), className only, no style/props passthrough.
fake_complexity: Named 'Navigation' but it is a swipe-detecting div.
target: useSwipe hook
justification: A misnamed swipe wrapper with no navigation semantics and no keyboard path. It should be a hook if the behavior is kept at all.

name: TouchOptimizedGlass (alias TouchGlassOptimization)
material_impl: Calls createGlassStyle(level2) and then immediately overrides background/border/boxShadow with a hard-coded channelBalancedGlassStyle (rgba(255,255,255,0.28)/rgba(32,32,32,0.14)), so the shared token output is discarded. glassIntensity light/medium/heavy all map to the identical createGlassStyle call. Border radius hard-coded at 12px.
motion: framer-motion scale motion values + ripple AnimatePresence. Reduced motion is checked, but in the wrong place: animate={} with initial scale 0 means ripples never animate (harmless) while the press overlay never appears.
a11y: No role, no tabIndex, no keyboard activation for onTap/onLongPress; pure touch API. touch-none + select-none on the root blocks native scrolling. Haptics via navigator.vibrate without user opt-in.
api: forwardRef with a manual ref merge. e.preventDefault() in onTouchStart suppresses synthetic click and scrolling for children. onTap fires even after a swipe or pan (no movement threshold). The TouchGlassOptimization alias is not exported from root (only TouchOptimizedGlass is). Long-press timer is stored in state (stale closure risk).
ssr: 'use client'; window checks are guarded. SSR-safe.
fake_complexity: 'glassIntensity' and 'Optimization' are fake: the three intensities are identical and nothing is optimized.
target: usePress/useRipple hooks + GlassPressable primitive
justification: A touch-only surface that blocks scrolling and clicks, has no keyboard path, and whose intensity API does nothing. Ripple and press feedback belong in a shared interaction hook that every pressable glass control uses, not in a wrapper component.

name: TouchRippleEffects
material_impl: No glass; ripple color defaults to var(--glass-bg-hover). Uses raw Tailwind 'relative overflow-hidden' via template string instead of cn.
motion: framer ripple; under reduced motion ripples are mounted at scale 0 (invisible), which is acceptable.
a11y: Touch-only; no pointer or mouse support for desktop.
api: Plain function, className only. Ripple id uses Date.now(), so two touches in the same ms collide.
fake_complexity: None.
target: useRipple hook shared with GlassButton
justification: This is the same ripple implemented a second time in the same file. Fold it into one pointer-event ripple hook.

name: GlassBottomSheet
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level3 for the glass path; LiquidGlassAdaptiveSheet for material='liquid'. Backdrop uses glass-surface-dark/50 and glass-z-1100; glass-z-1100 has no definition in src/styles, so the backdrop has no z-index.
motion: Motion primitive presets fadeIn/slideUp. The sheet Motion is always mounted; when open=false and motion is allowed, no transform is applied (line 181 only translates when !shouldAnimate). The closed sheet therefore stays rendered at its slid-in position with pointer-events-none (verified by reading code, not executed). There is no exit animation.
a11y: createModalA11y gives role/aria; announceToScreenReader on open. No focus trap or initial focus. Escape only works when focus is inside the sheet (onKeyDown). The backdrop has no aria-hidden.
api: open/onOpenChange (good) but does not extend HTMLAttributes. Rules-of-hooks violation: useA11yId (wraps useId) is called conditionally on title/description (lines 94-97). ref goes to inner OptimizedGlass while props go to the Motion wrapper.
fake_complexity: sourceId/presentationMode are passed through to LiquidGlassAdaptiveSheet, where they are only data attributes.
target: GlassSheet (canonical, side=bottom) on Portal/FocusScope/DismissableLayer
justification: The closed state appears to leave the sheet visible, hooks are called conditionally, there is no focus trap, and the z-index class does not exist. A bottom sheet is a glass-signature surface, so the concept should survive as one canonical sheet with real detents, drag, and focus management.
evidence: Pixel stats desktop.png: mean 249, sd 9, min luminance 100 -> very low-contrast pale surface, no dark text

name: GlassDialog
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level2 with liftOnHover + hoverSheen (a dialog that lifts on hover), or LiquidGlassMaterial. Backdrop is a hard-coded double linear-gradient rgba(255,255,255,.08)/rgba(15,23,42,.20). Urgency tint is hard-coded rgba(220,38,38,.12). Uses the glass-radial-reveal and glass-text-secondary-foreground classes, which are undefined in src/styles.
motion: Motion presets scale/fade/slide/flip and useReducedMotion is honored for presets. Exit is a setTimeout delay with no exit animation.
a11y: role=dialog is placed on the full-viewport wrapper (which includes the backdrop), not on the panel. trapFocus is used with manual focus restore. Escape on document. No portal, so stacking contexts can clip it. aria-label fallback is 'Dialog'.
api: Both onOpenChange and onClose. ...props are spread twice (outer wrapper and inner glass) and className is applied twice (wrapper and surface). The DialogTrigger/DialogHeader/useDialog compound parts and six Glass*Dialog consciousness variants are not exported from root (dead surface).
ssr: 'use client'; document access only in effects; SSR-safe.
fake_complexity: The 'consciousness' features (predictive, eyeTracking, adaptive biometrics, spatialAudio, achievements) are inline no-op mocks: biometrics return a constant stressLevel 0.3 and eye tracking start/stop do nothing. Even so, they run a 1s setInterval re-render while open and a 3s interval when adaptive. The 'Dialog Insights' badge renders fake urgency.
target: GlassModal -> canonical GlassDialog rebuilt on Portal/FocusScope/DismissableLayer
justification: This is a 1,059-line near-copy of GlassModal. Roughly half of it is fake consciousness telemetry that causes per-second re-renders. Its focus trap is real, but role=dialog sits on the backdrop wrapper, props and className are duplicated, it is not portaled, and the dialog surface lifts on hover. Merge it into one dialog.
evidence: Pixel stats desktop.png: mean 200/201/205 (dimmed backdrop rendered), max chroma 83, min luminance 91 -> no true dark text

name: GlassDrawer
material_impl: OptimizedGlass (liftOnHover, hoverSheen) or LiquidGlassMaterial. The backdrop uses the same hard-coded gradient as GlassDialog. Size classes are raw Tailwind (w-96, w-[28rem], h-64, rounded-l-xl); w-96 and rounded-l-xl are not defined in shipped src/styles, so drawer width depends on the consumer's Tailwind.
motion: Motion presets slideLeft/Right/Up/Down; reduced motion is honored for presets. No exit animation (timeout only). data-time-spent={Date.now()-...} is computed during render.
a11y: No focus trap and no initial focus or restore at all, even though aria-modal is true by default. Hard-coded ids 'drawer-title'/'drawer-description' collide. role=dialog sits on the full-viewport wrapper.
api: open defaults to TRUE (GlassDialog defaults to false). Rules-of-hooks violation: usePredictiveEngine/useEyeTracking/useBiometricAdaptation/useSpatialAudio/useInteractionRecorder/useAchievements are called conditionally (lines 227-232). It imports the real advanced/* modules, which pulls a large dependency graph into every drawer.
ssr: 'use client'. Date.now() in render causes hydration mismatches when SSR-rendered open.
fake_complexity: Eye tracking is wired to nothing (the startTracking call is commented out, lines 444-446). The 'Drawer Insights' badge is fake.
target: GlassSheet (side=left|right|top|bottom) on shared primitives
justification: This is a modal drawer with no focus management, conditional hooks, colliding ids, an open=true default, and width classes the package does not ship. It also imports the advanced 'consciousness' modules for features that are stubs. Fold it into a single sheet primitive with side variants.

name: GlassHoverCard
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level3 plus stacked bespoke classes (glass-backdrop-blur-md, glass-surface-dark/20, glass-border-white/20, glass-shadow-2xl), so the material is defined twice. The arrow is a bespoke bg-white/10 rotated div clipped by clip-path.
motion: Motion fadeIn, honoring the motion-preference context.
a11y: Opens on mouseenter only: no focus, no touch, no Escape. role=tooltip is placed on a card meant to hold interactive content, and the trigger gets no aria-describedby. Every open is announced with announceToScreenReader.
api: forwardRef to inner glass. Rules-of-hooks violation: conditional useA11yId (lines 194-197). The align prop is accepted but unused. The GlassHoverCardContent/Trigger compound parts are cosmetic (Trigger asChild only merges className and no handlers).
ssr: 'use client'; window only in handlers. Not portaled and uses glass-z-9999, which is undefined in src/styles.
fake_complexity: None, but the compound API is decorative.
target: GlassPopover rebuilt on primitives/positioning (hover-intent mode)
justification: This is a third hand-rolled floating-position engine (alongside Popover and Tooltip) in a library that already ships Positioner, Portal and DismissableLayer primitives used by GlassDropdownMenu. It is mouse-only with the wrong role. Make it a hover-intent mode of one floating primitive.
evidence: Pixel stats desktop.png: max chroma 23, min luminance 71

name: GlassModal
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level4 strong with glass-overlay-noise/glass-edge/glass-overlay-specular layers, or LiquidGlassMaterial (ior/thickness/tint). This is the best-layered material in the shard. The backdrop is the same hard-coded gradient. backdropBlur sm/md/lg all map to glass-backdrop-blur-md (fake scale).
motion: Motion presets; reduced motion honored. No exit animation (it unmounts immediately when open=false). 'flip' maps to scaleIn.
a11y: Best in shard: the FocusTrap primitive with onEscape, initialFocus/restoreFocus refs, role dialog|alertdialog, announced open, and body scroll lock that preserves scroll position. role and aria props sit on the surface, not the backdrop. Not portaled.
api: open defaults to TRUE and onClose is a no-op default. The open/onClose naming differs from Dialog/Popover (onOpenChange). Rules-of-hooks violation: conditional useA11yId (lines 309-312). 'contained' and 'compact' modes are useful. It re-exports GlassDialog/GlassDrawer.
ssr: 'use client'; mounted guard prevents SSR output entirely, so the modal never SSR-renders. Date.now() is used in a render-time data attribute.
fake_complexity: The same consciousness mocks as GlassDialog: constant stress 0.3 and no-op eye tracking. A predictive 'Modal Insights' badge is injected into user content.
target: Canonical GlassDialog/GlassSheet family (absorbs GlassDialog, GlassDrawer, GlassBottomSheet, GlassActionSheet, LiquidGlassAdaptiveSheet, MobileGlassBottomSheet)
justification: This is the most correct overlay in the shard (real FocusTrap, focus restore, scroll lock, alertdialog support) and the richest material stack, so it is the right base for a flagship dialog. It still needs to drop the consciousness mocks, call hooks unconditionally, portal through primitives/portal, use onOpenChange with a false default, add exit animation via AnimatePresence, and make the blur scale real. It then becomes the single overlay engine for sheet and drawer variants.
evidence: Pixel stats desktop.png: mean 203/204/208 (dimmed backdrop), max chroma 80

name: GlassPopover
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level4 plus stacked bespoke classes (bg-background/95, glass-backdrop-blur-md, border-border/20, shadow-lg, glass-lift, glass-sheen). bg-background/95 makes it nearly opaque, which defeats the glass. The 'solid' appearance is a plain div. The arrow uses bg-background, a raw Tailwind token.
motion: Motion presets. useReducedMotion is imported but never applied (getAnimationPreset ignores it, lines 433-448).
a11y: Trigger gets aria-expanded/aria-haspopup='dialog' but no aria-controls. The role=dialog with aria-label 'Popover content' sits on a full-viewport pointer-events-none wrapper, not on the panel. FocusTrap is used for click/focus triggers and Escape is handled. title/description are not wired to aria-labelledby, and the liquid branch drops title/description entirely.
api: Controlled/uncontrolled with defaultOpen (good). Trigger is cloneElement with a ref override, which clobbers the child's own ref. The same file declares a second, different GlassTooltip; its disabled early return precedes useState, a hooks-order violation.
ssr: 'use client'; not portaled; position computed in effect; SSR-safe.
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassPopover on primitives/positioning + portal + dismissable-layer (canonical floating surface for Popover/HoverCard/Tooltip/Menu)
justification: Its controlled/uncontrolled API and FocusTrap are a good base. It reimplements positioning and flip logic by hand instead of using the library's own Positioner, and it nests a near-opaque bg-background/95 inside glass. The role is on the wrong element, and it ships a conflicting second GlassTooltip. Rebuild it as the single floating primitive.
evidence: Pixel stats desktop.png: min luminance 114 -> no text darker than mid-grey

name: GlassTooltip
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level4. The arrow is a CSS border triangle using glass-border-b-white/20 (near-invisible on light). glass-z-9999 is undefined in src/styles.
motion: Motion presets; respects the motion-preference context.
a11y: Fails WCAG 1.4.13/2.1.1: it opens on mouseenter only, with no focus/blur, no Escape, and no touch. aria-describedby is set on a wrapper div, not on the focusable trigger. Every show also triggers announceToScreenReader, which double-announces.
api: forwardRef. Position styles are computed during render from tooltipRef, which is null on the render that mounts the tooltip, so the first (and usually only) render places it at its static position and not next to the trigger. Rules-of-hooks: `id || useA11yId(...)` is a conditional hook call. GlassTooltipTrigger/GlassTooltipContent are exported from root but are pass-through fragments that do nothing.
fake_complexity: The compound Trigger/Content API is fake. The Storybook stories render a StaticTooltipPreview div (a hand-styled stand-in, not the component) to show the tooltip, so the certified screenshot is not the real component's bubble.
duplicates: GlassTooltip inside GlassPopover.tsx (same export name, different API)
target: GlassTooltip on primitives/positioning + portal (focus+hover, Escape, describedby on trigger)
justification: A tooltip is a foundational primitive, and this one is mouse-only, mispositioned on first paint, and paired with no-op compound parts. Its stories fake the visual with a static div. Two components share the GlassTooltip name with different APIs. Rebuild it on the shared floating primitive and delete the duplicate.
evidence: Pixel stats desktop.png: max chroma 0, min luminance 117 -> monochrome, no legible dark text

name: LiquidGlassAdaptiveSheet
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial (material=liquid, variant regular|clear) + LiquidGlassScrollEdge, which is the correct primitive. It then overrides background with a hard-coded double white gradient and forces --glass-text-primary to rgb(15,23,42), so it is light-mode only. Backdrop button uses glass-bg-black/30; the root uses glass-z-1100, which is undefined in src/styles.
motion: None: no enter/exit animation and no detents, despite the 'adaptive' naming.
a11y: role=dialog, aria-modal only when interruptive, and the backdrop is a labeled 'Close sheet' button (nice). No focus trap, initial focus, restore, or scroll lock. aria-label=title rather than aria-labelledby to the h2.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes passthrough, open/onOpenChange. side bottom|left|right with a fixed w-96. Small and clean.
ssr: 'use client'; document only in effect. Not portaled.
fake_complexity: 'Adaptive' and sourceId 'source transition' are cosmetic: sourceId becomes data-source-id and nothing animates from the source (LiquidGlassSourceTransition primitive exists but is unused).
target: GlassSheet material='liquid' using LiquidGlassSourceTransition for real source morphs
justification: It uses the right primitive, but the Liquid Glass promise (adaptive detents, source morph, dark/light adaptation) is not implemented: it is a static light-only panel with hard-coded slate text and no motion. It should become the liquid material variant of the canonical sheet, which already has the focus and motion engine.

name: LiquidGlassPopoverMenu
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial, overridden with hard-coded white gradients and slate text vars. It injects a <style> block per instance with !important overrides on every button (light-only colors, min-height 44px).
motion: None.
a11y: role=menu/menuitem, but aria-checked on menuitem is invalid (needs menuitemcheckbox/menuitemradio). No arrow-key roving focus, no typeahead, no Escape, no focus on open. Not positioned: it is not anchored to any trigger.
api: forwardRef + HTMLAttributes. Items-array API. 'Popover' in the name, but there is no trigger, positioning, or dismissal.
fake_complexity: sourceId is a data attribute only.
duplicates: GlassDropdownMenu / GlassMenuPrimitive (real menu primitives with RovingFocus)
target: GlassDropdownMenu (material='liquid')
justification: The library already has a menu primitive with roving focus and positioning. This is an unanchored list of buttons with invalid ARIA and per-instance !important CSS injection. Its liquid look should be a material option on the real menu.

name: CollapsedMenu

tests.notes: templated render/axe/snapshot tests

material_impl: Shared OptimizedGlass (level3/strong) plus raw Tailwind hover:bg-white/10 and glass-focus-ring-white-opacity-30 utilities; no tokens for item surfaces.
motion: CSS transition-all + hover translate; gated by useReducedMotion via respectMotionPreference (wired, L29-30, L60).
a11y: Wrapper is role=navigation but children are role=menuitem with no role=menu parent (invalid ARIA, L42/L53); every item tabIndex=0 with no arrow-key/Escape handling; aria-label optional and unset by default; buttons lack type=button.
api: forwardRef but items: any[] and onItemClick(item: any) (L10-11); no style passthrough; absolute positioning hard-coded (top-full right-0).
fake_complexity: None.
duplicates: GlassDropdownMenu (overflow menu should be a DropdownMenu)
target: GlassDropdownMenu (GlassTabBar overflow should render DropdownMenu.Content)
justification: A private overflow popover for GlassTabBar that re-implements menu semantics incorrectly (menuitems inside a navigation landmark, no roving focus, no Escape). The library already has a far more complete GlassDropdownMenu; GlassTabBar should use it and this file should be deleted along with its story/test which only exist to bump coverage.

name: ScrollButtons
material_impl: Inline createGlassStyle({intent:'neutral', elevation:'level2'}) per button (L26, L37).
motion: None.
a11y: aria-label present, type=button; glyphs are text characters (‹/›) not icons; glass-touch-target class only.
api: Not forwardRef; className interpolated as template string so missing className renders literal 'undefined' class (L28, L39); no disabled state.
fake_complexity: None.
target: IconButton with library chevron icons inside GlassTabBar
justification: Trivial internal helper using typographic chevrons and a className bug that emits 'undefined'. Not a design-system component; fold into GlassTabBar using the shared IconButton and @/icons ChevronLeft/Right.

name: TabItem
material_impl: Bespoke inline styles: active background rgba(255,255,255,0.28), badge rgba(255,255,255,0.3), hard-coded padding 8px 16px / radius 6px (L99-118, L143-150). No glass primitive.
motion: Inline 'transition: all 0.2s ease' with no reduced-motion handling (L117).
a11y: role=tab, aria-selected, roving tabIndex, Arrow/Home/End handling via DOM query of siblings (L55-87) - reasonable. Badge renders falsy 0 as text '0' (L140) and aria-label 'N notifications' assumes semantics. Duplicate class list string (L124).
api: Not forwardRef; spreads rest; style merge OK; id is prefixed 'tab-' globally so two tab bars with same ids collide (L93).
fake_complexity: None.
target: GlassTabItem / single Tabs primitive
justification: Keyboard handling is actually decent, but it is a second private tab-trigger implementation with hard-coded rgba and px values while a public GlassTabItem exists. Merge into one tab trigger used by every tab component.

name: EnhancedGlassTabs
material_impl: OptimizedGlass container; tab colors via getTabColors returning hard-coded rgba(255,255,255,0.28)/0.82 plus color-mix tokens (L186-207). The color prop computes selectedColor that is never used (L183-184) - color variants are dead.
motion: Indicator slides with CSS transition; reduced motion wired. But transition classes are built with template literals (glass-duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms] L470, L536) which no static CSS pipeline can generate, so transitions likely no-op.
a11y: Roving tabIndex (inactive = -1, L464) with NO onKeyDown arrow handler anywhere -> keyboard users can only reach the active tab and can never switch tabs. aria-controls points to non-existent 'tabpanel-*' ids (L466). Wrapped in a <nav> landmark (tabs are not navigation). Dark mode via OS media query, not theme (L211-225). Hover colors mutated imperatively via e.currentTarget.style (L500-511).
api: forwardRef exposes imperative handle (not the DOM node); size small|medium|large conflicts with library sm|md|lg; physicsEnabled prop unused; color prop dead; controlled/uncontrolled partially (activeTab sync effect).
ssr: 'use client'; window.matchMedia in effect only; ResizeObserver in effect; OK.
fake_complexity: 'High-contrast, accessibility-focused' docblock (L5) is false: no keyboard navigation; 'physicsEnabled' does nothing.
target: GlassPageTabs (or a single unified GlassTabs)
justification: One of at least six tab implementations, and the one whose marketing ('accessibility-focused') is most contradicted by code: keyboard users cannot change tabs, panels it claims to control do not exist, the color prop is dead, and its motion classes cannot compile. GlassPageTabs already does APG-correct tabs; deprecate this with a codemod mapping tabs/activeTab/onChange to tabs/value/onChange.

name: GlassBottomNav
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level2 container with GlassButton primary/ghost items; 'elevation' prop is accepted but ignored (hard-coded elevation='level2' L237). Variant styling relies on glass-border-glass-border/20 utilities.
motion: Active icon scale via CSS (gated by reduced motion); Motion preset for dot indicator.
a11y: Uses role=tablist/tab for app navigation instead of <nav> + links with aria-current (L165, L260). Inactive items tabIndex=-1 with no arrow-key handler (L168) -> keyboard users can only reach the active destination. aria-controls references non-existent nav-panel-* ids (L167). aria-label hard-coded 'Bottom navigation' and cannot be overridden before ...props spread order (it can via props, but id is overwritten).
api: forwardRef OK; item.href is declared but never rendered as a link (L17 unused) - no router/Link integration; renderItem escape hatch; elevation type (0-4|float|modal) mismatches OptimizedGlass levels.
fake_complexity: None, but 'safeArea' adds class pb-safe that has no visible definition in the shard.
target: Merge with LiquidGlassTabBar as a single link-based bottom tab bar
justification: The core mobile chrome surface, but it misuses tab semantics for navigation, traps keyboard users on the active item, ignores href and elevation, and stacks a GlassButton pill inside a glass slab rather than reading as an iOS-grade tab bar. Rebuild on LiquidGlassMaterial with nav/a + aria-current, asChild for router links and real safe-area insets.

name: GlassBreadcrumb (+ GlassBreadcrumbItem, GlassBreadcrumbSeparator, GlassBreadcrumbLink, GlassBreadcrumbCompound)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass pill plus redundant raw Tailwind 'glass-backdrop-blur-md ring-1 ring-white/10 bg-white/10' stacked on top (L180).
motion: Hover translate on items, gated by useReducedMotion per item.
a11y: nav/ol/li structure and aria-current correct. But the <nav> sits INSIDE the glass div and the glass div also receives ...props including aria-label (double label). Only GlassBreadcrumb is root-exported (src/index.ts:91) - Item/Link/Separator/Compound are not, so consumers cannot build accessible items with aria-current from the public API. GlassBreadcrumbLink with isCurrentPage drops the ref and the rest props (L332-337). Separator in container is aria-hidden (good) but GlassBreadcrumbSeparator would double-render separators if used with the container.
api: forwardRef with ref as any; style: computed maxWidth style is overwritten by the later {...props} spread containing style (L186-197) so maxWidth/contained are lost whenever style is passed; maxItems truncation logic is duplicated twice (L131-144, L152-167) and maxItems=1 yields slice(-0) = whole array; keys are array index.
fake_complexity: None.
target: single Breadcrumb family (merge with app-shell GlassBreadcrumbs; export Item/Link/Separator)
justification: Structurally sound breadcrumb with correct list semantics, but three breadcrumb implementations exist, the compound parts are not publicly exported, the style-spread bug defeats the contained/maxWidth features, and maxItems math is duplicated and wrong at edge values. Merge into one family with asChild links.

name: GlassCommandBar
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level2 container; buttons use raw utility strings (hover:glass-bg-white/10 glass-border-white/10); kbd chip glass-surface-subtle/10.
motion: Hover scale 105% gated by reduced motion.
a11y: role=toolbar with aria-label hard-coded 'Command bar' (L59) but no roving-tabindex arrow navigation as the toolbar pattern requires; buttons lack type=button; shortcut is visual only (no aria-keyshortcuts).
api: forwardRef targets the inner glass, while className goes to inner and position wrapper div is unreachable; returns null on non-array items; 'position' only toggles a margin.
fake_complexity: Named 'CommandBar' but it is a wrapped row of buttons - no command search, no overflow.
target: LiquidGlassToolbar / GlassToolbar
justification: A 111-line button row that overlaps five other toolbar/action-bar components and lacks the toolbar keyboard model its role promises. Fold into the toolbar family as a 'compact actions' variant.

name: GlassContextMenu (+ GlassContextMenuContent, GlassContextMenuItem, useContextMenu)

tests.notes: no test clicks a menu item with real pointer sequence

material_impl: OptimizedGlass level4 with liftOnHover + hoverSheen plus raw 'glass-backdrop-blur-lg bg-white/10 border border-white/20 shadow-2xl' stacked (L299) - double material; destructive uses Tailwind text-red-400 rather than danger token.
motion: Motion preset scaleIn (primitive honours reduced motion); items hover translate unconditionally; respectMotionPreference prop declared but never destructured or used (L68).
a11y: BLOCKER: document 'mousedown' listener closes the menu on ANY mousedown including inside the menu (L172-182, no target check), so the menu unmounts before 'click' fires and mouse selection of items cannot work. No focus moved into the menu on open; trigger div is not focusable and there is no keyboard way to open (cert DOM shows only the 3 skip links focusable). Menu items are tabIndex=0 each (not roving). Submenu is nested inside the parent role=menu as a div sibling without proper aria-controls.
api: React.FC (no forwardRef); menuClassName ?? className applies the trigger class to the menu too (L223); position adjustment writes style imperatively; useContextMenu.createSeparator uses Date.now() ids (duplicate keys when called twice in a tick, L499).
fake_complexity: None, but align/side positioning ignores pointer location for side='bottom' default (y forced to rect.bottom, L162) so a right-click menu does not open at the cursor by default.
target: GlassContextMenu rebuilt on GlassDropdownMenu content/item primitives (Positioner at pointer, DismissableLayer, FocusScope autoFocus)
justification: The outside-click handler closes the menu on mousedown inside it, so the primary interaction (click an item) is broken; there is no keyboard entry, default positioning ignores the cursor, and material is double-stacked. The dropdown family already has DismissableLayer/Positioner/FocusScope - rebuild the context menu as a thin trigger over those.

name: GlassDropdownMenu (+ Trigger, Content, Item, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup, RadioItem, Label, Separator, Shortcut, Sub, SubTrigger, SubContent)

tests.notes: keyboard test fires keyDown on the menu node directly, masking the focus-entry gap

material_impl: Bespoke: inline background rgba(255,255,255,0.24), border rgba(255,255,255,0.24), backdropFilter 'blur(24px) saturate(1.45) brightness(1.04) contrast(1.04)' hard-coded in Content and duplicated in SubContent (L320-326, L882-888); does NOT use OptimizedGlass/LiquidGlassMaterial or tokens.
motion: Motion scaleIn wrapper plus Radix/tailwindcss-animate data-state classes (animate-in, zoom-in-95, slide-in-from-top-2) that this repo does not ship - dead classes.
a11y: Good skeleton (Radix-like): aria-haspopup/expanded/controls on trigger, roles menu/menuitem/menuitemcheckbox/menuitemradio, Arrow/Home/End/Escape with focus return. Gaps: Item has no Enter/Space handler - div role=menuitem only reacts to click, so keyboard users cannot activate items (L446-462); FocusScope is used without autoFocus (L372, FocusScope autoFocus defaults false) so focus stays on trigger after Enter/ArrowDown open; RadioItem indicator dot is glass-bg-transparent (L608) - selected radio is invisible; no typeahead.
api: Best API in shard: controlled/uncontrolled via useControllableOpen, asChild trigger via Slot, onSelect with preventDefault, portal/contained strategies, forwardRef everywhere, DropdownMenu namespace. 'modal' prop accepted and discarded.
ssr: 'use client'; Portal used; document access only in handlers.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: The only menu in the library with a credible primitive architecture (controllable state, Slot, Positioner, DismissableLayer, FocusScope, sub-menus). It should become the single menu engine for context menu, menubar, header user menu and tab overflow. Required polish: Enter/Space activation, autofocus first item on open, typeahead, visible radio indicator, replace hard-coded rgba/blur with the shared Liquid Glass material and tokens, remove dead tailwindcss-animate classes.

name: GlassHeader (+ internal NotificationButton, UserMenu; exported-from-file HeaderBreadcrumbs, HeaderNavigation, ConsciousGlassHeader, PredictiveHeader, GazeResponsiveHeader, AccessibleHeader, HeaderConsciousnessPresets)

tests.notes: templated render/axe/snapshot; no behaviour tests for menus or search

material_impl: Two full render paths: LiquidGlassMaterial (material='liquid') and OptimizedGlass with an overriding inline style background rgba(255,255,255,0.12) + hard-coded triple box-shadow (L631-635). ~240 lines of JSX duplicated verbatim between the two paths (L393-612 vs L639-855). Dropdowns use arbitrary glass-shadow-[...rgba(2,8,23,0.55)] utilities.
motion: Motion slideDown for dropdowns; hamburger morph via Tailwind duration-[${...}ms] template classes (L402) which cannot compile; no reduced-motion handling in header itself.
a11y: Root gets role=navigation AND contains nested <nav> elements (double landmark, L629/L432); should be <header>/banner. Notification and user menus use full-viewport click-catcher divs (L995-1000, L1248-1253) instead of DismissableLayer; user menu items are plain buttons without role=menu/menuitem despite aria-haspopup=menu; mobile search button focuses document.querySelector('input[placeholder*=Search]') globally - may focus another component's input (L840-843); suggestions list not a combobox/listbox.
api: Violates Rules of Hooks: hooks called conditionally (predictive ? usePredictiveEngine() : null, etc. L181-189) - toggling a prop between renders crashes React. Each consciousness hook throws outside its provider, so ConsciousGlassHeader/GazeResponsiveHeader crash without 4-5 providers. External style prop is silently overridden (comment L361). Scroll effect re-subscribes on every scroll because state is in deps (L229-235). trackNavigation is defined but never called (L288). UserMenu navigates with window.location.href (L1036) - breaks SPA routers.
ssr: 'use client'; window only in effects, but module imports ~6.4k lines of advanced 'consciousness' modules (PredictiveEngine, AchievementSystem, BiometricAdaptation, EyeTracking/webgazer, SpatialAudio) even for a plain header (L25-32) - heavy bundle cost.
fake_complexity: Severe. Hard-coded fake notifications rendered whenever an action has id 'notifications' ('New evaluation completed', 'GPT-4 vs Claude-3.5 Sonnet', 'Sarah Chen joined your organization', badge '3') - demo data in library code (L911-987). 'Biometric' header resizes on 'stress level' (L238-260); 'gaze responsive' only adds shadow-lg; 'Predicted' suggestions with emoji labels; 'AccessibleHeader' preset is just biometric + spatial audio.
duplicates: HeaderBreadcrumbs vs GlassBreadcrumb vs app-shell GlassBreadcrumbs
target: GlassTopBar (app-shell) composed with GlassDropdownMenu, GlassBreadcrumb and a real search combobox
justification: The library's primary header ships fake product data, conditional hooks, a 240-line duplicated render path, double navigation landmarks, global DOM querying, full-page click catchers and ~6.4k lines of pseudo-scientific 'consciousness' imports. None of that belongs in a premium first-party header. Replace with a slim, slot-based top bar (app-shell GlassTopBar) and delete the Conscious/Predictive/Gaze/Accessible variants and presets.

name: GlassMenubar (+ GlassMenubarContent, GlassMenubarItem, useMenubar, createFileMenu, createEditMenu)
material_impl: Built on GlassMenuPrimitive (OptimizedGlass root + DismissableLayer content). Every item inherits GlassMenuPrimitiveItem's inline bordered pill (rgba 0.18 bg, 0.3 border, radius 12, marginBottom 8) so the menubar renders as a column/row of bordered buttons rather than a menubar.
motion: Motion scaleIn on content (primitive honours reduced motion); underline after: transition.
a11y: Submenus are rendered as a nested GlassMenubar -> role=menubar inside a menu (L243-250) - invalid ARIA. Every item focusable (no roving tabindex). Hover close bug: GlassMenubarItem onMouseLeave calls onCloseSubmenu which clears ALL open menus (L366-368, L216), so moving the pointer from a top item into its submenu closes it. Separators render twice (parent L197-206 and item L370-377).
api: React.FC (no forwardRef), no style passthrough; MenuItem type duplicates ContextMenuItem/NavigationItem shapes; createFileMenu/createEditMenu export no-op demo actions in library code (L573-659); useMenubar separator ids from Date.now().
ssr: 'use client'; document listeners in effects only.
fake_complexity: Preset menus with empty action bodies ('implement based on your needs').
target: Menubar built on GlassDropdownMenu primitives (Menubar.Menu/Trigger/Content)
justification: Recursive self-nesting produces invalid menubar-in-menu semantics, hover closes submenus before the pointer can reach them, separators double-render, and the visual is a stack of bordered pills. A desktop-app menubar is valuable for a premium kit but must be rebuilt as a compound API over the dropdown engine.

name: GlassMenuPrimitive (Root, Content, Item)

tests.notes: covered indirectly by GlassMenubar tests

material_impl: Root: OptimizedGlass + redundant 'glass-backdrop-blur-md ring-1 ring-white/10 bg-white/5'. Content: DismissableLayer with raw Tailwind blur/bg/border. Item: hard-coded inline rgba background/border, 12px radius, two-layer box-shadow and marginBottom 8 (L132-146) - an item style no menu should have.
motion: None (item hover translate class only, no reduced-motion gate).
a11y: Root is always role=menubar regardless of use; Item is a plain button without role (consumer must add); FocusScope loop in Content good; min-height 44 touch target good.
api: forwardRef on all parts; namespace export. Content 'positionStrategy' is only a data attribute. Inline style + className both define padding/radius (conflicting sources of truth).
fake_complexity: Called a 'primitive' but hard-codes visual opinions (pill items with margin) that leak into every consumer.
target: GlassDropdownMenu internals (+ src/primitives roving-focus)
justification: A second, weaker menu primitive alongside the dropdown engine, with hard-coded item chrome that makes the menubar look like a button stack. Collapse into one headless menu primitive (shared by dropdown, context, menubar) with material applied from tokens.

name: GlassMobileNav
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level2 drawer (elevation prop 'modal' default is ignored); backdrop is Motion div with inline white rgba(255,255,255,0.2) + gradient overlay + backdrop blur (L319-323) - a white scrim, odd for dark themes.
motion: CSS transform slide with explicit prefersReducedMotion branch and motion-reduce:transition-none (wired, L354-356); Motion slideDown for children.
a11y: Best of the nav group: role=dialog, aria-modal, inert when closed, FocusTrap with restoreFocus/autoFocus/Escape, body scroll lock with restore, close button labelled. Gaps: items are GlassButtons even when href is set (no <a>, so no open-in-new-tab, no aria-current; active state only visual) (L243-254); expandable items lack aria-expanded; '▶' glyph chevron and '×' close icon text.
api: forwardRef; open/onOpenChange controlled only; variant overlay|push|slide all map to identical classes (positionClasses L143-164) - push/slide are fake variants; elevation unused; renderItem escape hatch.
ssr: 'use client'; document.body access in effect only.
fake_complexity: variant='push' and 'slide' do nothing different from 'overlay'.
justification: Solid dialog mechanics (focus trap, inert, scroll lock, reduced motion) make this the most production-ready nav surface here, but items must render real links with aria-current, the fake push/slide variants and ignored elevation should be removed or implemented, and the white scrim should be theme-aware. Longer term it should be the Sheet primitive + a nav list rather than a standalone drawer.

name: GlassNavigation (alias GlassNavbar)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass container; inline rgba styles on buttons (rgba(100,116,139,.16), rgba(255,255,255,.16), rgba(148,163,184,.28)); active state uses Tailwind text-blue-200/bg-blue-500/15 - off-palette blue that fails contrast on light glass.
motion: Indicator via CSS transition, hidden under reduced motion; useAnimationContext spring config resolved (L160-177) but never applied to anything.
a11y: Outer <nav> wraps an OptimizedGlass with role=navigation (double landmark, L467/L480); <ul role=menubar> containing links/buttons without menuitem roles (invalid); posinset/setsize on links; the 'Tooltip' is a div title (L42-48); mobile toggle classes 'hidden md:hidden lg:hidden max-md:flex' depend on Tailwind that the package does not ship (only a storybook-utility-shim).
api: forwardRef; glassIntensity and showLabels destructured and never used; renderNavItem useCallback deps omit position/items/handleNavKeyDown; huge prop surface (types.ts) with mixed id/key identity.
fake_complexity: Stub Icon component renders the same '🔹' emoji for every icon name (menu, close, chevrons, expand) (L36-40) - the mobile toggle, collapse button and expand indicators all show a blue diamond. Imports spring physics and animation context that do nothing.
target: GlassTopBar (app-shell) + GlassSidebar for vertical
justification: A catch-all navbar whose icons are a placeholder emoji, whose tooltips are title attributes, whose spring/intensity props are dead, and whose responsive toggle depends on Tailwind classes the package does not ship. It overlaps the header, sidebar and app-shell top bar. Remove (keep GlassNavbar alias pointing at the replacement for one major).

name: GlassNavigationMenu (+ GlassNavigationMenuContent, GlassNavigationMenuItem, useNavigationMenu, createDashboardNavigation, createAdminNavigation)
material_impl: OptimizedGlass as='nav' plus variant utility strings (glass-backdrop-blur ring-1 ring-white/10); nested submenus re-render a full OptimizedGlass nav inside (glass-on-glass stacking, L239); badges glass-surface-red; featured dot glass-surface-yellow with pulse.
motion: Motion slideDown/rotateIn presets; hover-intent timers 120/180ms; featured indicator animate-pulse with no reduced-motion gate.
a11y: OptimizedGlass as='nav' AND role='navigation' (redundant); every nested submenu is another <nav> landmark; links are rendered as <button> and navigate via window.location.href / window.open (L150-158) - no real anchors, no middle-click, no aria-current; submenu toggle is a <span> with aria-label and onClick but not focusable (L467-481); aria-haspopup='menu' on disclosure (should be aria-expanded only).
api: React.FC (no forwardRef); NavigationItem type name collides with types.ts NavigationItem used by GlassNavigation; useNavigationMenu also hard-navigates; demo presets with emoji icons exported from library.
fake_complexity: None, but 'Advanced navigation menu' is a disclosure list.
target: GlassSidebar / LiquidGlassInsetSidebar nav tree
justification: A disclosure nav list that hard-navigates with window.location, renders links as buttons, nests landmarks and glass-in-glass, and ships emoji demo presets. Its job is the sidebar tree; merge into the sidebar family with link/asChild items.

name: GlassPageTabs
material_impl: CSS module (GlassPageTabs.module.css) with layered surface: backdrop-filter from --aura-glass-neutral-level2-backdrop-blur token, ::before specular gradient, inset highlight + hairline + soft drop shadow tokens; selected trigger gradient. Tokens with fallbacks throughout; but ink is hard-coded to black (--glass-page-tabs-ink rgba(black/0.9), CSS L2-19) so it is light-theme only.
motion: CSS transitions on tokenised durations/easing; prefers-reduced-motion block disables transitions and press scale (CSS L259-267).
a11y: APG-correct: tablist/tab/tabpanel wiring with useId ids, roving tabIndex, Arrow/Home/End skipping disabled, automatic vs manual activation, panel aria-labelledby + tabIndex 0, visible focus ring token, forced-colors and prefers-reduced-transparency support (CSS L269-303). Missing: vertical orientation still accepts Left/Right (fine), no dark-theme ink.
api: forwardRef, controlled/uncontrolled (value/defaultValue/onChange), orientation, activationMode, renderPanel; className/props passthrough. Data-driven only (tabs array) - no compound Tabs.List/Trigger/Panel for custom layouts; no size variant.
ssr: 'use client'; document.getElementById only in handlers; useId-safe ids.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: The reference implementation in this shard: real APG keyboard model, tokenised CSS-module material with specular layer, reduced-motion/transparency/forced-colors handling, SSR-safe ids. It should be the base of a single Tabs family (add compound parts, dark-theme ink tokens, size scale, tests, and a certification screenshot) and the other five tab components should be deprecated into it.

name: GlassPagination (+ GlassPaginationContent, GlassPaginationItem, usePagination, GlassPaginationWithInfo)

tests.notes: templated; no keyboard or page-change interaction test

material_impl: Every page number is its own OptimizedGlass (liftOnHover, press, glass-sheen, level1/level3) inside an OptimizedGlass container plus redundant 'glass-backdrop-blur-md' and Tailwind bg-white/8|12|15 - N+1 backdrop-filter layers per pagination (L259-269, L417-443). Also an 'ink' underline bar under the active page.
motion: CSS hover lift; ink indicator transitions width/left with no reduced-motion handling; spinner animate-spin.
a11y: BLOCKER: page/prev/next/first/last items are <div role=button> with no tabIndex and no Enter/Space handler (L405-446; createPaginationA11y adds only aria-* in src/utils/a11y.ts:678-695) - pagination is mouse-only. Certification DOM confirms: focusableElementCount=3 (only the story skip links). Disabled items still receive onClick (guarded in handler). Ellipsis exposed as a disabled 'More pages' button. announceToScreenReader live-region is a nice touch.
api: React.FC (no forwardRef), no style passthrough; className applied to both <nav> and inner glass (L256, L271); keys are index; registerPageRef calls requestAnimationFrame on every ref callback each render; usePagination returns {startIndex,endIndex} named 'currentItems'.
ssr: 'use client'; requestAnimationFrame inside ref callbacks only on client.
fake_complexity: None.
justification: Page-range logic is fine and the item-info compound is useful, but the controls are non-focusable divs (keyboard users cannot paginate at all) and each button stacks its own backdrop-filter, which is both visually noisy and expensive. Rebuild with real <button>/<a> items (asChild for router links), a single glass container, aria-current on the active page, and share it with the data-table paginators.

name: GlassResponsiveNav (alias ResponsiveNavigation)
material_impl: Composes GlassMobileNav and GlassBottomNav; desktop mode is a bespoke inline strip (glass-surface-overlay, inline transition) not using any glass primitive; wrapper adds glass-surface-subtle radius-xl.
motion: Inherited from children; useReducedMotion computed but unused (shouldReduceMotion never read, L136).
a11y: Wrapper role=navigation containing GlassBottomNav (role=tablist) and GlassMobileNav (role=dialog) and desktop links - nested/odd landmark structure; desktop fallback maps bottom items to href='#' anchors (L199-204, L269) - dead links; links get aria-current (good).
api: forwardRef; viewport switch in JS via window.innerWidth resize listener - initial render always 'desktop' so SSR/first paint on mobile flashes desktop then swaps; breakpoints not tied to tokens; elevation cast through 'as' (L228, L238) to types the children ignore anyway; navId and motion state unused.
ssr: 'use client'; hydration mismatch-free but layout shift on mobile (state defaults 'desktop', L144-146).
fake_complexity: tabletNavType='sidebar' renders the desktop strip, not a sidebar (comment L188-189).
target: GlassAppShell (app-shell) with CSS container/media-query driven chrome
justification: A JS-breakpoint switcher that inherits all of BottomNav's and MobileNav's defects, flashes desktop chrome on mobile first paint, fakes the 'sidebar' tablet mode and emits href='#' links. Responsive chrome belongs in the app-shell layout via CSS, not a runtime innerWidth listener.

name: GlassSegmentedControl
material_impl: Shared primitive: OptimizedGlass elevation level1 as track; each segment is a full GlassButton (variant primary when selected, secondary otherwise). No sliding thumb, so selection reads as a row of separate buttons, not one segmented material. material='liquid' delegates to LiquidGlassSegmentedControl.
motion: OptimizedGlass animation 'gentle' vs 'none' via useReducedMotion + respectMotionPreference (wired, L60-61, L90). No selection-indicator motion at all.
a11y: Outer <nav aria-label> wraps a role=group with the SAME aria-label (double landmark/label; a segmented control is not navigation). Segments use aria-pressed toggle buttons instead of radiogroup/radio or tablist semantics; no roving tabindex or arrow-key navigation. condensed=true hides labels with no aria-label fallback -> icon-only buttons without accessible names (L117).
api: forwardRef (ref lands on inner OptimizedGlass, while className lands on outer nav - split targets). No style passthrough, no ...rest. Controlled only (value default '', onChange noop) - no defaultValue. Size sm/md/lg. items typed but mapped as any (L99). Liquid branch ignores size/condensed.
ssr: 'use client'; no module-scope window access. Imports Liquid variant eagerly.
fake_complexity: None; simple.
target: single SegmentedControl (merge with LiquidGlassSegmentedControl and GlassToggleGroup)
justification: A segmented control is a signature Liquid Glass component (iOS/macOS), so it should be a flagship, but this implementation is a row of independent GlassButtons inside a glass track with no shared sliding thumb, wrong landmark semantics (nav + group with duplicate labels), no arrow-key/radio semantics, and icon-only mode loses accessible names. Two parallel implementations (glass vs liquid) with different prop names (items/onChange vs segments/onValueChange). Redesign as one component with a measured, spring-animated thumb on the liquid material, radiogroup semantics, controlled/uncontrolled, and consolidate the duplicates into it.

name: GlassSidebar
material_impl: OptimizedGlass (intent neutral, level1/level2, border subtle/gradient) - shared primitive. But toggle button is bespoke: glass-backdrop-blur-lg + bg-white/25 + inline backgroundColor rgba(255,255,255,0.28) + arbitrary Tailwind shadow (L266-278). Badges bespoke bg-white/24 border-white/30 shadow-md. Status dots raw Tailwind bg-green-500/yellow/red/gray (L709-713). Active item class is a single-quoted string containing a literal '${glassStyles.borderColor ...}' (L491) - broken class, active ring never applies.
motion: Motion primitive slideRight for overlay, slideDown for children. Dynamic Tailwind classes duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms] (L349, L484, L521, L545) are interpolated at runtime and will not be generated by Tailwind JIT. No explicit reduced-motion handling in this file (depends on Motion primitive).
a11y: OptimizedGlass role=navigation with label; items are buttons even when item.href is provided (href ignored entirely - no links, no aria-current). Parent items lack aria-expanded/aria-controls. Items set focus:outline-none (L485). Collapsed mode uses tooltips (good). Status dot is color-only. Toggle has aria-label + touch target.
api: forwardRef with manual ref merge. BUG: isCollapsed = collapsed ?? internalCollapsed (L177) with collapsed defaulting to false (L152) -> uncontrolled collapse toggle never works (internal state ignored); stories mask it by controlling collapsed. BUG: early return 'if (variant === overlay && !open) return null' (L216) precedes useLayoutEffect/useEffect (L235, L257) - Rules of Hooks violation, toggling open crashes React with hook-count mismatch. Default expansion hard-coded to item id 'home' (L459). Toggle portaled to document.body at viewport-fixed position measured from getBoundingClientRect (L397-414) - fragile in scroll containers/iframes. SidebarBrand/SidebarUserInfo define inner Content components per render (remount each render). data-glass-component passed to Context.Provider (L295) - meaningless.
ssr: 'use client'. createPortal guarded by mounted flag; window listeners in layout effect. OK for SSR but useLayoutEffect warns on server.
fake_complexity: Moderate: 'advanced features' doc claims; portal toggle positioning is over-engineered; toggleable uncontrolled state is fake (doesn't work).
target: single Sidebar in app-shell (merge LiquidGlassInsetSidebar, GlassSidebarRail/Panel)
justification: The sidebar is a core app-shell flagship surface, but this one has two real correctness bugs (uncontrolled collapse never toggles; hooks after a conditional return crash when overlay open flips), a broken active-state class, ignored hrefs (no real links / aria-current), runtime-interpolated Tailwind classes that never compile, and a body-portaled toggle that is positioned by measuring the viewport. It duplicates three other sidebars. Redesign one sidebar on the liquid material with proper link semantics, disclosure semantics for groups, controlled/uncontrolled state and an in-flow toggle.

name: SidebarBrand / SidebarUserInfo
material_impl: No glass; plain flex layout. Avatar fallback uses glass-surface-primary/20; status dots hard-coded Tailwind bg-green-500 etc.
motion: none
a11y: Status conveyed by color only; img alt=name OK; h1 used for brand title inside sidebar (L622) - wrong heading level for a component.
api: Plain functions, no forwardRef; must be inside GlassSidebar context (throws otherwise). Inner Content component recreated each render (L606, L723).
fake_complexity: none
target: Sidebar slots in redesigned app-shell Sidebar; use GlassAvatar
justification: Not exported from root (only module-level exports), unstoried, untested, and re-implements avatar/status that GlassAvatar already has. Fold into slot API of the redesigned sidebar.

name: GlassTabBar
material_impl: Container: styled.tsx TabBarContainer -> OptimizedGlassCore plus CSS module backdrop-filter (GlassTabBar.module.css:10-19) - double blur layer (OptimizedGlass + module). Selector: CSS module selectorBase with tokenised color-mix gradients (decent). Tabs: components/TabItem with inline rgba(255,255,255,0.28) active bg, borderRadius 6px, 0.875rem font, transition all - bespoke and off-token. Magnetic trail uses hard-coded 60px slots (L1101) and var(--color-${color}-transparent) tokens that do not exist in the token system.
motion: Claims physics/spring; reality: hand-rolled RAF momentum scroll with bounce (L670-759), mouse-drag scrolling on the container, 'magnetic' transform state. useTabAnimations results (animateToTab, selectorPosition...) are destructured and never used (L184-191). MagneticTrailEffect useCallback component is defined but never rendered (L992-1030). physics prop converted to finalAnimationConfig that is never consumed. Reduced motion via useAccessibilitySettings disables selector transform (wired partially), but the magnetic overlay and momentum scroll still run off isReducedMotion only through friction tweak.
a11y: role=tablist + aria-orientation on container; TabItem role=tab, aria-selected, roving tabindex, internal arrow-key handler. But GlassTabBar's own handleKeyDown (L342-421) is never attached to anything. No aria-controls wiring. Mouse-down on the container starts drag-scroll and mousemove preventDefault (L585), interfering with text selection/clicks. Mobile forces labels off (L108) but effectiveShowLabels is never passed to tabs, so it's dead.
api: forwardRef to an imperative handle (TabBarRef) - not a DOM ref. CRITICAL BUG: setTabRef is created per tab (L1122) but never passed to TabItemComponent (which is a non-forwardRef FC), so tabRefs.current is always empty -> selector never positions, scrollTabIntoView never runs, imperative getTabElement returns null, collapseTabs measurement bails (L965). BUG: '!activeTab' guards (L767, L874) treat index 0 as no selection. BUG: with collapseTabs, clicking the last visible real tab toggles the More menu even when nothing is collapsed (L305). toggleBadge/updateBadge are empty stubs (L279-286). onChange signature (event, index) differs from the rest of the library (value strings). 30+ props, many no-ops (glassVariant, iconPosition, placement, verticalDisplayMode, tabStyle, tabClassName, activeTabClassName, badgeStyle, defaultBadgeAnimation, responsiveConfig).
ssr: 'use client'; useResponsive reads window in hooks; document.createElement in callbacks only. OK.
fake_complexity: High. 'Physics-based animations' and 'magnetic' selector are largely dead code; selector is non-functional because refs are never attached; story uses variant default which renders no selector at all, masking it. ~60% of 1200 lines is unused or broken machinery.
target: GlassTabs (redesigned headless-tablist with animated liquid indicator)
justification: 1,200 lines of fake complexity: the 'physics' selector cannot work because tab refs are never attached, index-0 is treated as unselected, the component's own keyboard handler and magnetic-trail component are never wired, and a dozen props are no-ops. Its value (pill indicator CSS in the module) can be salvaged into a single Tabs implementation. Replace with the consolidated GlassTabs and keep GlassTabBar as a deprecated alias for one major.

name: GlassTabItem
material_impl: Fully bespoke inline styles: hard-coded padding 12px 20px, fontSize 14px, fallback #5ac8ff accent and #05111d text (L51, L135), rgba(99,102,241,0.3) focus ring fallback. Injects a <style> block per instance (L162-200) that sets hover background to the FULL accent color with !important - opaque cyan hover, not glass. Not a glass surface at all.
motion: Inline transition via useReducedMotion plus @media reduced-motion in injected CSS (wired). But the active underline indicator is removed entirely when reduced motion is on (L145) - state information lost, not just motion.
a11y: role=tab on an <a> when href is set (link-as-tab is wrong); every item tabIndex 0 (no roving), no aria-controls, no tablist parent required. focus-visible ring present (good).
api: forwardRef with 'as any'; no ...rest passthrough (aria/data attrs dropped); polymorphic only via href. Standalone - not composable with GlassTabs or GlassTabBar (third tab item implementation alongside components/TabItem and GlassTabsTrigger).
ssr: 'use client'; per-instance <style> tags duplicate N times in DOM.
fake_complexity: none
target: GlassTabsTrigger
justification: A third standalone tab-item implementation with off-token inline styles, a per-instance injected stylesheet with a garish !important accent hover, link-as-tab semantics, and an indicator that disappears under reduced motion. Nothing composes it. Deprecate in favour of the trigger of the consolidated Tabs.

name: GlassTabs (GlassTabs, GlassTabsList, GlassTabsTrigger, GlassTabsContent)
material_impl: List uses OptimizedGlass (variant ethereal, intensity subtle) for default/pills; triggers use GlassButton + glass-surface-* utility classes - shared primitives. Mixes raw Tailwind (rounded-2xl, after:bg-primary, focus-visible:ring-primary) with glass-* utilities. Selected default = glass-surface-subtle + shadow-md; no shared moving indicator.
motion: Each trigger wrapped in Motion preset scaleIn (L418-419) - tabs pop in on mount; content Motion fadeIn. Ink indicator is measured but rendered only inside the glass branch guarded by variant==='underline' (L243) which can never be true there (glass branch is default/pills only) - dead. Reduced motion depends solely on Motion primitive.
a11y: Best of the set: tablist with aria-orientation, role=tab, aria-selected, aria-controls/aria-labelledby, arrow/Home/End with loop, activationMode automatic/manual. Gaps: no roving tabindex (every trigger is tabbable), ids derived from value (collisions with multiple Tabs on a page: trigger-${value}), root wrapper role=navigation (L130) - tabs are not a landmark. Duplicate key handling on both list and trigger can double-move focus.
api: Radix-like compound API, forwardRef everywhere, value/defaultValue/onValueChange. Bug: handleValueChange uses 'if (!value)' (L109) so controlled value '' behaves as uncontrolled. Variants default/pills/underline/minimal. Layout hack: behaviour keyed on className.includes('glass-flex-1') (L422-454). registerTrigger runs rAF+setState in a ref callback every render.
ssr: 'use client'; window resize listener in effect; fine.
fake_complexity: Low; the ink indicator is the only dead feature.
target: canonical Tabs; absorb GlassTabBar, GlassTabItem, EnhancedGlassTabs, GlassPageTabs, LiquidGlassTabBar (as variant='liquid'/placement='bottom')
justification: The only tab implementation in this shard with a sound compound API and near-correct WAI-ARIA tabs semantics, so it should become the canonical Tabs. To meet the premium bar it needs a real shared animated indicator on the liquid material (the measured ink is currently dead code), roving tabindex, useId-based ids, removal of the scaleIn-per-trigger mount animation, removal of the className.includes layout hack, and the controlled-'' bug fix.

name: GlassToolbar
material_impl: OptimizedGlass level1/level2 - shared primitive; layout duplicated in both classes and inline style (L74 vs L79-87). material='liquid' delegates to LiquidGlassToolbar.
motion: OptimizedGlass animation gentle/none via useReducedMotion (wired).
a11y: role=navigation (L70) - a toolbar should be role=toolbar with arrow-key roving focus; it is labelled 'Toolbar'. Liquid branch uses role=toolbar - semantic mismatch between variants.
api: forwardRef, className, ...rest passthrough (rest spread after style - user style overwrites layout). left/center/right slots. scrollEdge/materialVariant only used by liquid branch; scrollEdge ignored by both (see LiquidGlassToolbar).
fake_complexity: none
target: single Toolbar (merge LiquidGlassToolbar; liquid as default material)
justification: Functional slot layout on the shared primitive, but wrong landmark role, no roving focus, and two parallel implementations with diverging semantics. Merge with LiquidGlassToolbar into one role=toolbar component with roving-focus groups.

name: HeaderUserMenu
material_impl: GlassPopover appearance=glass (shared) + GlassAvatar. Bespoke arbitrary Tailwind: shadow-[0_20px_60px_color-mix(...)], rounded-[14px], ring-white/10; raw text-red-300/red-400/bg-red-500/10 danger colors; status dot bg-green-500 etc. Many invented utility names (glass-text-primary-glass-opacity-80, glass-gradient-primary repeated 3x, glass-via-white-opacity-3) that likely resolve to nothing.
motion: useReducedMotion gates hover scale class, but the class is a runtime-interpolated duration-[${ANIMATION.DURATION.fast}ms] (L228) that Tailwind cannot generate.
a11y: Trigger aria-haspopup=menu + aria-expanded, but content is not role=menu and items are not menuitem; no arrow-key navigation, no focus move into menu. Wrapped in <nav role=navigation> (redundant role, wrong landmark for a single menu button). Status color-only in trigger.
api: forwardRef to trigger button. className applied to BOTH the nav wrapper and the button (L98, L229). intent/elevation/tier props declared but ignored. ContrastGuard imported unused. Default fake user 'User'.
fake_complexity: intent/elevation/tier are no-op props.
target: GlassDropdownMenu / GlassMenuPrimitive recipe (AccountMenu pattern)
justification: Not exported from the package root or any subpath, so it is effectively dead public surface despite stories/tests. It re-implements a dropdown menu without menu semantics or keyboard support, with no-op props and invented utility classes. Rebuild as a thin recipe on GlassMenuPrimitive (role=menu, roving focus) or drop.

name: LiquidGlassBottomAccessory
material_impl: Pure LiquidGlassMaterial radius full - the cleanest material usage in the shard (no overrides).
motion: none; collapsed only drops opacity to 90% (L19).
a11y: Generic div; no region/label. Fine as a container.
api: forwardRef, className, ...props. collapsed is cosmetic only.
fake_complexity: collapsed state does not collapse anything.
target: BottomTabBar.Accessory sub-component
justification: A 29-line pill wrapper; correct material usage, but as a standalone export it adds API surface without behaviour (collapsed is fake). Make it a slot/sub-component of the redesigned bottom tab bar with a real collapse transition.

name: LiquidGlassInsetSidebar
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial radius 2xl, overridden with hard-coded white gradient (L74-76); selected item inline rgba(255,255,255,0.28) (L30).
motion: none; width snaps between w-20 and w-72.
a11y: aside + inner nav with label (nav re-reads props['aria-label'], which is also spread on the aside - duplicate label). Items are buttons with aria-current=page (should be links for navigation). Collapsed adds aria-label (good). No hover/focus styles (inline reset).
api: forwardRef, ...props. No-ops: collapsible (only adds sr-only text 'Sidebar is fixed'), scrollEdge (unused), backgroundExtension (data-attr only). No onCollapsedChange/toggle. No nested items, header or footer slots.
fake_complexity: backgroundExtension, scrollEdge, collapsible mirror Apple API names without implementation.
target: redesigned app-shell Sidebar (variant='inset')
justification: The 'inset' presentation is the right modern look, but the component is a flat list of buttons with three no-op Apple-named props and a hard-coded white fill. Make it the inset variant of the single redesigned Sidebar.

name: LiquidGlassInspectorPanel
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial radius 2xl (no overrides) + LiquidGlassScrollEdge top hard - good primitive usage.
motion: none; open just mounts/unmounts (L42).
a11y: aside aria-label=title, h2 title, sections aria-labelledby (ids from section.id - collision risk). Close button is an unstyled native button showing the letter 'x' (L63-65) - not an icon, no touch target, no focus styling. No Escape handling.
api: forwardRef, ...props, controlled open/onOpenChange. placement 'left' renders identically to 'right' (L48). resizable = CSS resize-x on the aside (crude native grip). Category mismatch: lives in navigation but is a workspace panel.
fake_complexity: placement left/right is cosmetic only; resizable is the browser's native resize handle.
target: GlassInspectorPanel (src/workspace/index.tsx)
justification: Correct material and scroll-edge primitives, but a literal 'x' close glyph, native CSS resize, no enter/exit transition, no Escape, and placement that does nothing. There is already a GlassInspectorPanel in workspace; merge into that one and give it a real resize handle, icon close button and slide transition.

name: LiquidGlassSegmentedControl
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial + LiquidGlassEffectGroup primitives, but then overrides the material background with a hard-coded inline gradient rgba(255,255,255,.28)->.14 (L46-48), defeating the material's adaptive tinting. Segment buttons use inline border rgba(255,255,255,0.3) and selected background rgba(255,255,255,0.28) - white-on-white on light backdrops.
motion: None of its own; relies on LiquidGlassMaterial (which reads useReducedMotion internally). No selection thumb animation.
a11y: role=group without aria-label default; aria-pressed buttons; no arrow keys. Inline style color forces text-secondary on ALL segments (L72), overriding the selected 'glass-text-primary' class (L67) - selected segment has no text-weight/color distinction, only a faint white fill.
api: forwardRef, className + ...props passthrough (props spread after style, so a user style prop REPLACES the gradient). Controlled only. density prop only sets data-density (L49) - no styling effect found.
fake_complexity: density is a no-op prop.
target: GlassSegmentedControl (redesigned, liquid material default)
justification: Thin wrapper that uses the right primitives then neutralises them with hard-coded white rgba fills; selected state is barely distinguishable because inline color overrides the selected class; density is fake; 1-line test. Fold its primitive usage into the redesigned single SegmentedControl and delete.

name: LiquidGlassTabBar
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial + EffectGroup; background overridden with near-transparent white gradient 0.105->0.018 (L103-104). Selected tab = inline rgba(255,255,255,0.18) fill (L36). No shared lens/thumb.
motion: Scroll-driven minimize (labels hidden on scroll) via passive listener; instantaneous, no transition; no reduced-motion consideration (none needed since no animation, but minimize is abrupt). minimizeBehavior 'on-scroll' and 'auto' are identical (L72-74).
a11y: Buttons role=tab with aria-selected but NO role=tablist parent, no aria-controls, no arrow keys, all tabbable. When minimized, non-selected tabs lose their visible label and have no aria-label - icon-only tabs with no accessible name if icon provided (L128). Search tab gets sr-only 'Search tab' appended to its name.
api: forwardRef, ...props, controlled only (activeTab/onChange with id strings). accessoryPlacement 'auto' equals 'above'. scrollTargetRef read once in effect (ref.current captured).
fake_complexity: iOS 26 vocabulary (minimizeBehavior, bottomAccessory, searchTabId) mirrored as props but mostly shallow: no morphing, no search tab separation, auto==on-scroll.
target: BottomTabBar (merge GlassBottomNav) built on consolidated Tabs semantics
justification: A floating Liquid Glass bottom tab bar with minimize-on-scroll and a bottom accessory is exactly the iOS 26 flagship pattern, but this is a props-only imitation: broken tab semantics (no tablist), icon-only minimized tabs without names, abrupt minimize with no morph, and duplicate behaviours. Redesign as the flagship mobile tab bar with a spring-animated selection lens, proper tablist/keyboard, and animated minimize respecting reduced motion; merge GlassBottomNav.

name: LiquidGlassToolbar
material_impl: LiquidGlassMaterial + LiquidGlassEffectGroup, then overrides background with hard-coded white rgba gradient (L94-96). Toolbar buttons fully unstyled (border 0, transparent) - no hover/pressed/focus states (L44-50).
motion: None of its own; glass-transition class only.
a11y: role=toolbar but no roving tabindex/arrow keys (required pattern). Items render visible label AND aria-label=label (redundant). Groups are unlabeled divs unless aria-label provided; no focus-visible styling on buttons since inline style resets.
api: forwardRef, ...props. Declared but unused: scrollEdge (destructured, never used), floating only adds z-40 (no floating appearance), primaryActionId only toggles text color. Data-driven groups AND slot children both supported (two APIs in one).
fake_complexity: scrollEdge and floating are effectively no-ops.
target: single Toolbar
justification: Uses the liquid primitives but neuters the material with a fixed white gradient, ships unstyled buttons without interaction states, and advertises scrollEdge/floating that do nothing. Fold its groups API into the consolidated Toolbar.

name: TabBarContainer / TabSelector (styled.tsx)
material_impl: OptimizedGlassCore + CSS module; blur mapped to --glass-blur-* tokens with px fallbacks (L12-17). Background=false uses inline transparent + module !important override. Most $-props become data-attributes with no CSS consuming them ($glassVariant, $iconPosition, $placement, $color).
motion: CSS transitions on left/top/width/height (layout-thrashing properties) in module; disableAnimation sets transition none.
a11y: Selector aria-hidden role=presentation (correct).
api: forwardRef; legacy styled-components-style $props retained after migration.
ssr: No 'use client' but no browser access; fine.
fake_complexity: $glassVariant etc. are cosmetic no-ops (data-attr only).
target: absorbed into consolidated Tabs indicator styles
justification: Internal leftovers from a styled-components migration; only GlassTabBar uses them. The selector gradient CSS is the one reusable asset; move it into the consolidated tabs stylesheet and animate with transform instead of left/width.

name: GlassCoherenceIndicator
material_impl: OptimizedGlass variant=frosted. createGlassStyle({blur,opacity}).background (a CSS value) is passed into className, which yields a garbage class. `${hsl(var(--x))}80` appends a hex alpha to an hsl() string, which is invalid CSS, so the gradient fails. Fixed 300x100 SVG.
motion: framer width animation honors shouldAnimate. realTimeMode setInterval(100ms) ignores reduced motion. The decoherence warning pulse honors reduced motion. Inline <animate> SVG particles ignore it.
a11y: The progress bar has no role=meter/progressbar or value attributes. The ⚠️ emoji is the status icon. The SVG has no title or desc. Hard-coded SVG pattern id 'grid' collides across instances.
api: forwardRef; className only (it does not extend HTMLAttributes, though it spreads ...props). coherenceLevel is copied into state on mount and never resynced, so the prop is effectively uncontrolled. No displayName.
